import { api } from './backend'

export type ManagedRole = 'customer' | 'organizer' | 'staff' | 'admin'

export interface BackendManagedUser {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: ManagedRole
  createdAt?: string
  status?: 'active' | 'disabled'
}

type BackendRole = 'ATTENDEE' | 'ORGANIZER' | 'CHECK_IN_STAFF' | 'ADMIN'

const ROLE_FROM_BACKEND: Record<BackendRole, ManagedRole> = {
  ATTENDEE: 'customer',
  ORGANIZER: 'organizer',
  CHECK_IN_STAFF: 'staff',
  ADMIN: 'admin',
}

const ROLE_TO_BACKEND: Record<ManagedRole, BackendRole> = {
  customer: 'ATTENDEE',
  organizer: 'ORGANIZER',
  staff: 'CHECK_IN_STAFF',
  admin: 'ADMIN',
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function mapUser(value: unknown): BackendManagedUser {
  if (!isRecord(value)) throw new Error('The backend returned an invalid user record.')
  const { id, name, email, role, createdAt, created_at } = value
  if (
    (typeof id !== 'string' && typeof id !== 'number') ||
    typeof name !== 'string' ||
    typeof email !== 'string' ||
    typeof role !== 'string'
  ) {
    throw new Error('The backend returned a user missing its ID, name, email, or role.')
  }
  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ROLE_FROM_BACKEND, role)) {
    throw new Error(`The backend returned an unsupported user role: ${role}`)
  }
  return {
    id: String(id),
    name,
    email,
    role: ROLE_FROM_BACKEND[role as BackendRole],
    createdAt: typeof createdAt === 'string' ? createdAt : typeof created_at === 'string' ? created_at : undefined,
    status: value.isActive === true || value.status === 'ACTIVE'
      ? 'active'
      : value.isActive === false || value.status === 'DISABLED'
        ? 'disabled'
        : undefined,
  }
}

export async function fetchManagedUsers(): Promise<BackendManagedUser[]> {
  const users: unknown[] = []
  let page = 1
  let totalPages: number | undefined

  do {
    const result: unknown = await api<unknown>(`/users?page=${page}&limit=100`)
    const list = Array.isArray(result)
      ? result
      : isRecord(result) && Array.isArray(result.data)
        ? result.data
        : isRecord(result) && Array.isArray(result.items)
          ? result.items
          : isRecord(result) && Array.isArray(result.users)
            ? result.users
            : null
    if (!list) {
      throw new Error('The backend returned an invalid user list.')
    }
    users.push(...list)

    const meta = isRecord(result) && isRecord(result.meta) ? result.meta : null
    const pagination = isRecord(result) && isRecord(result.pagination) ? result.pagination : null
    const reportedPages = meta?.totalPages ?? pagination?.totalPages ??
      (isRecord(result) ? result.totalPages : undefined)
    if (reportedPages !== undefined) {
      if (typeof reportedPages !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(reportedPages) || reportedPages < 0) {
        throw new Error('The backend returned invalid user pagination details.')
      }
      totalPages = reportedPages
    } else if (list.length < 100) {
      totalPages = page
    }

    if (list.length === 0) break
    page += 1
  } while (totalPages === undefined || page <= totalPages)

  return users.map(mapUser)
}

export function updateManagedUserRole(userId: string, role: ManagedRole): Promise<void> {
  return api<void>(`/users/${encodeURIComponent(userId)}/role`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: { role: ROLE_TO_BACKEND[role] },
  })
}

export function createManagedUser(input: {
  name: string
  email: string
  password: string
  role: ManagedRole
}): Promise<unknown> {
  return api('/users', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: {
      name: input.name.trim(),
      email: input.email.trim(),
      password: input.password,
      role: ROLE_TO_BACKEND[input.role],
    },
  })
}

export function setManagedUserActive(userId: string, isActive: boolean): Promise<void> {
  return api<void>(`/users/${encodeURIComponent(userId)}/status`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: { isActive },
  })
}

import { API } from './backend'

// Bundled pictures an organizer can pick instead of uploading their own.
export const DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES = [
  '/images/events/event-1.webp',
  '/images/events/event-2.jpg',
  '/images/events/event-3.webp',
]

// The image of an event: the organizer's upload, a chosen default, or (when nothing was
// chosen) one of the defaults picked from the event id.
export function resolveEventImage(imageUrl: string | null | undefined, eventId: string): string {
  if (imageUrl) {
    // uploads live on the backend, which the browser reaches through the /be proxy
    return imageUrl.startsWith('/uploads/') ? `${API}${imageUrl}` : imageUrl
  }
  let hash = 0
  for (const char of eventId) hash = (hash * 31 + char.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0
  return DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES[hash % DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES.length]
}

import { api } from './backend'

export interface PendingPayment {
  txRef: string
  orderNumber: string
  eventId: string
  ticketTypeId: string
  quantity: number
  holder: string
  userId: string
  createdAt: string
  status: 'pending' | 'completed'
  ticketIds?: string[]
}

export interface VerifiedPayment {
  status: 'success' | 'pending' | 'failed'
  tx_ref: string
}

interface CreateOrderInput {
  eventId: string
  ticketTypeId: string
  quantity: number
}

export const PENDING_PAYMENTS_KEY = 'tm.ticket-master.pending-payments'

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function findOrderNumber(value: unknown, depth = 0): string | undefined {
  if (!isRecord(value) || depth > 3) return undefined

  for (const key of ['orderNumber', 'order_number', 'number']) {
    const candidate = value[key]
    if ((typeof candidate === 'string' || typeof candidate === 'number') && String(candidate).trim()) {
      return String(candidate).trim()
    }
  }

  for (const key of ['data', 'order', 'result']) {
    const nested = findOrderNumber(value[key], depth + 1)
    if (nested) return nested
  }
  return undefined
}

function readPending(): PendingPayment[] {
  const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(PENDING_PAYMENTS_KEY)
  if (!raw) return []

  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw)
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) throw new Error('Saved payment references are invalid. Clear them and try again.')
  return parsed as PendingPayment[]
}

function writePending(items: PendingPayment[]): void {
  window.localStorage.setItem(PENDING_PAYMENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(items.slice(0, 50)))
}

export function savePendingPayment(payment: PendingPayment): void {
  writePending([payment, ...readPending().filter((item) => item.txRef !== payment.txRef)])
}

export function getPendingPayment(txRef: string): PendingPayment | undefined {
  return readPending().find((item) => item.txRef === txRef)
}

export function latestPendingPayment(): PendingPayment | undefined {
  return readPending().find((item) => item.status === 'pending')
}

export function markPaymentCompleted(txRef: string, ticketIds: string[]): void {
  writePending(
    readPending().map((item) => (item.txRef === txRef ? { ...item, status: 'completed', ticketIds } : item)),
  )
}

export function addPendingTickets(txRef: string, ticketIds: string[]): void {
  if (ticketIds.length === 0) return
  writePending(
    readPending().map((item) =>
      item.txRef === txRef
        ? { ...item, ticketIds: Array.from(new Set([...(item.ticketIds ?? []), ...ticketIds])) }
        : item,
    ),
  )
}

export async function createOrder(input: CreateOrderInput): Promise<{ orderNumber: string }> {
  const result = await api<unknown>('/orders', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: {
      eventId: input.eventId,
      items: [{ ticketTypeId: input.ticketTypeId, quantity: input.quantity }],
    },
  })

  const orderNumber = findOrderNumber(result)
  if (!orderNumber) {
    throw new Error('The backend did not return an order number.')
  }
  return { orderNumber }
}

export async function initiatePayment(orderNumber: string): Promise<{ checkout_url: string; tx_ref: string }> {
  const result = await api<unknown>(
    `/payments/orders/${encodeURIComponent(orderNumber)}/checkout`,
    { method: 'POST' },
  )
  const dataObj = isRecord(result) && isRecord(result.data) ? result.data : result;
  const checkoutUrl = isRecord(dataObj) ? (dataObj.checkout_url || dataObj.checkoutUrl) : undefined;
  const txRef = isRecord(dataObj) ? (dataObj.tx_ref || dataObj.txRef) : undefined;

  if (typeof checkoutUrl !== 'string' || typeof txRef !== 'string' || !txRef.trim()) {
    throw new Error('The backend did not return a PayChangu checkout URL and transaction reference.')
  }
  let url: URL
  try {
    url = new URL(checkoutUrl)
  } catch {
    throw new Error('The backend returned an invalid PayChangu checkout URL.')
  }
  if (url.protocol !== 'https:' && url.protocol !== 'http:') {
    throw new Error('The backend returned an unsupported PayChangu checkout URL.')
  }
  return { checkout_url: url.toString(), tx_ref: txRef }
}

export async function verifyPayment(txRef: string): Promise<VerifiedPayment> {
  const result = await api<unknown>(`/payments/${encodeURIComponent(txRef)}/verify`)
  // The backend reports the payment as paymentStatus; older responses used status.
  const rawStatus = isRecord(result)
    ? (typeof result.paymentStatus === 'string' ? result.paymentStatus : result.status)
    : undefined
  if (!isRecord(result) || typeof rawStatus !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('The backend returned an invalid payment verification response.')
  }

  const status = rawStatus.toLowerCase()
  const mappedStatus =
    ['success', 'successful', 'paid', 'completed'].includes(status)
      ? 'success'
      : ['pending', 'processing', 'initiated'].includes(status)
        ? 'pending'
        : 'failed'

  const responseTxRef =
    typeof result.tx_ref === 'string'
      ? result.tx_ref
      : typeof result.txRef === 'string'
        ? result.txRef
        : txRef
  return { status: mappedStatus, tx_ref: responseTxRef }
}

export type TicketStatus = 'valid' | 'used' | 'cancelled' | 'refunded'

export interface TicketRecord {
  id: string
  userId: string
  eventId: string
  eventName: string
  date: string
  time: string
  venue: string
  city: string
  ticketType: string
  price: number
  holder: string
  status: TicketStatus
  createdAt: string
  checkedInAt?: string
  qrCodeDataUrl?: string
}

export type TicketValidationStatus = 'valid' | 'invalid' | 'used' | 'wrong_event'

export interface TicketValidationResult {
  status: TicketValidationStatus
  title: string
  message: string
  ticket?: TicketRecord
  tampered?: boolean
}

export function parseTicketCode(raw: string): { id: string; tag: string | null } {
  const cleaned = raw.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/^TICKET:/, '')
  const dot = cleaned.lastIndexOf('.')
  if (dot === -1) return { id: cleaned, tag: null }
  return { id: cleaned.slice(0, dot), tag: cleaned.slice(dot + 1) }
}

export function normalizeTicketCode(raw: string): string {
  return parseTicketCode(raw).id
}

export interface TicketType {
  id: string
  name: string
  price: number
  capacity: number
  sold: number
}

export interface Event {
  id: string
  title: string
  category: string
  city: string
  venue: string
  date: string // ISO date, e.g. 2026-11-14
  time: string // 24h, e.g. 18:00
  description: string
  organizer: string
  ownerId?: string // id of the organizer account that owns the event
  image: string
  ticketTypes: TicketType[]
}

// cheapest ticket type price, used for cards, filters and sorting
export function fromPrice(event: Event): number {
  if (event.ticketTypes.length === 0) return 0
  return Math.min(...event.ticketTypes.map((type) => type.price))
}

export function remainingSeats(type: TicketType): number {
  return Math.max(0, type.capacity - type.sold)
}

export function isSoldOut(event: Event): boolean {
  return (
    event.ticketTypes.length > 0 &&
    event.ticketTypes.every((type) => remainingSeats(type) === 0)
  )
}

// true when the event date is today or later
export function isUpcomingEvent(event: Event): boolean {
  const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA') // YYYY-MM-DD
  return event.date >= today
}

# Figure A-2: Sequence diagram, log in

Requirements: FR-07 (log in), NFR-07 (protected pages need a signed-in user). Picture for the SRS: `images/login.png`.

```mermaid
%%{init: {'theme':'neutral'}}%%
sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant Guard as Route guard
    participant Login as Login page
    participant Auth as Auth store
    participant Store as Local storage

    User->>Guard: Open protected page
    Guard->>Login: Redirect to login (no session)
    User->>Login: Submit login form
    Login->>Auth: loginRequest(email, password)
    Auth->>Auth: Check account
    alt Wrong email or password, or account disabled
        Auth-->>Login: Error
        Login-->>User: Show error message
    else Account accepted
        Auth->>Store: Save session
        Auth-->>Login: Return user
        Login->>Guard: Go to the page
        Guard->>Guard: Check role
        Guard-->>User: Show the page
    end
```

Notes
- In the current build the auth store and the session are in the browser. With the backend, "Auth store" becomes `POST /auth/login` on the Backend API and "Local storage" holds the token.
- A signed-in user with the wrong role is sent away from the page by the route guard (check this against the `requireAuth` code).

# Authentication and access control

Owner: Ishmael (bsc-19-23)
Reviewer: <Misheck> 
Issue: #<99>
Requirements covered: FR-06, FR-07, FR-08, NFR-07

## Purpose
Lets people register and log in, and makes sure every protected page is opened only by a signed-in user with the right role. A visitor who is not signed in cannot buy tickets.

## Actors
Customer, Organizer, Staff, Admin. A visitor who is not signed in can only register and log in.

## Responsibilities
- Register a new Customer or Organizer account with name, email and password (FR-06).
- Log in with email and password and keep the session in the browser (FR-07).
- Block visitors who are not signed in from buying tickets: the checkout pages need the Customer role (FR-08).
- Protect every page that is not public: each protected route checks that the user is signed in and has the correct role, otherwise the user is redirected (NFR-07).
- Let an Organizer create Staff accounts, and let an Admin create, disable and delete accounts.
- Log out and show each role only its own menu links.

## Inputs and outputs
| Receives from | What | Sends to | What |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Visitor | name, email, password, role (Customer or Organizer) | Auth store | new account |
| Login page | email, password | Auth store | user record, or an error message |
| Auth store | session: id, name, email, role | Local storage | saved session |
| Any user | request to open a page | Route guard | the page, a redirect to login, or a redirect away |
| Organizer | staff name, email, password | Auth store | new Staff account |
| Admin | create, disable or delete an account | Auth store | updated accounts |

## Depends on
- Browser storage: holds the accounts and the session in the current build.
- Router guards: `requireAuth(role)` on each protected route.
- Header menu: shows only the links the role may use.

## Data it uses
- User: id, name, email, role (customer, organizer, staff, admin), status (active or disabled). The demo store also keeps the password.
- Session: id, name, email, role.

## Rules and assumptions
- Only Customers and Organizers can register themselves. Staff accounts are created by an Organizer and Admin accounts by an Admin.
- A wrong email or password, or a disabled account, is rejected with an error message.
- Customer pages and checkout need the Customer role, organizer pages the Organizer role, the scanner the Staff role and the admin pages the Admin role.
- Assumption to confirm: a visitor who is not signed in is sent to the login page, and a signed-in user with the wrong role is sent away from the page.
- Not decided yet: with the backend, login returns a token that expires (the backend setting is 15 minutes). The team must decide what happens when it expires.
- The backend must store passwords hashed, not as plain text.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A-1 | Use case | use-case.drawio (picture: images/use-case.png) | Draft |
| A-2 | Sequence | login.md (picture: images/login.png) | Draft |

- [ ] Every requirement listed above appears in a diagram
- [ ] Every actor and component in the diagram is described in this page
- [ ] The diagram can be read without extra explanation

# Events Module work flows......

This is a simple overview of how the Events part of the system is work and built.

## What it does

- Anyone can look at events without logging in.
- Anyone can search, filter and sort events.
- Anyone can open an event to see its details and how many tickets are left.
- Organizers can log in to create and edit their own events.
- The number of tickets left updates live on the screen.

## The main pieces

**Events Controller**
The front door. It receives every request from the website or app and sends back the answer.

**Auth Guard**
The security check. It only applies to organizers. It makes sure the person is logged in, is an organizer, and (when editing) owns the event. Visitors never go through it.

**Event Service**
The brain. It decides what to do with each request and talks to the other pieces.

**Search and Filter**
Finds events. You can search by words, filter by category, date, location, price and availability, and sort the results.

**Validator**
Checks what an organizer typed before saving. For example, the date must be in the future and the price can't be negative.

**Ticket-Types Service**
Looks after the ticket types for each event (like "Regular" or "VIP"), with their price and quantity.

**Availability Service**
Works out how many tickets are left and sends updates to anyone viewing the event.

**Image Storage**
Keeps event pictures. The database only saves the link to the picture.

**Database**
Stores events, ticket types, users and orders.

## What visitors can do

Visitors only read. They never need a login.

| What they want | Request |
|----------------|---------|
| See a list of events | `GET /events` |
| Search, filter, sort | `GET /events?q=music&category=concert&sort=date` |
| Open one event | `GET /events/{id}` |
| See tickets left | `GET /events/{id}/availability` |
| Watch tickets left live | `GET /events/{id}/availability/stream` |

Only published events show up for visitors. Drafts stay hidden.

## What organizers can do

Organizers must be logged in.

| What they want | Request |
|----------------|---------|
| Create an event (saved as draft) | `POST /events` |
| Edit an event | `PUT /events/{id}` |
| Publish a draft | `POST /events/{id}/publish` |

## How creating an event works

1. The organizer opens the form and the system checks they are logged in and allowed to create events.
2. They fill in the details, add ticket types and save it as a draft.
3. The system checks the details. If something is wrong, it sends back the errors so they can fix them.
4. The picture is uploaded. If that fails, the form keeps what they typed so they can try again.
5. The event and its ticket types are saved together. If saving fails, nothing is kept and the organizer sees an error.
6. When the organizer clicks Publish, the system checks the event is ready: the date is in the future, there is at least one ticket type, and the price and quantity are set.
7. If it is ready, the event goes live and shows up in browse and search. If not, it stays a draft and the system says what is missing.

## How live ticket counts work

Tickets left = total tickets minus tickets sold.

When the number changes (someone buys a ticket, or the organizer edits the event), the system sends the new number to everyone looking at that event. We use Server-Sent Events (SSE) for this. It is a simple way for the server to push updates to the browser.

If the live connection drops, the page can still ask for the number normally.

## Data we store

- **Users:** who can log in, and their role.
- **Events:** name, description, category, start and end time, location, image link, status (draft, published or cancelled), organizer.
- **Ticket types:** name, price, total quantity, and which event they belong to.
- **Orders:** tickets that were bought (handled by the ordering part of the system).

## Errors we return

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 401 | Not logged in |
| 403 | Logged in, but not allowed |
| 404 | Event not found |
| 409 | Someone else changed the event first |
| 422 | Something typed was invalid |
| 500 | Something went wrong on our side |

## Things to keep in mind

- Speed: add database indexes on date, category and location, and keep popular lists in a short cache.
- Security: always check the login and the owner, and never trust what the user types.
- Safe edits: if two people edit the same event, the second save is rejected with a 409 so nothing gets overwritten.

## Questions still open

1. Can an organizer change the date, price or quantity after tickets have been sold?
2. How long should cancelled events stay visible?
3. Is location just text, a city list, or a map point with distance search?
4. Do tickets get held for a few minutes while someone pays?
5. Can one event have several dates?

## Diagrams

### Component Diagram (how the pieces connect)

**Who uses the system**
- Visitors: no login needed. Their requests go straight to the Events Controller.
- Organizers: must be logged in. Their requests go to the Auth Guard first, and then on to the Events Controller.

**What happens inside**
1. The Events Controller receives the request and passes it to the Event Service.
2. The Event Service does the work by talking to these pieces:
   - Search and Filter: finds events for the list and search pages.
   - Validator: checks what the organizer typed.
   - Ticket-Types Service: looks after ticket types, prices and quantities.
   - Availability Service: works out how many tickets are left.
   - Image Storage: keeps the event pictures.
3. Search and Filter and the Ticket-Types Service read from and save to the Database.
4. The Availability Service asks the Ticket-Types Service how many tickets are left. It then sends that number to everyone watching the event page, as a live update.

### Activity Diagram (creating and publishing an event)

1. The organizer opens the "Create event" form.
2. The system checks that they are logged in.
   - If not: it shows error 401 and sends them to the login page. The process stops.
3. The system checks that they are an organizer.
   - If not: it shows error 403 (not allowed). The process stops.
4. The organizer fills in the details (name, description, date, time, location, category, price and picture) and adds the ticket types and quantities.
5. The organizer clicks "Save draft".
6. The system checks the details.
   - If something is wrong: it shows the errors (422). The organizer fixes them and saves again.
7. The system uploads the picture.
   - If the upload fails: it shows an error and keeps what the organizer typed. The organizer uploads the picture again.
8. The system saves the event and its ticket types together.
   - If saving fails: it undoes everything and shows an error (500). The process stops.
9. The event is now saved as a **draft**. The organizer can review it and make changes.
10. The organizer clicks "Publish".
11. The system checks the event is ready: the date is in the future, there is at least one ticket type, and the price and quantity are set.
    - If not ready: the event stays a draft and the system lists what is missing. The organizer fixes it and tries again.
12. The event becomes **published**. It now shows up in browse and search, and the live ticket count starts.
13. The organizer sees a confirmation and the public link to the event.

# Functional requirements for unregistered and registered users/customers: 

//How it works for a customer or user.

1. Access platform and discover events

   - the system must allow any user/customer to open the web application in any modern browsers like  "microsoft edge" without login to browse events.

2. search, filter and sort events on search bar

   - the system must allow user/customer to search and filter events to discover relevant events    quickly

3. view events details

   - when user/customer clicks or open an event card, the system must display full events details

4. Authentication to book ticket

   - the system shall require login/sign-up before ticket booking to secure purchase

5. book and purchase events ticket

   - all authenticated customer shall be able to book and purchase a ticket

6. generate and display digital ticket with QR code 

   - upon successful booking, the system shall  generate and display digital ticket in detail.

7. save and download ticket

   - the system shall allow customer to save tickets for offline use.

8. ticket and booking history

   - logged-in customer shall be able to view all purchase tickets in one place

Functional requirements identified for ticket generation and door validation:

1. Ticket Generation

//System should be able to:

 a. Generate a digital ticket after successful purchase.
 b. Assign a unique identifier to each ticket.
 c. Generate a QR code/barcode for the ticket.
 d. Display relevant event and ticket information.
 e. Allow the customer to access/view the digital ticket.

2. Door Validation
//System should be able to:

 a. Allow the event player to scan the QR code/barcode.
 b. Verify ticket validity.
 c. Verify that the ticket belongs to the relevant event.
 d. Reject invalid tickets.
 d. Prevent reuse of already validated tickets.
 e. Display the validation result to the event player.

See [ticket-booking-payment-flows.md](ticket-booking-payment-flows.md) for the booking/payment sequence and activity diagrams.

FILE: ./docs/non-funtional-requirements.md

# Non-Functional Requirements

### Performance & Caching
*   The web application must cache results to reduce API calls.
*   Caching and API data fetching must be handled efficiently using Tanstack Query.
*   The ticket purchasing and event discovery processes must load quickly and operate in as few steps as possible to prevent slow transactions.

### Responsiveness across devices
*   The web application interfaces developed for both the customer and the event organizer must be fully responsive and function seamlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

### Usability/accessibility expectations
*   The platform must deliver a unified, low-friction user experience that eliminates the cumbersome, multi-step processes currently faced by users.
*   Event setup and sales tracking interfaces must be streamlined and intuitive so organizers do not lose time to inefficient operations.
*   Pricing information must be clear, transparent, and easy to read for the buyer during the purchasing experience.
*   Routing must be handled smoothly using Tanstack Router to ensure intuitive navigation.

### Basic security expectations
*   The platform must facilitate a secure purchasing environment for tickets.
*   The generated digital tickets (QR/barcode) must be trustworthy, unique, and reliably verifiable at the point of entry to eliminate attendee uncertainty and prevent fraud.
*   The frontend architecture must be robust, utilizing the mandated ReactJS/TypeScript framework to ensure type safety and minimize runtime errors.

3. Track sales and attendance
4. Control access and validate tickets

 b. Verify ticket validity.

 e. Display the validation result to the event player.

FILE: ./docs/ticket-booking-payment-flows.md
================================================================================
# Ticket Types, Booking & Payments

This document covers the purchase and payment flow for a customer, plus the
organizer controls that determine what can be bought. It is the diagram set for
requirements `FR-09` to `FR-14`, `FR-32`, `FR-33`, `FR-35`, `FR-37`, `NFR-06`
and `NFR-09`.

## Preconditions set by the organizer

- The organizer creates publishes an event with a maximum capacity (`FR-33`).
- The organizer sets or updates the price of each ticket type (`FR-32`).
- A ticket type is only purchasable while it is active, inside its sales window,
  and while it has remaining quantity.
- The backend is the source of truth for stock. A ticket is claimed only after
  the payment has been confirmed and verified; the application does not issue a
  ticket, or reduce availability, before that point (`NFR-09`).

## Sequence diagram: buy a ticket, including rollback on payment failure

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Customer
    participant UI as Checkout UI
    participant Pay as PayChangu
    participant PayAPI as Payment adapter
    participant TicketAPI as Ticket backend
    participant DB as Backend database

    Customer->>UI: Open event and choose ticket type and quantity
    UI->>TicketAPI: GET /events/:eventId/ticket-types
    TicketAPI-->>UI: Active ticket types, price, quantity and remaining
    UI->>UI: Check remaining quantity (FR-09, FR-13)
    alt Not enough tickets remaining
        UI-->>Customer: Show "sold out" / reduce quantity, block purchase
    else Tickets available
        UI-->>Customer: Show ticket price subtotal, service fee and total (FR-10, NFR-06)
        Customer->>UI: Confirm order (FR-11)
        UI->>UI: Save pending payment with txRef, user, event, ticket type and quantity
        UI->>Pay: Start PayChangu checkout
        Pay-->>Customer: Payment prompt / checkout page
        Customer->>Pay: Pay or cancel

        alt Payment fails, is cancelled, or remains unconfirmed
            Pay-->>UI: Return with failed/pending status
            UI->>PayAPI: Verify payment by txRef
            PayAPI-->>UI: failed / pending
            UI->>UI: Cancel the pending order; do not call ticket issuance
            UI-->>Customer: Show failure, no ticket issued, availability unchanged (NFR-09)
        else Payment succeeds
            Pay-->>UI: Return with success status and txRef
            UI->>PayAPI: Verify payment by txRef
            PayAPI->>Pay: Verify amount, reference and currency
            Pay-->>PayAPI: Confirmed payment details
            alt Reference, currency or amount does not match the order
                PayAPI-->>UI: Reject confirmation
                UI-->>Customer: Show support message; no ticket issued (NFR-09)
            else Verified payment
                loop Once per seat in the order
                    UI->>TicketAPI: POST /tickets/purchase { eventId, ticketTypeId }
                    TicketAPI->>DB: Lock ticket type row and find an unassigned ISSUED ticket
                    alt No ticket available or sales are closed
                        DB-->>TicketAPI: No stock
                        TicketAPI-->>UI: 400 sold out / sales closed
                        UI->>UI: Stop claiming more seats
                    else Ticket available
                        TicketAPI->>DB: Assign ticket to customer and increment quantity_sold (FR-14)
                        TicketAPI-->>UI: ticketNumber + QR code containing qrToken
                        UI->>UI: Save issued ticket locally for confirmation and My Tickets
                    end
                end
                alt All seats issued
                    UI-->>Customer: Confirm purchase and show digital ticket + QR (FR-12)
                    TicketAPI->>DB: Sales and attendance data updated (FR-35, FR-37)
                else Some seats issued
                    UI-->>Customer: Show purchased tickets and list the seats that failed
                    Note over UI,Customer: Payment succeeded, so support/refund is needed for the missing seats.
                else No seats issued
                    UI-->>Customer: Show failure and support message; no ticket was issued
                end
            end
        end
    end
```

## Activity diagram: payment success versus failure, all branches

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A([Organizer sets ticket price and event capacity]) --> B[Customer selects an active ticket type and quantity]
    B --> C{Enough tickets remaining?}
    C -- No --> C1[Block the purchase and show sold out / lower quantity]
    C1 --> Z([End: no order, no ticket issued])
    C -- Yes --> D[Show price before confirming including service fee]
    D --> E{Customer confirms the order?}
    E -- No --> Z
    E -- Yes --> F[Create pending order and start PayChangu payment]

    F --> G{Payment status from PayChangu}
    G -- Failed or cancelled --> H[Verify payment]
    G -- Pending or processing --> H
    H --> H1[No ticket claim is attempted]
    H1 --> H2[Cancel or release the pending order]
    H2 --> H3[Show failure / retry message]
    H3 --> Z

    G -- Success --> I[Verify txRef, amount, currency and order match]
    I --> J{Confirmation valid?}
    J -- No --> J1[Do not issue a ticket]
    J1 --> J2[Show support message for the charged payment]
    J2 --> Z

    J -- Yes --> K[Claim one backend ticket per seat]
    K --> L{Were all seats claimed?}
    L -- No, none --> L1[No ticket issued]
    L1 --> L2[Show failure and support/refund message]
    L2 --> Z

    L -- No, some --> M1[Keep the tickets that were issued]
    M1 --> M2[Show which seats were bought and which failed]
    M2 --> M3[Offer retry for the missing seats or contact support]
    M3 --> Z

    L -- Yes --> N[Persist the issued tickets and show the QR confirmation]
    N --> O[Availability and sales totals reflect the purchase]
    O --> P[Organizer can view tickets sold, performance and revenue]
    P --> Z
```

## Requirement traceability

| Requirement | Where it is covered |
| --- | --- |
| `FR-09` Select an available ticket | Customer chooses an active ticket type with remaining stock; the backend re-checks stock when claiming. |
| `FR-10` Show price before confirming | Price, quantity, service fee and total are shown before the customer confirms. |
| `FR-11` Purchase a ticket | Confirmed, verified payment triggers one backend claim per seat. |
| `FR-12` Confirm successful purchase | The confirmation page shows issued tickets and their QR images. |
| `FR-13` Block purchase at capacity | The remaining-quantity check blocks the purchase before payment; the backend also refuses a claim when no ticket is available. |
| `FR-14` Update availability after purchase | The backend increments `quantity_sold` when it claims a ticket; the UI refreshes events and tickets after success. |
| `FR-32` Organizer sets/updates ticket prices | Organizer ticket-type management supplies the price used throughout checkout. |
| `FR-33` Organizer sets max tickets for event | Event capacity and ticket-type quantity limit what can be claimed. |
| `FR-35` Organizer views tickets sold | Issued tickets and ticket-type sales are visible in organizer reporting. |
| `FR-37` Organizer sees performance and revenue | Confirmed purchases feed the organizer sales and revenue views. |
| `NFR-06` Price on selection and confirmation | Both the checkout selection screen and the confirmation flow display the amount. |
| `NFR-09` Never oversell; ticket only after confirmed purchase | No ticket is claimed before payment verification; the backend locks stock during the claim and refuses exhausted ticket types. |

FILE: ./event_ticket_booking_schema.sql

-- Ticket Master PostgreSQL schema for backend image alicekayla/ticket-backend:1.3
-- Run against a new, empty database:
--   docker exec -i ticket-db psql -U postgres -d ticket_master < event_ticket_booking_schema.sql
--
-- The backend uses synchronize=false and migrationsRun=false. This file combines the
-- legacy event/ticket schema with the tracked TypeORM migrations for orders, payments
-- and organizer staff.

BEGIN;

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto";

CREATE TABLE users (
  user_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  full_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ATTENDEE'
    CHECK (role IN ('ATTENDEE', 'ORGANIZER', 'CHECK_IN_STAFF', 'ADMIN')),
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE venues (
  venue_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  venue_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  address VARCHAR(255),
  city VARCHAR(100),
  country VARCHAR(100),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE events (
  event_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  organizer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  category VARCHAR(100),
  banner_url TEXT,
  event_type VARCHAR(50),
  venue_id BIGINT,
  venue VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  location VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  start_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  end_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  capacity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (capacity > 0),
  tickets_issued INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tickets_issued >= 0),
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT'
    CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED', 'CANCELLED')),
  published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT fk_events_organizer
    FOREIGN KEY (organizer_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT fk_events_venue
    FOREIGN KEY (venue_id) REFERENCES venues(venue_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT chk_events_dates CHECK (end_at > start_at),
  CONSTRAINT chk_events_issued_capacity CHECK (tickets_issued <= capacity)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_events_organizer ON events(organizer_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_public ON events(status, start_at) WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED';
CREATE INDEX idx_events_venue ON events(venue_id);

CREATE TABLE ticket_types (
  ticket_type_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  type_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  price NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (price >= 0),
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MWK',
  quantity_total INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_total >= 0),
  quantity_sold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_sold >= 0),
  quantity_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity_reserved >= 0),
  per_order_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10 CHECK (per_order_limit > 0),
  sales_start_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  sales_end_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT fk_ticket_types_event
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT uq_ticket_types_event_name UNIQUE (event_id, type_name),
  CONSTRAINT chk_ticket_types_committed
    CHECK (quantity_sold + quantity_reserved <= quantity_total),
  CONSTRAINT chk_ticket_types_sales_period
    CHECK (sales_start_at IS NULL OR sales_end_at IS NULL OR sales_end_at > sales_start_at)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_ticket_types_event ON ticket_types(event_id, ticket_type_id);

CREATE TABLE tickets (
  ticket_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  ticket_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  event_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  ticket_type_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  customer_id BIGINT,
  qr_token UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ISSUED'
    CHECK (status IN ('ISSUED', 'USED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED')),
  issued_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  checked_in_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  order_item_id BIGINT,
  purchased_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  payment_tx_ref VARCHAR(100),

  CONSTRAINT fk_tickets_event
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT fk_tickets_ticket_type
    FOREIGN KEY (ticket_type_id) REFERENCES ticket_types(ticket_type_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT fk_tickets_customer
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_event ON tickets(event_id, ticket_type_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_customer ON tickets(customer_id, purchased_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_qr_token ON tickets(qr_token);
CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_payment_tx_ref
  ON tickets(payment_tx_ref) WHERE payment_tx_ref IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE ticket_validations (
  validation_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  ticket_id BIGINT,
  checked_by BIGINT,
  attempted_event_id BIGINT,
  result VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (result IN ('ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED')),
  reason VARCHAR(50),
  validated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT fk_ticket_validations_ticket
    FOREIGN KEY (ticket_id) REFERENCES tickets(ticket_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT fk_ticket_validations_staff
    FOREIGN KEY (checked_by) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT fk_ticket_validations_event
    FOREIGN KEY (attempted_event_id) REFERENCES events(event_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT ticket_validations_result_reason_check CHECK (
    (result = 'ACCEPTED' AND reason IS NULL)
    OR (result = 'REJECTED' AND reason IN (
      'NOT_FOUND', 'ALREADY_USED', 'CANCELLED', 'WRONG_EVENT',
      'EVENT_CANCELLED', 'NOT_ASSIGNED'
    ))
  )
);

CREATE INDEX idx_ticket_validations_ticket ON ticket_validations(ticket_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_ticket_validations_staff ON ticket_validations(checked_by, validated_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE organizer_staff (
  staff_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY
    REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  organizer_id BIGINT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX idx_organizer_staff_organizer ON organizer_staff(organizer_id);

CREATE TABLE staff_event_assignments (
  staff_id BIGINT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES organizer_staff(staff_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  event_id BIGINT NOT NULL
    REFERENCES events(event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  assigned_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (staff_id, event_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_staff_assignments_event ON staff_event_assignments(event_id);

CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  event_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  total_amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount >= 0),
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MWK',
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'
    CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')),
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT fk_orders_customer
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT fk_orders_event
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_event ON orders(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_pending_expiry ON orders(expires_at) WHERE status = 'PENDING';

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  order_item_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  ticket_type_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  unit_price NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
  subtotal NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (subtotal >= 0),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT fk_order_items_order
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT fk_order_items_ticket_type
    FOREIGN KEY (ticket_type_id) REFERENCES ticket_types(ticket_type_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT uq_order_items_order_ticket_type UNIQUE (order_id, ticket_type_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_ticket_type ON order_items(ticket_type_id);

ALTER TABLE tickets
  ADD CONSTRAINT fk_tickets_order_items
  FOREIGN KEY (order_item_id) REFERENCES order_items(order_item_id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX idx_tickets_order_item_id ON tickets(order_item_id);

CREATE TABLE payments (
  payment_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  tx_ref VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  provider_reference VARCHAR(150),
  amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0),
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MWK',
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'
    CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')),
  checkout_url TEXT,
  failure_reason TEXT,
  provider_metadata JSONB,
  verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT fk_payments_order
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE INDEX idx_payments_order ON payments(order_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_payments_provider_reference
  ON payments(provider_reference) WHERE provider_reference IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE ticket_payment_claims (
  tx_ref VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  event_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  ticket_type_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0),
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MWK',
  provider_reference VARCHAR(150),
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUCCESS',
  tickets_claimed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tickets_claimed >= 0),
  verified_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT fk_payment_claims_customer
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT fk_payment_claims_event
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT fk_payment_claims_ticket_type
    FOREIGN KEY (ticket_type_id) REFERENCES ticket_types(ticket_type_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE INDEX idx_payment_claims_customer ON ticket_payment_claims(customer_id);

COMMIT;

import { useState } from 'react'
import { DollarSign, Ban, ShieldAlert, Ticket } from 'lucide-react'
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { fetchPublishedEvents } from '../../../lib/backendEvents'
import { cancelOrganizerEvent } from '../../../lib/backendOrganizer'
import { useAuth } from '../../authentication'
import { useToast } from '../../toast'
import { ConfirmDialog } from '../../../components/ConfirmDialog'
import { StatCard } from '../../organizer/components/StatCard'
import { UserManagement } from '../components/UserManagement'
import type { StoredEvent } from '../../../types/event'

type Tab = 'events' | 'users'

const tabClass = (active: boolean) =>
  `pb-3 font-semibold text-sm ${active ? 'border-b-2 border-navy text-navy' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'}`

export function AdminDashboardPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const { showToast } = useToast()
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<Tab>('events')
  const [cancelling, setCancelling] = useState<StoredEvent | null>(null)

  const { data: events = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['events', 'admin'],
    queryFn: fetchPublishedEvents,
    enabled: user?.role === 'admin',
  })

  if (user?.role !== 'admin') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 pb-16 pt-20">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl px-4 text-center">
          <ShieldAlert className="mx-auto mb-4 text-red-600" size={40} />
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-navy-dark">Access denied</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-slate-600">
            This area is for administrators only. Sign in with an administrator account to continue.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const ticketsSold = events.reduce((sum, event) => sum + event.ticketTypes.reduce((s, type) => s + type.sold, 0), 0)
  const revenue = events.reduce(
    (sum, event) => sum + event.ticketTypes.reduce((s, type) => s + type.sold * type.price, 0),
    0,
  )

  async function cancelEvent(event: StoredEvent) {
    try {
      await cancelOrganizerEvent(event.id)
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events'] })
      showToast('Event cancelled', 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not cancel the event', 'error')
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 pb-16 pt-20">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6">
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold sm:text-4xl text-navy-dark">Admin Control Center</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-slate-600">Moderate published events and manage user accounts.</p>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-8 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <StatCard title="Ticket revenue (published events)" value={`MK ${revenue.toLocaleString()}`} icon={<DollarSign />} />
          <StatCard title="Published events" value={events.length.toString()} icon={<ShieldAlert />} />
          <StatCard title="Tickets sold" value={ticketsSold.toLocaleString()} icon={<Ticket />} />
        </div>

        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-2 border-b border-slate-200">
          <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('events')} className={tabClass(activeTab === 'events')}>Event Moderation</button>
          <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('users')} className={tabClass(activeTab === 'users')}>User Management</button>
        </div>

        {activeTab === 'users' && <UserManagement />}

        {activeTab === 'events' && (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8">
            <h2 className="mb-4 text-xl font-bold text-navy-dark">Event Moderation</h2>
            {error && (
              <p role="alert" className="mb-4 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">
                {error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load events.'}
              </p>
            )}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-slate-600">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-xs uppercase text-slate-500">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="rounded-tl-lg px-4 py-3">Event Name</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Organizer</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Date</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3">Sold</th>
                    <th className="rounded-tr-lg px-4 py-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {isLoading && (
                    <tr><td colSpan={5} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-slate-500">Loading eventsâ€¦</td></tr>
                  )}
                  {!isLoading && events.length === 0 && (
                    <tr><td colSpan={5} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-slate-500">No published events.</td></tr>
                  )}
                  {events.map((event) => {
                    const sold = event.ticketTypes.reduce((sum, type) => sum + type.sold, 0)
                    const capacity = event.ticketTypes.reduce((sum, type) => sum + type.capacity, 0)
                    return (
                      <tr key={event.id} className="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0 hover:bg-slate-50">
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-navy-dark">{event.title}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">{event.organizer || '-'}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">{event.date}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">{sold} / {capacity}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setCancelling(event)}
                            className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-red-700"
                          >
                            <Ban size={14} /> Cancel event
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={!!cancelling}
        onClose={() => setCancelling(null)}
        onConfirm={() => cancelling && void cancelEvent(cancelling)}
        title="Cancel this event?"
        description={`"${cancelling?.title ?? ''}" will be cancelled and removed from the public list. This cannot be undone.`}
        confirmLabel="Cancel event"
        variant="danger"
      />
    </div>
  )
}

import { API, api } from './backend'
import type { StoredEvent, TicketType } from '../types/event'

// Published events from the backend, converted to the shape the pages already use.
const KNOWN_CITIES = ['Lilongwe', 'Blantyre', 'Mzuzu', 'Zomba', 'Mangochi', 'Salima']
// Bundled pictures an organizer can pick instead of uploading their own.
export const DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES = [
  '/images/events/event-1.webp',
  '/images/events/event-2.jpg',
  '/images/events/event-3.webp',
]

// The image of an event: the organizer's upload, a chosen default, or (when nothing was
// chosen) one of the defaults picked from the event id.
export function resolveEventImage(imageUrl: string | null | undefined, eventId: string): string {
  if (imageUrl) {
    // uploads live on the backend, which the browser reaches through the /be proxy
    return imageUrl.startsWith('/uploads/') ? `${API}${imageUrl}` : imageUrl
  }
  let hash = 0
  for (const char of eventId) hash = (hash * 31 + char.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0
  return DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES[hash % DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES.length]
}

interface BackendEvent {
  id: string
  title: string
  description: string
  venue: string
  location: string
  startAt: string
  status?: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'CANCELLED'
  category?: string | null
  imageUrl?: string | null
  organizerName?: string | null
}

interface BackendTicketType {
  ticketTypeId: string
  name: string
  price: number | string
  quantity: number
  remaining: number
}

interface Page {
  data: BackendEvent[]
  meta: { totalPages: number }
}

function toTicketType(type: BackendTicketType): TicketType {
  return {
    id: String(type.ticketTypeId),
    name: type.name,
    price: Number(type.price),
    capacity: type.quantity,
    sold: Math.max(0, type.quantity - type.remaining),
  }
}

function toStoredEvent(event: BackendEvent, ticketTypes: BackendTicketType[]): StoredEvent {
  const start = new Date(event.startAt)
  const location = event.location ?? ''
  return {
    id: String(event.id),
    title: event.title,
    description: event.description,
    category: event.category ?? '',
    city: KNOWN_CITIES.find((city) => location.toLowerCase().includes(city.toLowerCase())) ?? location,
    venue: event.venue,
    date: start.toLocaleDateString('en-CA'),
    time: start.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
    organizer: event.organizerName ?? '',
    image: resolveEventImage(event.imageUrl, String(event.id)),
    status: event.status === 'DRAFT' ? 'Draft' : event.status === 'CANCELLED' ? 'Cancelled' : 'Published',
    ticketTypes: ticketTypes.map(toTicketType),
  }
}

// All published events with their ticket types.
export async function fetchPublishedEvents(): Promise<StoredEvent[]> {
  const events: BackendEvent[] = []
  let page = 1
  let totalPages = 1
  do {
    const result = await api<Page>(`/events?page=${page}&limit=50`)
    events.push(...result.data)
    totalPages = result.meta.totalPages
    page += 1
  } while (page <= totalPages)

  return Promise.all(
    events.map(async (event) => toStoredEvent(event, await api<BackendTicketType[]>(`/events/${event.id}/ticket-types`))),
  )
}

export async function fetchBackendEvent(eventId: string): Promise<StoredEvent> {
  const event = await api<BackendEvent>(`/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}`)
  const ticketTypes = await api<BackendTicketType[]>(`/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}/ticket-types`)
  return toStoredEvent(event, ticketTypes)
}

import { API, api } from './backend'
import type { StoredEvent, TicketType } from '../types/event'

// Published events from the backend, converted to the shape the pages already use.
const KNOWN_CITIES = ['Lilongwe', 'Blantyre', 'Mzuzu', 'Zomba', 'Mangochi', 'Salima']
// Bundled pictures an organizer can pick instead of uploading their own.

function cleanId(value: unknown): string {
  // If your backend uses UUIDs, comment out this line and return String(value)
  const numeric = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isInteger(numeric) || numeric <= 0) {
    console.warn('[event] backend returned a non-numeric id:', value);
    return "";
  }
  return String(numeric);
}

export const DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES = [
  '/images/events/event-1.webp',
  '/images/events/event-2.jpg',
  '/images/events/event-3.webp',
]

// The image of an event: the organizer's upload, a chosen default, or (when nothing was
// chosen) one of the defaults picked from the event id.
export function resolveEventImage(imageUrl: string | null | undefined, eventId: string): string {
  if (imageUrl) {
    // uploads live on the backend, which the browser reaches through the /be proxy
    return imageUrl.startsWith('/uploads/') ? `${API}${imageUrl}` : imageUrl
  }
  let hash = 0
  for (const char of eventId) hash = (hash * 31 + char.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0
  return DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES[hash % DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES.length]
}

interface BackendEvent {
  id: string
  title: string
  description: string
  venue: string
  location: string
  startAt: string
  status?: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'CANCELLED'
  category?: string | null
  imageUrl?: string | null
  organizerName?: string | null
}

interface BackendTicketType {
  ticketTypeId: string
  name: string
  price: number | string
  quantity: number
  remaining: number
}

interface Page {
  data: BackendEvent[]
  meta: { totalPages: number }
}

function toTicketType(type: BackendTicketType): TicketType {
  return {
    id: String(type.ticketTypeId),
    name: type.name,
    price: Number(type.price),
    capacity: type.quantity,
    sold: Math.max(0, type.quantity - type.remaining),
  }
}

function toStoredEvent(event: BackendEvent, ticketTypes: BackendTicketType[]): StoredEvent {
  const start = new Date(event.startAt)
  const location = event.location ?? ''
  return {
    id: cleanId(event.id),
    title: event.title,
    description: event.description,
    category: event.category ?? '',
    city: KNOWN_CITIES.find((city) => location.toLowerCase().includes(city.toLowerCase())) ?? location,
    venue: event.venue,
    date: start.toLocaleDateString('en-CA'),
    time: start.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
    organizer: event.organizerName ?? '',
    image: resolveEventImage(event.imageUrl, String(event.id)),
    status: event.status === 'DRAFT' ? 'Draft' : event.status === 'CANCELLED' ? 'Cancelled' : 'Published',
    ticketTypes: ticketTypes.map(toTicketType),
  }
}

// All published events with their ticket types.
export async function fetchPublishedEvents(): Promise<StoredEvent[]> {
  const events: BackendEvent[] = []
  let page = 1
  let totalPages = 1
  do {
    const result = await api<Page>(`/events?page=${page}&limit=50`)
    events.push(...result.data)
    totalPages = result.meta.totalPages
    page += 1
  } while (page <= totalPages)

  return Promise.all(
    events.map(async (event) => toStoredEvent(event, await api<BackendTicketType[]>(`/events/${event.id}/ticket-types`))),
  ).then((results) => results.filter((e) => e.id !== ""))
}

export async function fetchBackendEvent(eventId: string): Promise<StoredEvent> {
  const event = await api<BackendEvent>(`/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}`)
  const ticketTypes = await api<BackendTicketType[]>(`/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}/ticket-types`)
  return toStoredEvent(event, ticketTypes)
}

FILE: ./.fix-backup/backendOrganizer.ts.1794308153

import { API, api, getToken } from './backend'
import { resolveEventImage } from './backendEvents'
import type { EventItem } from '../features/organizer/Data/Events'

// Organizer side of the backend: create, publish, cancel and list the organizer's own events.

export interface NewTicketType {
  name: string
  price: number
  quantity: number
  perOrderLimit?: number
}

export interface NewEventInput {
  name: string
  description: string
  venue: string
  location: string
  startAt: string // ISO date-time
  endAt: string // ISO date-time
  ticketTypes: NewTicketType[]
  status: 'Published' | 'Draft'
  imageUrl?: string // an uploaded image (/uploads/..), a bundled default, or nothing
}

interface BackendMyEvent {
  id: string
  title: string
  venue: string
  startAt: string
  status: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'CANCELLED'
  publishedAt?: string | null
  imageUrl?: string | null
}

interface MyEventsPage {
  data: BackendMyEvent[]
  meta: { totalPages: number }
}

interface SalesSummary {
  totals: { sold: number }
}

const STATUS: Record<BackendMyEvent['status'], EventItem['status']> = {
  DRAFT: 'Draft',
  PUBLISHED: 'Published',
  CANCELLED: 'Cancelled',
}

// "10 May 2026 â€¢ 19:00", the same style the dashboard table already shows
export function formatEventDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso
  const day = date.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
  const time = date.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
  return `${day} â€¢ ${time}`
}

// The backend wants the total capacity as well. It is simply the sum of the ticket types.
export function totalCapacity(ticketTypes: NewTicketType[]): number {
  return ticketTypes.reduce((sum, type) => sum + type.quantity, 0)
}

async function soldFor(eventId: string): Promise<number> {
  const summary = await api<SalesSummary>(`/events/${eventId}/sales-summary`)
  return summary.totals.sold
}

// Every event of the logged-in organizer, in all statuses, with tickets sold.
export async function listMyEvents(): Promise<EventItem[]> {
  const events: BackendMyEvent[] = []
  let page = 1
  let totalPages = 1
  do {
    const result = await api<MyEventsPage>(`/events/mine?page=${page}&limit=50`)
    events.push(...result.data)
    totalPages = result.meta.totalPages
    page += 1
  } while (page <= totalPages)

  return Promise.all(
    events.map(async (event) => ({
      id: String(event.id),
      name: event.title,
      date: formatEventDate(event.startAt),
      venue: event.venue,
      ticketsSold: event.status === 'PUBLISHED' ? await soldFor(event.id) : 0,
      status: STATUS[event.status] ?? 'Draft',
      ...(event.status === 'CANCELLED'
        ? { restoreStatus: event.publishedAt ? 'Published' as const : 'Draft' as const }
        : {}),
      image: resolveEventImage(event.imageUrl, String(event.id)),
    })),
  )
}

export async function setOrganizerEventStatus(
  eventId: string,
  status: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'CANCELLED',
): Promise<void> {
  await api(`/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    body: { status },
  })
}

// Publishing makes the event public. Tickets only exist after "generate", so both run together.
// Generating again is safe: it only creates tickets that are still missing.
export async function publishEvent(eventId: string): Promise<void> {
  await api(`/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}/publish`, { method: 'POST' })
  try {
    await api(`/tickets/events/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}/generate`, { method: 'POST' })
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown error'
    throw new Error(`The event is published but its tickets could not be created (${reason}). Press Publish again to retry.`)
  }
}

export const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024

// Sends a picture to the backend and returns the path to save as the event's imageUrl.
export async function uploadEventImage(file: File): Promise<string> {
  if (!/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/.test(file.type)) throw new Error('Choose a JPG, PNG or WEBP image.')
  if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES) throw new Error('The image must be 5 MB or smaller.')

  const form = new FormData()
  form.append('file', file)
  const token = getToken()

  let response: Response
  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API}/events/images`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {},
      body: form,
    })
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Cannot reach the server. Is the backend running?')
  }

  let data: { imageUrl?: string; message?: string | string[] } | null = null
  try {
    data = await response.json()
  } catch {
    data = null
  }
  if (!response.ok || !data?.imageUrl) {
    const message = Array.isArray(data?.message) ? data.message.join('. ') : data?.message
    throw new Error(response.status >= 500 ? 'The image could not be uploaded. Try again.' : message || 'The image could not be uploaded.')
  }
  return data.imageUrl
}

export async function createOrganizerEvent(input: NewEventInput): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  const created = await api<{ id: string }>('/events', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: {
      title: input.name.trim(),
      description: input.description.trim(),
      venue: input.venue.trim(),
      location: input.location.trim(),
      startAt: input.startAt,
      endAt: input.endAt,
      ...(input.imageUrl ? { imageUrl: input.imageUrl } : {}),
      capacity: totalCapacity(input.ticketTypes),
      ticketTypes: input.ticketTypes.map((type) => ({
        name: type.name.trim(),
        price: type.price,
        currency: 'MWK',
        quantity: type.quantity,
        perOrderLimit: type.perOrderLimit ?? 10,
      })),
    },
  })
  if (input.status === 'Published') await publishEvent(created.id)
  return { id: String(created.id) }
}

}

import { API, api, getToken } from './backend'
import { resolveEventImage } from './backendEvents'
import type { EventItem } from '../features/organizer/Data/Events'

// Organizer side of the backend: create, publish, cancel and list the organizer's own events.

export interface NewTicketType {
  name: string
  price: number
  quantity: number
  perOrderLimit?: number
}

export interface NewEventInput {
  name: string
  description: string
  venue: string
  location: string
  startAt: string // ISO date-time
  endAt: string // ISO date-time
  ticketTypes: NewTicketType[]
  status: 'Published' | 'Draft'
  imageUrl?: string // an uploaded image (/uploads/..), a bundled default, or nothing
}

interface BackendMyEvent {
  id: string
  title: string
  venue: string
  startAt: string
  status: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'CANCELLED'
  publishedAt?: string | null
  imageUrl?: string | null
}

interface MyEventsPage {
  data: BackendMyEvent[]
  meta: { totalPages: number }
}

interface SalesSummary {
  totals: { sold: number }
}

const STATUS: Record<BackendMyEvent['status'], EventItem['status']> = {
  DRAFT: 'Draft',
  PUBLISHED: 'Published',
  CANCELLED: 'Cancelled',
}

// "10 May 2026 â€¢ 19:00", the same style the dashboard table already shows
export function formatEventDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso
  const day = date.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
  const time = date.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
  return `${day} â€¢ ${time}`
}

// The backend wants the total capacity as well. It is simply the sum of the ticket types.
export function totalCapacity(ticketTypes: NewTicketType[]): number {
  return ticketTypes.reduce((sum, type) => sum + type.quantity, 0)
}

async function soldFor(eventId: string): Promise<number> {
  if (!eventId) {
    console.warn('[soldFor] called with an empty or undefined eventId');
    return 0;
  }
  try {
    const summary = await api<SalesSummary>(`/events/${eventId}/sales-summary`)
    return summary.totals.sold ?? 0
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[soldFor] failed for event', eventId, error)
    return 0
  }
}

// Every event of the logged-in organizer, in all statuses, with tickets sold.
export async function listMyEvents(): Promise<EventItem[]> {
  const events: BackendMyEvent[] = []
  let page = 1
  let totalPages = 1
  do {
    const result = await api<MyEventsPage>(`/events/mine?page=${page}&limit=50`)
    events.push(...result.data)
    totalPages = result.meta.totalPages
    page += 1
  } while (page <= totalPages)

  return Promise.all(
    events.map(async (event) => ({
      id: String(event.id),
      name: event.title,
      date: formatEventDate(event.startAt),
      venue: event.venue,
      ticketsSold: event.status === 'PUBLISHED' ? await soldFor(event.id) : 0,
      status: STATUS[event.status] ?? 'Draft',
      ...(event.status === 'CANCELLED'
        ? { restoreStatus: event.publishedAt ? 'Published' as const : 'Draft' as const }
        : {}),
      image: resolveEventImage(event.imageUrl, String(event.id)),
    })),
  )
}

// Admin user management and organizer staff, served by the backend.

type BackendRole = 'ATTENDEE' | 'ORGANIZER' | 'CHECK_IN_STAFF' | 'ADMIN'

  ATTENDEE: 'customer',
  ORGANIZER: 'organizer',
  CHECK_IN_STAFF: 'staff',
  ADMIN: 'admin',
}

const TO_BACKEND: Record<Role, BackendRole> = {
  customer: 'ATTENDEE',
  organizer: 'ORGANIZER',
  staff: 'CHECK_IN_STAFF',
  admin: 'ADMIN',

  email: string

  createdAt: string

  name: string
  email: string
  role: BackendRole
  isActive: boolean
  createdAt: string
}

  data: BackendUser[]
  totalPages: number
}

  return {
    id: String(user.id),
    name: user.name,
    email: user.email,
    role: FROM_BACKEND[user.role] ?? 'customer',
    status: user.isActive ? 'active' : 'disabled',
    createdAt: user.createdAt,

// ---------- organizer staff ----------

export interface StaffMember {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  isActive: boolean
  createdAt: string
  assignedEventIds: string[]
}

interface RawStaffMember {
  id: string | number
  name: string
  email: string
  isActive?: boolean
  active?: boolean
  status?: string
  createdAt?: string
  created_at?: string
  assignedEventIds?: unknown
  eventIds?: unknown
  assignedEvents?: unknown
  events?: unknown
}

function normalizeIds(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return []
  return value
    .map((item) => {
      if (typeof item === 'string' || typeof item === 'number') return String(item)
      if (item && typeof item === 'object' && 'id' in item) {
        const id = (item as { id: unknown }).id
        if (typeof id === 'string' || typeof id === 'number') return String(id)
      }
      return null
    })
    .filter((id): id is string => id !== null)
}

function toStaffMember(raw: RawStaffMember): StaffMember {
  const ids = raw.assignedEventIds ?? raw.eventIds ?? raw.assignedEvents ?? raw.events
  const active =
    typeof raw.isActive === 'boolean'
      ? raw.isActive
      : typeof raw.active === 'boolean'
        ? raw.active
        : raw.status !== 'DISABLED' && raw.status !== 'INACTIVE'
  return {
    id: String(raw.id),
    name: raw.name,
    email: raw.email,
    isActive: active,
    createdAt: raw.createdAt ?? raw.created_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    assignedEventIds: normalizeIds(ids),
  }
}

export async function listMyStaff(): Promise<StaffMember[]> {
  const result = await api<unknown>('/organizers/me/staff')
  let list: unknown[] = []
  if (Array.isArray(result)) {
    list = result
  } else if (result && typeof result === 'object') {
    const maybe = (result as { data?: unknown }).data
    if (Array.isArray(maybe)) list = maybe
    else if (Array.isArray((result as { staff?: unknown }).staff)) list = (result as { staff: unknown[] }).staff
  }
  return list
    .filter((item): item is RawStaffMember => !!item && typeof item === 'object')
    .map(toStaffMember)
}

export function createMyStaff(input: { name: string; email: string; password: string }): Promise<unknown> {
  return api('/organizers/me/staff', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: { name: input.name.trim(), email: input.email.trim(), password: input.password },
  })
}

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Pause, Play } from 'lucide-react'
import { useEvents } from '../../events/hooks/useEvents'
import SearchBar from './SearchBar'
import type { Filters } from '../filters'
import { useAutoplay } from '../hooks/useAutoplay'

interface HeroSliderProps {
  filters: Filters
  setFilters: (f: Filters, options?: { replace?: boolean }) => void
  onShowAll?: (filters: Filters) => void
}

export default function HeroSlider({ filters, setFilters, onShowAll }: HeroSliderProps) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0)
  // The slides are the next published events from the backend. With none, one welcome slide is shown.
  const { data: events = [] } = useEvents()
  const heroSlides = events.length > 0
    ? events
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
        .slice(0, 5)
        .map((event) => ({
          image: event.image,
          title: event.title,
          text: [event.venue, event.date].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· '),
        }))
    : [{ image: '/images/hero/hero-1.png', title: 'Ticket Master', text: 'Discover events happening near you' }]
  const total = heroSlides.length

  const goTo = useCallback(
    (index: number) => setCurrent((index + total) % total),
    [total],
  )

  // Auto-advance stops on hover, keyboard focus, reduced motion, or when the
  // visitor presses pause (WCAG 2.2.2).
  const next = useCallback(() => goTo(current + 1), [goTo, current])
  const { paused, reducedMotion, togglePause, handlers } = useAutoplay(6000, next)

  const arrowStyle =
    'absolute top-1/2 z-10 hidden h-12 w-12 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-white/40 sm:flex'

  return (
    <section className="relative min-h-screen bg-navy-dark" {...handlers}>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden">
        {heroSlides.map((slide, i) => (
          <img
            key={slide.image}
            src={slide.image}
            alt={slide.title}
            aria-hidden={i !== current}
            className={`absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover transition-all duration-1500 motion-reduce:transition-none ${
              i === current ? 'scale-105 opacity-100' : 'scale-100 opacity-0'
            }`}
          />
        ))}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-b from-navy-dark/70 via-navy-dark/50 to-navy-dark/80" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-20 mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-5xl flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 pb-20 pt-28 text-center">
        <div key={current} className="fade-up">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-extrabold text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-7xl">
            {heroSlides[current % total].title}
          </h1>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-4 max-w-2xl text-base text-white/85 sm:text-xl">
            {heroSlides[current % total].text}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-10 w-full">
          <SearchBar filters={filters} setFilters={setFilters} onShowAll={onShowAll} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <button aria-label="Previous slide" onClick={() => goTo(current - 1)} className={`${arrowStyle} left-4`}>
        <ChevronLeft />
      </button>
      <button aria-label="Next slide" onClick={() => goTo(current + 1)} className={`${arrowStyle} right-4`}>
        <ChevronRight />
      </button>

      <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-0 right-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
        {!reducedMotion && (
          <button
            aria-label={paused ? 'Resume hero slideshow' : 'Pause hero slideshow'}
            onClick={togglePause}
            className="mr-2 flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-white/40"
          >
            {paused ? <Play size={14} /> : <Pause size={14} />}
          </button>
        )}
        {heroSlides.map((_, i) => (
          <button
            key={i}
            aria-label={`Slide ${i + 1}`}
            onClick={() => setCurrent(i)}
            className={`h-2 rounded-full transition-all ${i === current ? 'w-8 bg-white' : 'w-2 bg-white/50'}`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
