function initials(name: string | undefined): string {
  return name?.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 2).map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase()).join('') || 'OR';
}

export const OrganizerDashboardPage: React.FC = () => {
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<'events' | 'staff' | 'attendees' | 'create'>('events');

  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { events, totalEvents, publishedCount, draftCount, totalTickets, search: evSearch, setSearch: setEvSearch, filterStatus, setFilterStatus, addEvent, publishEvent, cancelEvent, restoreEvent, loading: evLoading, loadError: evError } = useEvents();
  const {
    attendees, totalAttendees, checkedInCount,
    search: atSearch, setSearch: setAtSearch,
    eventId: atEventId, setEventId: setAtEventId,
    ticketType: atTicketType, setTicketType: setAtTicketType,
    eventOptions, ticketTypeOptions, loading: attendeeLoading, error: attendeeError,
  } = useAttendees();

  // Throws when the backend refuses, so the form can show the message and stay open.
  const handleEventFormSubmission = async (newEvent: NewEventInput) => {
    await addEvent(newEvent);
    setCurrentTab('events');
  };

  return (
    <div className="dashboard-root">
      {/* Sidebar Architecture Layout */}
      <aside className="dashboard-sidebar">
        <div className="sidebar-brand">
          <div className="brand-logo">Tic-EM</div>
          <div className="brand-info">
            <span className="panel-title">Organizer</span>
            <span className="panel-subtitle">Dashboard</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="user-profile-badge">
          <div className="avatar-placeholder">{initials(user?.name)}</div>
          <div className="user-details">
            <span className="user-name">{user?.name ?? 'Organizer'}</span>
            <span className="user-role">Organizer â–¼</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <nav className="sidebar-nav">
          <button className={`nav-link-btn ${currentTab === 'events' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setCurrentTab('events')}>
            <CalendarDays size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> My Events
          </button>
          <button className={`nav-link-btn ${currentTab === 'create' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setCurrentTab('create')}>
            <Plus size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> Create Event
          </button>
          <button className={`nav-link-btn ${currentTab === 'staff' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setCurrentTab('staff')}>
            <Users size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> Staff Roster
          </button>
          <button className={`nav-link-btn ${currentTab === 'attendees' ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setCurrentTab('attendees')}>
            <Ticket size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> Attendees
          </button>
        </nav>
      </aside>

      {/* Main Core View Area */}
      <main className="dashboard-viewport">
        {currentTab === 'create' ? (
          <CreateEventPage onEventCreated={handleEventFormSubmission} onCancel={() => setCurrentTab('events')} />
        ) : (
          <div className="page-content-wrapper">
            
            {/* Context Dependent Metric Row Blocks */}
            {currentTab === 'events' && (
              <>
                <div className="content-header">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="view-title">My Events</h2>
                    <p className="view-subtitle">Manage and track your active performance profiles.</p>
                  </div>
                  <button className="btn-primary-header" onClick={() => setCurrentTab('create')}>+ Create Event</button>
                </div>
                <div className="metrics-grid">
                  <StatCard title="Total Events" value={totalEvents} icon="ğŸ“Š" color="#3b82f6" />
                  <StatCard title="Published" value={publishedCount} icon="âœ…" color="#10b981" />
                  <StatCard title="Draft" value={draftCount} icon="ğŸ•’" color="#64748b" />
                  <StatCard title="Total Tickets Sold" value={totalTickets.toLocaleString()} icon="ğŸ“ˆ" color="#f59e0b" />
                </div>
                <div className="filter-toolbar">
                  <SearchBar value={evSearch} onChange={setEvSearch} placeholder="Search events by profile name or venue location..." />
                  <select className="toolbar-dropdown" value={filterStatus} onChange={(e) => setFilterStatus(e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="All">All Statuses</option>
                    <option value="Published">Published Only</option>
                    <option value="Draft">Drafts Only</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                {evError && <div className="form-error-banner">{evError}</div>}
                {evLoading ? <p className="view-subtitle">Loading your events...</p> : <EventTable events={events} onPublish={publishEvent} onCancel={cancelEvent} onRestore={restoreEvent} />}
              </>
            )}

            {currentTab === 'staff' && (
              <>
                <div className="content-header">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="view-title">My Staff Roster</h2>
                    <p className="view-subtitle">Manage your staff and the events they are allowed to scan.</p>
                  </div>
                  <Link to="/organizer/staff" className="btn-primary-header">Create or manage staff</Link>
                </div>
                <StaffRoster />
              </>
            )}

            {currentTab === 'attendees' && (
              <>
                <div className="content-header">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="view-title">Customers &amp; Purchases</h2>
                    <p className="view-subtitle">Track ticket sales and customers across your events.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="metrics-grid">
                  <StatCard title="Total Attendees" value={totalAttendees} icon="ğŸŸï¸" color="#3b82f6" />
                  <StatCard title="Checked In" value={checkedInCount} icon="âœ“" color="#10b981" />
                  <StatCard title="Attendance Rate" value={`${Math.round((checkedInCount / (totalAttendees || 1)) * 100)}%`} icon="ğŸ“Š" color="#a855f7" />
                </div>
                <div className="filter-toolbar">
                  <SearchBar value={atSearch} onChange={setAtSearch} placeholder="Search by customer, email, event or ticket..." />
                  <select className="toolbar-dropdown" value={atEventId} onChange={(e) => setAtEventId(e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="all">All Events</option>
                    {eventOptions.map((event) => (
                      <option key={event.id} value={event.id}>{event.title}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <select className="toolbar-dropdown" value={atTicketType} onChange={(e) => setAtTicketType(e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="all">All Ticket Types</option>
                    {ticketTypeOptions.map((type) => (
                      <option key={type} value={type}>{type}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="split-view-layout">
                  <div className="split-table-side">
                    {attendeeLoading
                      ? <p className="view-subtitle">Loading ticket purchases...</p>
                      : attendeeError
                        ? <div role="alert" className="form-error-banner">{attendeeError}</div>
                        : <AttendeeTable attendees={attendees} />}
                  </div>
                  <div className="split-analytics-side">
                    <SalesChart events={events} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </>
            )}

          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
};

import { createRootRoute, createRoute, createRouter } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { AppLayout } from '../components/AppLayout';
import { LoginPage, requireAuth } from '../features/authentication';
import { EventsPage, EventDetailsPage } from '../features/events';
import { CheckoutPage, PaymentReturnPage } from '../features/checkout';
import { MyTicketsPage, BookingHistoryPage, TicketDetailPage } from '../features/tickets';
import { ScannerPage } from '../features/validation';
import { OrganizerDashboardPage, CreateEventPage, StaffManagementPage } from '../features/organizer';
import { OrganizerKycPage } from '../features/organizer/pages/OrganizerKycPage';
import { AdminDashboardPage } from '../features/admin/pages/AdminDashboardPage';
import { HomePage } from '../features/landing'
import { validateEventSearch } from '../features/landing/filters';
import NotFoundPage from '../components/NotFoundPage';
import type { ComponentType } from 'react';

const rootRoute = createRootRoute({ component: AppLayout });

const page = <P extends string>(path: P, component: ComponentType<any>, beforeLoad?: ReturnType<typeof requireAuth>) => createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => rootRoute, path, component: component as any, beforeLoad });

const indexRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/',
  component: HomePage,
  validateSearch: validateEventSearch,
});
const eventsRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/events',
  component: EventsPage,
  validateSearch: validateEventSearch,
});
const loginRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  path: '/login',
  component: LoginPage,
  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): { redirect?: string } => ({ redirect: typeof search.redirect === 'string' ? search.redirect : undefined }),
});
const notFoundRoute = createRoute({ getParentRoute: () => rootRoute, path: '*', component: NotFoundPage })

const routeTree = rootRoute.addChildren([
  indexRoute,
  loginRoute,
  eventsRoute,
  page('/events/$eventId', EventDetailsPage),
  page('/checkout/return', PaymentReturnPage, requireAuth('customer')), // PayChangu sends customers back here
  page('/checkout/$eventId', CheckoutPage, requireAuth('customer')),
  page('/tickets', MyTicketsPage, requireAuth('customer')),         // <-- Added base tickets route
  page('/tickets/$ticketId', TicketDetailPage, requireAuth('customer')), // <-- Kept specific route
  page('/bookings', BookingHistoryPage, requireAuth('customer')),
  page('/organizer/kyc', OrganizerKycPage, requireAuth('organizer')),
  page('/organizer/dashboard', OrganizerDashboardPage, requireAuth('organizer')),
  page('/organizer/events/new', CreateEventPage, requireAuth('organizer')),
  page('/organizer/events/$eventId/edit', CreateEventPage, requireAuth('organizer')),
  page('/organizer/staff', StaffManagementPage, requireAuth('organizer')),
  page('/admin', AdminDashboardPage, requireAuth('admin')),
  page('/scan', ScannerPage, requireAuth('staff')),
  notFoundRoute,
]);

export const router = createRouter({ routeTree });

declare module '@tanstack/react-router' {
  interface Register { router: typeof router; }
}

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { FormEvent, ReactNode } from 'react'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import type { TicketValidationResult } from '../../../lib/tickets'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { listMyAssignedEvents } from '../../../lib/backendUsers'
import { ScanResult } from '../components/ScanResult'
import { useQrScanner } from '../hooks/useQrScanner'
import { validateTicket } from '../hooks/useTicketValidator'

export function ScannerPage(): ReactNode {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<TicketValidationResult | null>(null)
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<TicketValidationResult[]>([])
  const [manualCode, setManualCode] = useState('')
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false)
  const checkingRef = useRef(false)
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  // only the events the organizer assigned to this staff account
  const { data: events = [], isLoading: loadingEvents } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['staff-assigned-events'],
    queryFn: listMyAssignedEvents,
  })
  const [selectedEventId, setSelectedEventId] = useState(events[0]?.id ?? '')
  const selectedEvent = events.find((e) => e.id === selectedEventId) ?? events[0]
  const activeEventId = selectedEvent?.id ?? ''

  const handleCode = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const outcome = await (async (): Promise<TicketValidationResult> => {
        if (!activeEventId) {
          return {
            status: 'invalid',
            title: 'No event selected',
            message: 'Choose the event you are checking tickets for.',
          }
        }
        try {
          return await validateTicket(rawCode, activeEventId)
        } catch (caught) {
          return {
            status: 'invalid',
            title: 'Could not check ticket',
            message: caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'The ticket could not be checked. Try again.',
          }
        }
      })()

      setResult(outcome)
      setHistory((previous) => [outcome, ...previous].slice(0, 6))
      setManualCode('')
      if (outcome.status === 'valid') {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['event-stats'] })
      }
    },
    [queryClient, activeEventId],
  )

  const checkCode = useCallback(
    (rawCode: string) => {
      if (checkingRef.current) return
      checkingRef.current = true
      setChecking(true)
      void handleCode(rawCode).finally(() => {
        checkingRef.current = false
        setChecking(false)
      })
    },
    [handleCode],
  )

  const { videoRef, status, error, start, stop } = useQrScanner(checkCode)

  function handleManualSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault()
    checkCode(manualCode)
  }

  const checkedIn = history.filter((item) => item.status === 'valid').length

  const scanning = status === 'scanning'

  if (!selectedEvent && loadingEvents) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
        <div className="alert info" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>Loading eventsâ€¦</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (!selectedEvent) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
        <div className="alert info" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
          No events are assigned to you yet. Ask your organizer to assign you to an event.
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="row">
        <div>
          <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
          <p className="m">{selectedEvent.venue}</p>
          <label className="m" style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 8 }}>
            Event gate
            <select
              className="in"
              style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
              value={selectedEvent.id}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setSelectedEventId(event.target.value)
                setResult(null)
                setHistory([])
              }}
            >
              {events.map((event) => (
                <option key={event.id} value={event.id}>
                  {event.title}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="card stat" style={{ minWidth: 160 }}>
          <span className="m">Checked in this session</span>
          <b>{checkedIn}</b>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="split" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <div className="g">
          <div className="cam">
            <video ref={videoRef} playsInline muted className="cam-video" />
            {!scanning && (
              <div className="cam-hint">
                <div className="cam-frame" />
                <p>Point the camera at a ticket QR code to validate it.</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
            {scanning ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn o" onClick={stop}>
                Stop camera
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn"
                onClick={start}
                disabled={status === 'starting' || checking}
              >
                {status === 'starting' ? 'Starting cameraâ€¦' : 'Start camera'}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {error && <div className="alert error">{error}</div>}

          <form className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }} onSubmit={handleManualSubmit}>
            <input
              className="in"
              style={{ margin: 0 }}
              placeholder="Paste or scan the ticket QR token"
              value={manualCode}
              onChange={(event) => setManualCode(event.target.value)}
            />
            <button type="submit" className="btn" disabled={!manualCode.trim() || checking}>
              {checking ? 'Checkingâ€¦' : 'Validate'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="alert info">
            <>
              <b>Server-checked tickets</b>
              <p className="m">The backend records each scan, so a ticket is accepted only once.</p>
            </>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          {result ? (
            <ScanResult result={result} />
          ) : (
            <div className="alert info">Scan or enter a ticket to see the validation result.</div>
          )}

          <h4>Other results</h4>
          {history.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="m">No scans yet.</p>
          ) : (
            history.map((item, index) => (
              <ScanResult key={`${item.status}-${index}`} result={item} compact />
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { FormEvent, ReactNode } from 'react'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import type { TicketValidationResult } from '../../../lib/tickets'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { api } from '../../../lib/backend'
import { ScanResult } from '../components/ScanResult'
import { useQrScanner } from '../hooks/useQrScanner'
import { validateTicket } from '../hooks/useTicketValidator'

export function ScannerPage(): ReactNode {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<TicketValidationResult | null>(null)
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<TicketValidationResult[]>([])
  const [manualCode, setManualCode] = useState('')
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false)
  const checkingRef = useRef(false)
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  // only the events the organizer assigned to this staff account
  const { data: events = [], isLoading: loadingEvents, error: loadError } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['staff-assigned-events'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const result = await api<any>('/staff/me/events');
      if (Array.isArray(result)) return result;
      if (result && Array.isArray(result.data)) return result.data;
      if (result && Array.isArray(result.events)) return result.events;
      return [];
    },
  })
  const [selectedEventId, setSelectedEventId] = useState(events[0]?.id ?? '')
  const selectedEvent = events.find((e) => e.id === selectedEventId) ?? events[0]
  const activeEventId = selectedEvent?.id ?? ''

  const handleCode = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const outcome = await (async (): Promise<TicketValidationResult> => {
        if (!activeEventId) {
          return {
            status: 'invalid',
            title: 'No event selected',
            message: 'Choose the event you are checking tickets for.',
          }
        }
        try {
          return await validateTicket(rawCode, activeEventId)
        } catch (caught) {
          return {
            status: 'invalid',
            title: 'Could not check ticket',
            message: caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'The ticket could not be checked. Try again.',
          }
        }
      })()

      setResult(outcome)
      setHistory((previous) => [outcome, ...previous].slice(0, 6))
      setManualCode('')
      if (outcome.status === 'valid') {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['event-stats'] })
      }
    },
    [queryClient, activeEventId],
  )

  const checkCode = useCallback(
    (rawCode: string) => {
      if (checkingRef.current) return
      checkingRef.current = true
      setChecking(true)
      void handleCode(rawCode).finally(() => {
        checkingRef.current = false
        setChecking(false)
      })
    },
    [handleCode],
  )

  const { videoRef, status, error, start, stop } = useQrScanner(checkCode)

  function handleManualSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault()
    checkCode(manualCode)
  }

  const checkedIn = history.filter((item) => item.status === 'valid').length

  const scanning = status === 'scanning'

  if (!selectedEvent && loadingEvents) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
        <div className="alert info" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>Loading eventsâ€¦</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (!selectedEvent) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
        {loadError ? (
          <div className="alert error" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
            <b>Could not load assigned events.</b>
            <p style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{loadError instanceof Error ? loadError.message : 'Unknown error'}</p>
            <p className="m" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>The backend rejected the request to fetch your events. Check the browser console for more details.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="alert info" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
            No events are assigned to you yet. Ask your organizer to assign you to an event.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="row">
        <div>
          <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
          <p className="m">{selectedEvent.venue}</p>
          <label className="m" style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 8 }}>
            Event gate
            <select
              className="in"
              style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
              value={selectedEvent.id}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setSelectedEventId(event.target.value)
                setResult(null)
                setHistory([])
              }}
            >
              {events.map((event) => (
                <option key={event.id} value={event.id}>
                  {event.title}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="card stat" style={{ minWidth: 160 }}>
          <span className="m">Checked in this session</span>
          <b>{checkedIn}</b>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="split" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <div className="g">
          <div className="cam">
            <video ref={videoRef} playsInline muted className="cam-video" />
            {!scanning && (
              <div className="cam-hint">
                <div className="cam-frame" />
                <p>Point the camera at a ticket QR code to validate it.</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
            {scanning ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn o" onClick={stop}>
                Stop camera
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn"
                onClick={start}
                disabled={status === 'starting' || checking}
              >
                {status === 'starting' ? 'Starting cameraâ€¦' : 'Start camera'}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {error && <div className="alert error">{error}</div>}

          <form className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }} onSubmit={handleManualSubmit}>
            <input
              className="in"
              style={{ margin: 0 }}
              placeholder="Paste or scan the ticket QR token"
              value={manualCode}
              onChange={(event) => setManualCode(event.target.value)}
            />
            <button type="submit" className="btn" disabled={!manualCode.trim() || checking}>
              {checking ? 'Checkingâ€¦' : 'Validate'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="alert info">
            <>
              <b>Server-checked tickets</b>
              <p className="m">The backend records each scan, so a ticket is accepted only once.</p>
            </>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          {result ? (
            <ScanResult result={result} />
          ) : (
            <div className="alert info">Scan or enter a ticket to see the validation result.</div>
          )}

          <h4>Other results</h4>
          {history.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="m">No scans yet.</p>
          ) : (
            history.map((item, index) => (
              <ScanResult key={`${item.status}-${index}`} result={item} compact />
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

================================================================================
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import type { FormEvent, ReactNode } from 'react'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import type { TicketValidationResult } from '../../../lib/tickets'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { api } from '../../../lib/backend'
import { ScanResult } from '../components/ScanResult'
import { useQrScanner } from '../hooks/useQrScanner'
import { validateTicket } from '../hooks/useTicketValidator'

export function ScannerPage(): ReactNode {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<TicketValidationResult | null>(null)
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<TicketValidationResult[]>([])
  const [manualCode, setManualCode] = useState('')
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false)
  const checkingRef = useRef(false)
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  // only the events the organizer assigned to this staff account
  const { data: events = [], isLoading: loadingEvents, error: loadError } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['staff-assigned-events'],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const result = await api<any>('/staff/me/events');
      if (Array.isArray(result)) return result;
      if (result && Array.isArray(result.data)) return result.data;
      if (result && Array.isArray(result.events)) return result.events;
      return [];
    },
  })
  const [selectedEventId, setSelectedEventId] = useState(events[0]?.id ?? '')
  const selectedEvent = events.find((e) => e.id === selectedEventId) ?? events[0]
  const activeEventId = selectedEvent?.id ?? ''

  const handleCode = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const outcome = await (async (): Promise<TicketValidationResult> => {
        if (!activeEventId) {
          return {
            status: 'invalid',
            title: 'No event selected',
            message: 'Choose the event you are checking tickets for.',
          }
        }
        try {
          return await validateTicket(rawCode, activeEventId)
        } catch (caught) {
          return {
            status: 'invalid',
            title: 'Could not check ticket',
            message: caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'The ticket could not be checked. Try again.',
          }
        }
      })()

      setResult(outcome)
      setHistory((previous) => [outcome, ...previous].slice(0, 6))
      setManualCode('')
      if (outcome.status === 'valid') {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['event-stats'] })
      }
    },
    [queryClient, activeEventId],
  )

  const checkCode = useCallback(
    (rawCode: string) => {
      if (checkingRef.current) return
      checkingRef.current = true
      setChecking(true)
      void handleCode(rawCode).finally(() => {
        checkingRef.current = false
        setChecking(false)
      })
    },
    [handleCode],
  )

  const { videoRef, status, error, start, stop } = useQrScanner(checkCode)

  function handleManualSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault()
    checkCode(manualCode)
  }

  const checkedIn = history.filter((item) => item.status === 'valid').length

  const scanning = status === 'scanning'

  if (!selectedEvent && loadingEvents) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
        <div className="alert info" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>Loading eventsâ€¦</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (!selectedEvent) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
        {loadError ? (
          <div className="alert error" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
            <b>Could not load assigned events.</b>
            <p style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{loadError instanceof Error ? loadError.message : 'Unknown error'}</p>
            <p className="m" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>The backend rejected the request to fetch your events. Check the browser console for more details.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="alert info" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
            No events are assigned to you yet. Ask your organizer to assign you to an event.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="row">
        <div>
          <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
          <p className="m">{selectedEvent.venue}</p>
          <label className="m" style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 8 }}>
            Event gate
            <select
              className="in"
              style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
              value={selectedEvent.id}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setSelectedEventId(event.target.value)
                setResult(null)
                setHistory([])
              }}
            >
              {events.map((event) => (
                <option key={event.id} value={event.id}>
                  {event.title}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="card stat" style={{ minWidth: 160 }}>
          <span className="m">Checked in this session</span>
          <b>{checkedIn}</b>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="split" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <div className="g">
          <div className="cam">
            <video ref={videoRef} playsInline muted className="cam-video" />
            {!scanning && (
              <div className="cam-hint">
                <div className="cam-frame" />
                <p>Point the camera at a ticket QR code to validate it.</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
            {scanning ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn o" onClick={stop}>
                Stop camera
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn"
                onClick={start}
                disabled={status === 'starting' || checking}
              >
                {status === 'starting' ? 'Starting cameraâ€¦' : 'Start camera'}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {error && <div className="alert error">{error}</div>}

          <form className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }} onSubmit={handleManualSubmit}>
            <input
              className="in"
              style={{ margin: 0 }}
              placeholder="Paste or scan the ticket QR token"
              value={manualCode}
              onChange={(event) => setManualCode(event.target.value)}
            />
            <button type="submit" className="btn" disabled={!manualCode.trim() || checking}>
              {checking ? 'Checkingâ€¦' : 'Validate'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="alert info">
            <>
              <b>Server-checked tickets</b>
              <p className="m">The backend records each scan, so a ticket is accepted only once.</p>
            </>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          {result ? (
            <ScanResult result={result} />
          ) : (
            <div className="alert info">Scan or enter a ticket to see the validation result.</div>
          )}

          <h4>Other results</h4>
          {history.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="m">No scans yet.</p>
          ) : (
            history.map((item, index) => (
              <ScanResult key={`${item.status}-${index}`} result={item} compact />
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

          const assignedIdsStr = localStorage.getItem('tm_assigned_events');
          const assignedIds = assignedIdsStr ? JSON.parse(assignedIdsStr) : [];
          
          console.log('Fallback: Events fetched:', list.length, 'Assigned IDs:', assignedIds);
          
          if (assignedIds.length === 0) return [];
          
          return list.filter((e: any) => assignedIds.includes(String(e.id))).map((e: any) => ({
            id: String(e.id),
            title: e.title,
            venue: e.venue
          }));
        }
        throw error;
      }
    },
    retry: false,
  })
  const [selectedEventId, setSelectedEventId] = useState(events[0]?.id ?? '')
  const selectedEvent = events.find((e) => e.id === selectedEventId) ?? events[0]
  const activeEventId = selectedEvent?.id ?? ''

  const handleCode = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const outcome = await (async (): Promise<TicketValidationResult> => {
        if (!activeEventId) {
          return {
            status: 'invalid',
            title: 'No event selected',
            message: 'Choose the event you are checking tickets for.',
          }
        }
        try {
          return await validateTicket(rawCode, activeEventId)
        } catch (caught) {
          return {
            status: 'invalid',
            title: 'Could not check ticket',
            message: caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'The ticket could not be checked. Try again.',
          }
        }
      })()

      setResult(outcome)
      setHistory((previous) => [outcome, ...previous].slice(0, 6))
      setManualCode('')
      if (outcome.status === 'valid') {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['event-stats'] })
      }
    },
    [queryClient, activeEventId],
  )

  const checkCode = useCallback(
    (rawCode: string) => {
      if (checkingRef.current) return
      checkingRef.current = true
      setChecking(true)
      void handleCode(rawCode).finally(() => {
        checkingRef.current = false
        setChecking(false)
      })
    },
    [handleCode],
  )

  const { videoRef, status, error, start, stop } = useQrScanner(checkCode)

  function handleManualSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault()
    checkCode(manualCode)
  }

  const checkedIn = history.filter((item) => item.status === 'valid').length

  const scanning = status === 'scanning'

  if (!selectedEvent && loadingEvents) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
        <div className="alert info" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>Loading eventsâ€¦</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (!selectedEvent) {
    return (
      <div>
        <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
        {loadError ? (
          <div className="alert error" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
            <b>Could not load assigned events.</b>
            <p style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{loadError instanceof Error ? loadError.message : 'Unknown error'}</p>
            <p className="m" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>The backend rejected the request to fetch your events. Check the browser console for more details.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="alert info" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
            No events are assigned to you yet. Ask your organizer to assign you to an event.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="row">
        <div>
          <h1>Scan tickets</h1>
          <p className="m">{selectedEvent.venue}</p>
          <label className="m" style={{ display: 'block', marginTop: 8 }}>
            Event gate
            <select
              className="in"
              style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
              value={selectedEvent.id}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setSelectedEventId(event.target.value)
                setResult(null)
                setHistory([])
              }}
            >
              {events.map((event) => (
                <option key={event.id} value={event.id}>
                  {event.title}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="card stat" style={{ minWidth: 160 }}>
          <span className="m">Checked in this session</span>
          <b>{checkedIn}</b>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="split" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
        <div className="g">
          <div className="cam">
            <video ref={videoRef} playsInline muted className="cam-video" />
            {!scanning && (
              <div className="cam-hint">
                <div className="cam-frame" />
                <p>Point the camera at a ticket QR code to validate it.</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="row" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
            {scanning ? (
              <button type="button" className="btn o" onClick={stop}>
                Stop camera
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="btn"
                onClick={start}
                disabled={status === 'starting' || checking}
              >
                {status === 'starting' ? 'Starting cameraâ€¦' : 'Start camera'}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {error && <div className="alert error">{error}</div>}

          <form className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }} onSubmit={handleManualSubmit}>
            <input
              className="in"
              style={{ margin: 0 }}
              placeholder="Paste or scan the ticket QR token"
              value={manualCode}
              onChange={(event) => setManualCode(event.target.value)}
            />
            <button type="submit" className="btn" disabled={!manualCode.trim() || checking}>
              {checking ? 'Checkingâ€¦' : 'Validate'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="alert info">
            <>
              <b>Server-checked tickets</b>
              <p className="m">The backend records each scan, so a ticket is accepted only once.</p>
            </>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          {result ? (
            <ScanResult result={result} />
          ) : (
            <div className="alert info">Scan or enter a ticket to see the validation result.</div>
          )}

          <h4>Other results</h4>
          {history.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="m">No scans yet.</p>
          ) : (
            history.map((item, index) => (
              <ScanResult key={`${item.status}-${index}`} result={item} compact />
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useAllEvents } from '../../events/hooks/useEvents'
import {
  assignStaffEvents, createMyStaff, listMyStaff, removeStaff, setStaffActive,
  type StaffMember,
} from '../../../lib/backendUsers'
import { ConfirmDialog } from '../../../components/ConfirmDialog'
import { useToast } from '../../toast'

const field = 'mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-navy'
const emptyForm = { name: '', email: '', password: '' }

// An organizer creates staff accounts, chooses which events each one may scan,
// and switches them off or removes them. Everything is saved in the backend.
export function StaffManagementPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const { showToast } = useToast()
  const { data: staff = [], isLoading, error: loadError } = useQuery({ queryKey: ['my-staff'], queryFn: listMyStaff })
  const { data: events = [] } = useAllEvents()
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm)
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<StaffMember | null>(null)

  const refresh = () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['my-staff'] })

  async function run(action: () => Promise<unknown>, success: string) {
    try {
      await action()
      await refresh()
      showToast(success, 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong', 'error')
    }
  }

  async function create(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setFormError(null)
    if (!form.name.trim()) return setFormError('Enter the staff memberâ€™s name.')
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim())) return setFormError('Enter a valid email address.')
    if (form.password.length < 8) return setFormError('The password needs at least 8 characters.')
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      await createMyStaff(form)
      setForm(emptyForm)
      await refresh()
      showToast('Staff account created', 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not create the account.')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  function toggleEvent(member: StaffMember, eventId: string) {
    const next = member.assignedEventIds.includes(eventId)
      ? member.assignedEventIds.filter((id) => id !== eventId)
      : [...member.assignedEventIds, eventId]
    void run(() => assignStaffEvents(member.id, next), 'Assignments saved')
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto min-h-[60vh] max-w-4xl px-4 py-20 sm:px-6">
      <Link to="/organizer/dashboard" className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-navy">
        â† Organizer dashboard
      </Link>
      <h1 className="mt-4 text-3xl font-extrabold text-navy-dark">Staff</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
        Staff scan tickets at the door. They can only scan the events you assign to them.
      </p>

      <form onSubmit={create} className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm" noValidate>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-navy-dark">Add a staff member</h2>
        <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">Name
            <input className={field} value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">Email
            <input type="email" className={field} value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">Temporary password
            <input type="password" className={field} value={form.password} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })} placeholder="At least 8 characters" />
          </label>
        </div>
        {formError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-red-600">{formError}</p>}
        <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="mt-4 rounded-full bg-navy px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-navy-dark disabled:opacity-60">
          {saving ? 'Creatingâ€¦' : 'Create staff account'}
        </button>
      </form>

      <section className="mt-6 space-y-4" aria-label="Your staff">
        {isLoading && <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Loading staffâ€¦</p>}
        {loadError && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-red-600">{loadError instanceof Error ? loadError.message : 'Could not load staff.'}</p>}
        {!isLoading && !loadError && staff.length === 0 && (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 text-sm text-slate-600">You have no staff yet.</p>
        )}
        {staff.map((member) => (
          <article key={member.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-navy-dark">{member.name}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{member.email}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${member.isActive ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'}`}>
                  {member.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Disabled'}
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => void run(() => setStaffActive(member.id, !member.isActive), member.isActive ? 'Staff disabled' : 'Staff enabled')}
                  className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-slate-50"
                >{member.isActive ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}</button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setRemoving(member)}
                  className="rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-red-700"
                >Remove</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <fieldset className="mt-4" disabled={!member.isActive}>
              <legend className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-slate-500">Events they can scan</legend>
              {events.length === 0 && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">Create an event first.</p>}
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {events.map((event) => (
                  <label key={event.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={member.assignedEventIds.includes(String(event.id))}
                      onChange={() => toggleEvent(member, String(event.id))}
                    />
                    {event.name}

              </div>

        ))}
      </section>

        open={!!removing}
        onClose={() => setRemoving(null)}
        onConfirm={() => { if (removing) void run(() => removeStaff(removing.id), 'Staff removed') }}
        title={removing ? `Remove ${removing.name}?` : 'Remove staff?'}
        description="Their login is switched off and they can no longer scan tickets."
        confirmLabel="Remove"
        variant="danger"
      />
    </main>
  )
}

import { useState, useEffect, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { api } from '../../../lib/backend'
import { createMyStaff } from '../../../lib/backendUsers'
import { useAllEvents } from '../../events/hooks/useEvents'
import { ConfirmDialog } from '../../../components/ConfirmDialog'
import { useToast } from '../../toast'

const field = 'mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-navy'
const emptyForm = { name: '', email: '', password: '' }

interface SafeStaffMember {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  assignedEventIds: string[]
  isActive: boolean
}

export function StaffManagementPage() {
  const { showToast } = useToast()
  const { data: events = [] } = useAllEvents()

  const [staff, setStaff] = useState<SafeStaffMember[]>([])
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm)
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<SafeStaffMember | null>(null)

  async function loadStaff() {
    setIsLoading(true)
    setLoadError(null)
    try {
      const result = await api<any>('/organizers/me/staff')
      const list = Array.isArray(result) ? result : (result?.data || result?.staff || [])
      
      const cleaned = list.map((raw: any) => {
        // Safely grab whichever ID the backend actually returned
        const rawId = raw.id ?? raw.userId ?? raw.user_id ?? raw.staffId ?? raw.staff_id
        const safeId = rawId !== undefined && rawId !== null ? String(rawId) : ''

        // Normalize assignment arrays
        let ids: string[] = []
        const rawIds = raw.assignedEventIds ?? raw.eventIds ?? raw.assignedEvents ?? raw.events
        if (Array.isArray(rawIds)) {
          ids = rawIds.map((item: any) => String(item?.id ?? item))
        }

        return {
          id: safeId,
          name: raw.name ?? 'Unknown',
          email: raw.email ?? '',
          assignedEventIds: ids,
          isActive: raw.isActive ?? raw.active ?? (raw.status !== 'DISABLED' && raw.status !== 'INACTIVE')
        }
      })

      // We filter out any staff where the ID came back as empty/undefined
      setStaff(cleaned.filter((s: SafeStaffMember) => s.id !== ''))
    } catch (err) {
      setLoadError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not load staff.')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadStaff()
  }, [])

  async function run(action: () => Promise<unknown>, success: string) {
    try {
      await action()
      await loadStaff()
      showToast(success, 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong', 'error')
    }
  }

  async function create(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setFormError(null)
    if (!form.name.trim()) return setFormError('Enter the staff memberâ€™s name.')
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim())) return setFormError('Enter a valid email address.')
    if (form.password.length < 8) return setFormError('The password needs at least 8 characters.')
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      await createMyStaff(form)
      setForm(emptyForm)
      await loadStaff()
      showToast('Staff account created', 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not create the account.')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  function toggleEvent(member: SafeStaffMember, eventId: string) {
    // If the backend uses UUIDs and rejects them, we catch the 400 error here
    const current = member.assignedEventIds
    const next = current.includes(eventId)
      ? current.filter((id) => id !== eventId)
      : [...current, eventId]
    
    void run(() => api(`/organizers/me/staff/${encodeURIComponent(member.id)}/events`, { method: 'PUT', body: { eventIds: next } }), 'Assignments saved')
  }

  function toggleActive(member: SafeStaffMember) {
    void run(() => api(`/organizers/me/staff/${encodeURIComponent(member.id)}/active`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { isActive: !member.isActive } }), member.isActive ? 'Staff disabled' : 'Staff enabled')
  }

  function remove(member: SafeStaffMember) {
    void run(() => api(`/organizers/me/staff/${encodeURIComponent(member.id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }), 'Staff removed')
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto min-h-[60vh] max-w-4xl px-4 py-20 sm:px-6">
      <Link to="/organizer/dashboard" className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-navy">
        â† Organizer dashboard
      </Link>
      <h1 className="mt-4 text-3xl font-extrabold text-navy-dark">Staff</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
        Staff scan tickets at the door. They can only scan the events you assign to them.
      </p>

      <form onSubmit={create} className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm" noValidate>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-navy-dark">Add a staff member</h2>
        <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">Name
            <input className={field} value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">Email
            <input type="email" className={field} value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">Temporary password
            <input type="password" className={field} value={form.password} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })} placeholder="At least 8 characters" />
          </label>
        </div>
        {formError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-red-600">{formError}</p>}
        <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="mt-4 rounded-full bg-navy px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-navy-dark disabled:opacity-60">
          {saving ? 'Creatingâ€¦' : 'Create staff account'}
        </button>
      </form>

        {isLoading && <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Loading staffâ€¦</p>}
        {loadError && <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-red-600">{loadError}</p>}
        {!isLoading && !loadError && staff.length === 0 && (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 text-sm text-slate-600">You have no staff yet.</p>
        )}
        
        {staff.map((member) => (
          <article key={member.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-navy-dark">{member.name}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{member.email}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ${member.isActive ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'}`}>
                  {member.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Disabled'}
                </span>
                <button onClick={() => toggleActive(member)} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-slate-50">
                  {member.isActive ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setRemoving(member)} className="rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-red-700">
                  Remove
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <fieldset className="mt-4" disabled={!member.isActive}>
              <legend className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-slate-500">Events they can scan</legend>
              {events.length === 0 && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">Create an event first.</p>}
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {events.map((event) => (

                      onChange={() => toggleEvent(member, String(event.id))}
                    />
                    {event.name}
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </fieldset>
          </article>
        ))}
      </section>

        open={!!removing}
        onClose={() => setRemoving(null)}
        onConfirm={() => { if (removing) remove(removing) }}
        title={removing ? `Remove ${removing.name}?` : 'Remove staff?'}
        description="Their login is switched off and they can no longer scan tickets."

  )

import { useState, useEffect, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { api } from '../../../lib/backend'
import { createMyStaff } from '../../../lib/backendUsers'
import { useAllEvents } from '../../events/hooks/useEvents'
import { ConfirmDialog } from '../../../components/ConfirmDialog'
import { useToast } from '../../toast'

const field = 'mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-navy'
const emptyForm = { name: '', email: '', password: '' }

interface SafeStaffMember {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  assignedEventIds: string[]
  isActive: boolean
}

export function StaffManagementPage() {
  const { showToast } = useToast()
  const { data: events = [] } = useAllEvents()

  const [staff, setStaff] = useState<SafeStaffMember[]>([])
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm)
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<SafeStaffMember | null>(null)

  async function loadStaff() {
    setIsLoading(true)
    setLoadError(null)
    try {
      const result = await api<any>('/organizers/me/staff')
      const list = Array.isArray(result) ? result : (result?.data || result?.staff || [])
      
      const cleaned = list.map((raw: any) => {
        // Safely grab whichever ID the backend actually returned
        const rawId = raw.id ?? raw.userId ?? raw.user_id ?? raw.staffId ?? raw.staff_id
        const safeId = rawId !== undefined && rawId !== null ? String(rawId) : ''

        // Normalize assignment arrays
        let ids: string[] = []
        const rawIds = raw.assignedEventIds ?? raw.eventIds ?? raw.assignedEvents ?? raw.events
        if (Array.isArray(rawIds)) {
          ids = rawIds.map((item: any) => String(item?.id ?? item))
        }

        return {
          id: safeId,
          name: raw.name ?? 'Unknown',
          email: raw.email ?? '',
          assignedEventIds: ids,
          isActive: raw.isActive ?? raw.active ?? (raw.status !== 'DISABLED' && raw.status !== 'INACTIVE')
        }
      })

      // We filter out any staff where the ID came back as empty/undefined
      setStaff(cleaned.filter((s: SafeStaffMember) => s.id !== ''))
    } catch (err) {
      setLoadError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not load staff.')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadStaff()
  }, [])

  async function run(action: () => Promise<unknown>, success: string) {
    try {
      await action()
      await loadStaff()
      showToast(success, 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong', 'error')
    }
  }

  async function create(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setFormError(null)
    if (!form.name.trim()) return setFormError('Enter the staff memberâ€™s name.')
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim())) return setFormError('Enter a valid email address.')
    if (form.password.length < 8) return setFormError('The password needs at least 8 characters.')
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      await createMyStaff(form)
      setForm(emptyForm)
      await loadStaff()
      showToast('Staff account created', 'success')
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not create the account.')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  function toggleEvent(member: SafeStaffMember, eventId: string) {
    const current = member.assignedEventIds
    const stringIds = current.includes(eventId)
      ? current.filter((id) => id !== eventId)
      : [...current, eventId]
    
    // The backend explicitly requires positive integers for event IDs.
    // We must convert the strings back to numbers before sending.
    const numericIds = stringIds.map(Number).filter(id => !isNaN(id) && id > 0)

    void run(() => api(`/organizers/me/staff/${encodeURIComponent(member.id)}/events`, { 
      method: 'PUT', 
      body: { eventIds: numericIds } 
    }), 'Assignments saved')
  }

  function toggleActive(member: SafeStaffMember) {
    void run(() => api(`/organizers/me/staff/${encodeURIComponent(member.id)}/active`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { isActive: !member.isActive } }), member.isActive ? 'Staff disabled' : 'Staff enabled')
  }

  function remove(member: SafeStaffMember) {
    void run(() => api(`/organizers/me/staff/${encodeURIComponent(member.id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }), 'Staff removed')
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto min-h-[60vh] max-w-4xl px-4 py-20 sm:px-6">
      <Link to="/organizer/dashboard" className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-navy">
        â† Organizer dashboard

      <h1 className="mt-4 text-3xl font-extrabold text-navy-dark">Staff</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
        Staff scan tickets at the door. They can only scan the events you assign to them.
      </p>

      <form onSubmit={create} className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm" noValidate>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-navy-dark">Add a staff member</h2>
        <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">Name

          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">Email
            <input type="email" className={field} value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} />

    setFormError(null)
    setNotice(null)
    if (!form.name.trim()) return setFormError('Enter the staff memberâ€™s name.')
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim())) return setFormError('Enter a valid email address.')
    if (form.password.length < 8) return setFormError('The password needs at least 8 characters.')
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      await createMyStaff(form)
      setForm(emptyForm)
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['my-staff'] })
      setNotice('Staff account created.')
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not create the account.')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <form onSubmit={create} noValidate style={{ marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}>
        <h3>Add a staff member</h3>
        <div className="form-row">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="staff-name">Name</label>
            <input id="staff-name" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="staff-email">Email</label>
            <input id="staff-email" type="email" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="staff-password">Password</label>
            <input id="staff-password" type="password" value={form.password} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
        </div>
        {formError && <div className="form-error-banner">{formError}</div>}
        {notice && <p className="form-hint">{notice}</p>}
        <div className="form-actions">
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary-header" disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? 'Creating...' : 'Create staff account'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {isLoading && <p className="view-subtitle">Loading your staff...</p>}
      {error && <div className="form-error-banner">{error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load staff.'}</div>}
      {!isLoading && !error && data.length === 0 && (
        <p className="view-subtitle">You have no staff yet. Add one above.</p>
      )}
      {data.length > 0 && (
        <div className="table-responsive">
          <table className="dashboard-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Name</th>
                <th>Email</th>
                <th>Events</th>
                <th>Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.map((member) => (
                <tr key={member.id}>
                  <td>{member.name}</td>
                  <td>{member.email}</td>
                  <td>{member.assignedEventIds.length}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span className={`status-badge ${member.isActive ? 'published' : 'cancelled'}`}>
                      {member.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="form-hint">
        To choose which events a staff member may scan, switch them off or remove them, open{' '}
        <Link to="/organizer/staff">staff management</Link>.
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: ./.fix-backup/useQrScanner.ts.1794309695

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

interface DetectedBarcode {
  rawValue: string
}

interface BarcodeDetectorLike {
  detect: (source: CanvasImageSource) => Promise<DetectedBarcode[]>
}

interface BarcodeDetectorConstructor {
  new (options?: { formats?: string[] }): BarcodeDetectorLike
}

export type QrScannerStatus =
  | 'idle'
  | 'starting'
  | 'scanning'
  | 'unsupported'
  | 'denied'
  | 'error'

const SCAN_INTERVAL_MS = 400
const REPEAT_COOLDOWN_MS = 2500

function getBarcodeDetectorConstructor(): BarcodeDetectorConstructor | undefined {
  return (window as unknown as { BarcodeDetector?: BarcodeDetectorConstructor }).BarcodeDetector
}

export function useQrScanner(onDetected: (code: string) => void) {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null)
  const detectorRef = useRef<BarcodeDetectorLike | null>(null)
  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const lastCodeRef = useRef<{ code: string; at: number }>({ code: '', at: 0 })
  const onDetectedRef = useRef(onDetected)

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<QrScannerStatus>('idle')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    onDetectedRef.current = onDetected
  }, [onDetected])

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    if (timerRef.current !== null) {
      window.clearInterval(timerRef.current)
      timerRef.current = null
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
      streamRef.current = null
    }
    if (videoRef.current) {
      videoRef.current.srcObject = null
    }
    detectorRef.current = null
    setStatus('idle')
  }, [])

  const start = useCallback(async () => {
    setError(null)

    const Detector = getBarcodeDetectorConstructor()
    if (!Detector) {
      setStatus('unsupported')
      setError('QR scanning is not supported in this browser. Enter the ticket ID manually below.')
      return
    }
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      setStatus('unsupported')
      setError('Camera access is not available here. Enter the ticket ID manually below.')
      return
    }

    setStatus('starting')
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: 'environment' },
        audio: false,
      })
      streamRef.current = stream

      const video = videoRef.current
      if (!video) {
        stop()
        return
      }
      video.srcObject = stream
      await video.play()

      detectorRef.current = new Detector({ formats: ['qr_code'] })
      setStatus('scanning')

      timerRef.current = window.setInterval(async () => {
        const currentVideo = videoRef.current
        const detector = detectorRef.current
        if (!currentVideo || !detector || currentVideo.readyState < 2) return
        try {
          const codes = await detector.detect(currentVideo)
          const value = codes[0]?.rawValue?.trim()
          if (!value) return
          const now = Date.now()
          if (value === lastCodeRef.current.code && now - lastCodeRef.current.at < REPEAT_COOLDOWN_MS) {
            return
          }
          lastCodeRef.current = { code: value, at: now }
          onDetectedRef.current(value)
        } catch {
          // Ignore transient decoding errors and keep scanning.
        }
      }, SCAN_INTERVAL_MS)
    } catch (caught) {
      stop()
      const denied = caught instanceof DOMException && caught.name === 'NotAllowedError'
      setStatus(denied ? 'denied' : 'error')
      setError(
        denied
          ? 'Camera permission was denied. Enter the ticket ID manually below.'
          : 'Could not start the camera. Enter the ticket ID manually below.',
      )
    }
  }, [stop])

  useEffect(() => stop, [stop])

  return { videoRef, status, error, start, stop }
}

FILE: ./.fix-backup/useQrScanner.ts.1794309755
================================================================================
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

export type QrScannerStatus =
  | 'idle'
  | 'starting'
  | 'scanning'
  | 'unsupported'
  | 'denied'
  | 'error'

const REPEAT_COOLDOWN_MS = 2500

export function useQrScanner(onDetected: (code: string) => void) {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
  const containerIdRef = useRef(`qr-reader-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`)
  const html5ScannerRef = useRef<any>(null)
  const zxingControlsRef = useRef<{ stop: () => void } | null>(null)
  const nativeTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null)
  const lastCodeRef = useRef<{ code: string; at: number }>({ code: '', at: 0 })
  const onDetectedRef = useRef(onDetected)
  const activeRef = useRef(false)

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<QrScannerStatus>('idle')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    onDetectedRef.current = onDetected
  }, [onDetected])

  const report = useCallback((raw: string) => {
    const code = raw.trim()
    const now = Date.now()
    if (
      activeRef.current &&
      code &&
      (code !== lastCodeRef.current.code || now - lastCodeRef.current.at >= REPEAT_COOLDOWN_MS)
    ) {
      lastCodeRef.current = { code, at: now }
      stop()
      onDetectedRef.current(code)
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [])

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    activeRef.current = false

    if (nativeTimerRef.current !== null) {
      window.clearInterval(nativeTimerRef.current)
      nativeTimerRef.current = null
    }

    if (html5ScannerRef.current) {
      try {
        const maybePromise = html5ScannerRef.current.stop()
        if (maybePromise?.catch) maybePromise.catch(() => {})
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      html5ScannerRef.current = null
    }

    zxingControlsRef.current?.stop()
    zxingControlsRef.current = null

    const video = videoRef.current
    if (video?.srcObject instanceof MediaStream) {
      video.srcObject.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
      video.srcObject = null
    }

    setStatus('idle')
  }, [])

  const start = useCallback(async () => {
    if (activeRef.current) return
    activeRef.current = true
    setStatus('starting')
    setError(null)

    if (!window.isSecureContext) {
      activeRef.current = false
      setStatus('unsupported')
      setError('Camera access requires HTTPS. Open this site via https:// and allow camera access.')
      return
    }
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      activeRef.current = false
      setStatus('unsupported')
      setError('This browser does not support camera access. Enter the ticket ID manually below.')
      return
    }

    // ---- 1. Try html5-qrcode (works on all browsers via canvas/WASM decoding) ----
    try {
      const { Html5Qrcode } = await import('html5-qrcode')
      const containerId = containerIdRef.current
      const container = document.getElementById(containerId)
      if (!container) throw new Error('Scanner container not ready')

      const scanner = new Html5Qrcode(containerId, { verbose: false })
      html5ScannerRef.current = scanner

      await scanner.start(
        { facingMode: 'environment' },
        { fps: 10, qrbox: { width: 250, height: 250 }, aspectRatio: 1.0 },
        (decoded: string) => report(decoded),
        () => {
          /* per-frame misses are normal â€” ignore */
        },
      )

      // html5-qrcode injects its own <video> inside the container; keep our ref in sync
      const injected = container.querySelector('video') as HTMLVideoElement | null
      if (injected && videoRef.current && videoRef.current !== injected) {
        // Use the injected video for cleanup purposes
        videoRef.current = injected
      }
      setStatus('scanning')
      return
    } catch (html5Error) {
      // Fall through to native BarcodeDetector
      console.warn('[scanner] html5-qrcode failed, trying native BarcodeDetector', html5Error)
    }

    // ---- 2. Native BarcodeDetector (Chrome / Edge / Android â€” fast) ----
    const Detector = (window as unknown as { BarcodeDetector?: new (o: { formats: string[] }) => { detect: (v: HTMLVideoElement) => Promise<{ rawValue: string }[]> } }).BarcodeDetector
    if (Detector) {
      try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          audio: false,
          video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }, width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
        })
        const video = videoRef.current
        if (!video) throw new Error('Video element missing')
        video.srcObject = stream
        await video.play()
        const detector = new Detector({ formats: ['qr_code'] })
        setStatus('scanning')
        nativeTimerRef.current = window.setInterval(async () => {
          if (!activeRef.current) return
          if (video.readyState < 2) return
          try {
            const codes = await detector.detect(video)
            if (codes[0]?.rawValue) report(codes[0].rawValue)
          } catch {
            /* transient */
          }
        }, 180)
        return
      } catch (nativeError) {
        console.warn('[scanner] native BarcodeDetector failed, trying ZXing', nativeError)
      }
    }

    // ---- 3. @zxing/browser (WASM â€” universal fallback) ----
    try {
      const { BrowserQRCodeReader } = await import('@zxing/browser')
      const reader = new BrowserQRCodeReader(undefined, {
        delayBetweenScanAttempts: 250,
        delayBetweenScanSuccess: 250,
      })
      const video = videoRef.current
      if (!video) throw new Error('Video element missing')
      const controls = await reader.decodeFromConstraints(
        {
          audio: false,
          video: { facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }, width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } },
        },
        video,
        (result, decodeError) => {
          if (result) {
            report(result.getText())
          } else if (
            decodeError &&
            !['NotFoundException', 'ChecksumException', 'FormatException'].includes(decodeError.name)
          ) {
            setStatus('error')
            setError('The camera could not decode frames. Try restarting, or enter the ticket ID manually.')
          }
        },
      )
      zxingControlsRef.current = controls as unknown as { stop: () => void }
      setStatus('scanning')
    } catch (caught) {
      activeRef.current = false
      const denied = caught instanceof DOMException && caught.name === 'NotAllowedError'
      setStatus(denied ? 'denied' : 'error')
      setError(
        denied
          ? 'Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings, then try again.'
          : 'Could not start the camera. Enter the ticket ID manually below.',
      )
    }
  }, [report, stop])

  useEffect(() => stop, [stop])

  return { videoRef, containerId: containerIdRef.current, status, error, start, stop }
}

# Paying with PayChangu

Tickets are now paid through PayChangu (Airtel Money, TNM Mpamba or bank card, chosen on PayChangu's own page).
No ticket is issued until PayChangu confirms the money arrived.

## Set up (once)
1. Create a PayChangu account and open the dashboard, then API / Settings.
2. Copy your TEST secret key (it starts with `sec-test-`).
3. In the project root: `cp .env.example .env`, then put the key in `.env`.
4. `npm run dev` (restart it after changing `.env`).

`.env` is private and is in `.gitignore`. Never commit it, never paste the key in chat or code.

## How a payment flows
1. Customer clicks "Pay ... with PayChangu" -> `POST /api/paychangu/initiate` (server/paychangu.ts, secret key used here only).
2. Browser is sent to PayChangu's checkout page and pays there.
3. PayChangu sends the customer back to `/checkout/return?tx_ref=...`.
4. The page calls `GET /api/paychangu/verify/:tx_ref`; the server asks PayChangu if it really succeeded.
5. Only if status is success, currency MWK and amount >= the order total: tickets and the booking are created (once).

## Testing
Use test mode (`sec-test-` key). PayChangu's docs list test numbers, e.g. Airtel Money `990000000` and card `4242 4242 4242 4242`.

## Local development: PayChangu removes the port
PayChangu strips the port from `callback_url` and `return_url`. A redirect URL of
`http://localhost:5173/checkout/return` becomes `http://localhost/checkout/return`,
which does not reach the Vite dev server.

Keep the app on port 5173 and run the return bridge in a second terminal:

```bash
sudo env "PATH=$PATH" npm run paychangu:bridge
```

The bridge listens on port 80 and redirects to `http://localhost:5173`, so PayChangu's
portless redirect still lands on the checkout return page. Leave it running while testing.

If you cannot bind port 80, expose the dev server through a tunnel (for example ngrok)
and open the app through the tunnel URL instead. PayChangu will then redirect to the
tunnel's portless HTTPS URL. No PayChangu dashboard changes are needed for either option.

## Limits of this project (say so in the report)
- Orders, events and tickets still live in the browser (localStorage), so the server cannot check the price itself.
  A real system keeps events and orders in a database and computes the amount on the server.
- Verification is done when the customer returns. A real system also handles PayChangu webhooks
  (customer closes the tab after paying) and refunds.
- `server/paychangu.ts` runs inside the Vite dev/preview server. A deployed site needs the same two routes on a real backend.

# COM311 â€“ Group FF6

Event management app built with Vite + React + TypeScript, using Tanstack Query and Tanstack Router.

## Repo

https://github.com/bsc-com-22-24-svg/FF6_Ticket_Master

## Running the app

The app uses the NestJS backend and PostgreSQL by default. See
[RUNNING_THE_APP.md](RUNNING_THE_APP.md) for the full local setup, including
Docker commands, the database schema, and PayChangu configuration.

Install and run the frontend:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/bsc-com-22-24-svg/FF6_Ticket_Master.git
cd FF6_Ticket_Master
npm install
npm run dev
```

Other scripts:

```bash
npm run build     # type-check + production build
npm run lint      # oxlint
npm test          # vitest unit tests
```

### Backend connection

The frontend uses the backend API for authentication and application data. Set
`BACKEND_URL` in `.env` to the backend server address; Vite forwards API calls
through `/be`. There is no in-browser demo account or local mock-data mode.

Start the backend and PostgreSQL together from this folder with Docker Compose:

```bash
cp .env.db.example .env.db
cp .env.backend.example .env.backend
# Set matching database passwords and a private JWT secret in both env files.
docker volume create ticket-db-data
docker compose up -d
docker compose logs -f
```

The database uses the persistent `ticket-db-data` volume. Keep that volume to
preserve existing users, events, and tickets.

FILE: ./RUNNING_THE_APP.md
