    'fetch',
    vi.fn(async () => new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', tx_ref: txRef, amount: 70500, currency: 'MWK' }),
      { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } },
    )),
  )
}

function purchased(number: string) {
  return {
    ticketNumber: number,
    qrCodeDataUrl: `data:image/png;base64,${number}`,
    status: 'ISSUED',
  }
}

describe('completePayment with the backend', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    window.localStorage.clear()
    vi.unstubAllGlobals()
    purchase.mockReset()
  })

  it('claims one backend ticket per seat and keeps the server QR image', async () => {
    pendingOrder('TM-BACKEND-0001')
    paymentSuccess('TM-BACKEND-0001')
    purchase
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(purchased('TKT-ONE'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(purchased('TKT-TWO'))

    const result = await completePayment('TM-BACKEND-0001')

    expect(result.kind).toBe('success')
    if (result.kind !== 'success') return
    expect(result.tickets.map((ticket) => ticket.id).sort()).toEqual(['TKT-ONE', 'TKT-TWO'])
    expect(result.tickets.every((ticket) => ticket.qrCodeDataUrl?.includes(ticket.id))).toBe(true)
    expect(purchase).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
    expect(purchase).toHaveBeenCalledWith(EVENT_ID, getEvent(EVENT_ID)!.ticketTypes[0].id, 'TM-BACKEND-0001')
    expect(getPendingPayment('TM-BACKEND-0001')?.status).toBe('completed')
  })

  it('reports tickets that were bought when a later claim fails, then retries only the missing seat', async () => {
    pendingOrder('TM-BACKEND-0002')
    paymentSuccess('TM-BACKEND-0002')
    purchase
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(purchased('TKT-THREE'))
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Tickets are sold out'))

    const first = await completePayment('TM-BACKEND-0002')

    expect(first.kind).toBe('partial')
    if (first.kind !== 'partial') return
    expect(first.tickets.map((ticket) => ticket.id)).toEqual(['TKT-THREE'])
    expect(first.message).toContain('1 of 2')
    expect(getPendingPayment('TM-BACKEND-0002')?.status).toBe('pending')
    expect(getPendingPayment('TM-BACKEND-0002')?.ticketIds).toEqual(['TKT-THREE'])

    purchase.mockResolvedValueOnce(purchased('TKT-FOUR'))
    const retry = await completePayment('TM-BACKEND-0002')

    expect(retry.kind).toBe('success')
    if (retry.kind !== 'success') return
    expect(retry.tickets.map((ticket) => ticket.id).sort()).toEqual(['TKT-FOUR', 'TKT-THREE'])
    expect(purchase).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3)
    expect(listTickets().filter((ticket) => ticket.id.startsWith('TKT-'))).toHaveLength(2)
  })

  it('does not claim a ticket when the backend refuses every seat', async () => {
    pendingOrder('TM-BACKEND-0003')
    paymentSuccess('TM-BACKEND-0003')
    purchase.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Tickets are sold out'))

    const result = await completePayment('TM-BACKEND-0003')

    expect(result.kind).toBe('failed')
    if (result.kind !== 'failed') return
    expect(result.message).toContain('no tickets could be issued')
    expect(listTickets().filter((ticket) => ticket.id.startsWith('TKT-'))).toHaveLength(0)
  })
})


================================================================================
FILE: ./src/features/checkout/completePayment.ts
================================================================================
import type { TicketRecord } from '../../lib/tickets'
import type { StoredEvent } from '../../types/event'
import type { TicketType } from '../../types/event'
import { backendTicketToRecord, purchaseBackendTicket } from '../../lib/backendTickets'
import { fetchBackendEvent } from '../../lib/backendEvents'
import { fetchTicketRecords } from '../tickets/ticketData'
import {
  addPendingTickets,
  getPendingPayment,
  markPaymentCompleted,
  verifyPayment,
  type PendingPayment,
} from '../../lib/paychangu'

export type CompletionResult =
  | { kind: 'success'; tickets: TicketRecord[]; payment: PendingPayment }
  | {
      kind: 'partial'
      tickets: TicketRecord[]
      message: string
      eventId: string
      payment: PendingPayment
    }
  | { kind: 'pending' }
  | { kind: 'failed'; message: string; eventId?: string }
  | { kind: 'unknown' }

const inFlight = new Map<string, Promise<CompletionResult>>()

async function ticketsFor(payment: PendingPayment): Promise<TicketRecord[]> {
  const ids = new Set(payment.ticketIds ?? [])
  if (ids.size === 0) return []

  const tickets = await fetchTicketRecords(payment.userId, payment.holder)
  return tickets.filter((ticket) => ids.has(ticket.id))
}

async function claimBackendTickets(
  pending: PendingPayment,
  event: StoredEvent,
  ticketType: TicketType,
): Promise<CompletionResult> {
  const tickets = await ticketsFor(pending)
  let failure: string | null = null

  for (let index = tickets.length; index < pending.quantity; index += 1) {
    try {
      const purchased = await purchaseBackendTicket(event.id, ticketType.id, pending.txRef)
      const ticket = backendTicketToRecord(purchased, {
        userId: pending.userId,
        event,
        ticketType,
        holder: pending.holder,
      })
      tickets.push(ticket)
      addPendingTickets(pending.txRef, [ticket.id])
    } catch (caught) {
      failure = caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'The ticket service could not issue the ticket.'
      break
    }
  }

  const updated = getPendingPayment(pending.txRef) ?? pending

  if (tickets.length >= pending.quantity) {
    markPaymentCompleted(pending.txRef, tickets.map((ticket) => ticket.id))
    return {
      kind: 'success',
      tickets,
      payment: getPendingPayment(pending.txRef) ?? {
        ...updated,
        status: 'completed',
        ticketIds: tickets.map((ticket) => ticket.id),
      },
    }
  }

  const issued = tickets.length
  const message =
    issued > 0
      ? `Your payment (ref ${pending.txRef}) went through. ${issued} of ${pending.quantity} tickets were issued${failure ? `: ${failure}` : '.'} Contact support with this reference for the remaining ticket(s).`
      : `Your payment (ref ${pending.txRef}) went through, but no tickets could be issued${failure ? `: ${failure}` : '.'} Contact support for a refund.`

  if (issued > 0) {
    return { kind: 'partial', tickets, message, eventId: pending.eventId, payment: updated }
  }
  return { kind: 'failed', eventId: pending.eventId, message }
}

async function run(txRef: string): Promise<CompletionResult> {
  const pending = getPendingPayment(txRef)
  if (!pending) return { kind: 'unknown' }

  if (pending.status === 'completed') {
    const tickets = await ticketsFor(pending)
    if (tickets.length < pending.quantity) {
      throw new Error('The backend has not returned all tickets recorded for this payment.')
    }
    return { kind: 'success', tickets, payment: pending }
  }

  const verified = await verifyPayment(txRef)

  if (verified.status === 'pending') return { kind: 'pending' }
  if (verified.status !== 'success') {
    return {
      kind: 'failed',
      eventId: pending.eventId,
      message: 'The payment was not completed. No ticket was issued and you were not charged.',
    }
  }

  if (verified.tx_ref !== pending.txRef) {
    return {
      kind: 'failed',
      eventId: pending.eventId,
      message: 'The backend confirmed a different payment reference. No ticket was issued. Please contact support.',
    }
  }

  let event: StoredEvent
  try {
    event = await fetchBackendEvent(pending.eventId)
  } catch (caught) {
    return {
      kind: 'failed',
      eventId: pending.eventId,
      message: `Payment (ref ${pending.txRef}) was confirmed, but the event details could not be loaded. Please contact support. ${caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : ''}`.trim(),
    }
  }

  const ticketType = event.ticketTypes.find((candidate) => candidate.id === pending.ticketTypeId)
  if (!ticketType) {
    return {
      kind: 'failed',
      eventId: pending.eventId,
      message: `Your payment (ref ${pending.txRef}) went through, but this ticket is no longer available. Please contact support for a refund.`,
    }
  }

  return claimBackendTickets(pending, event, ticketType)
}

export function completePayment(txRef: string): Promise<CompletionResult> {
  const existing = inFlight.get(txRef)
  if (existing) return existing
  const promise = run(txRef).finally(() => inFlight.delete(txRef))
  inFlight.set(txRef, promise)
  return promise
}

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'

interface QuantityStepperProps {
  value: number
  min: number
  max: number
  onChange: (value: number) => void
}

export function QuantityStepper({ value, min, max, onChange }: QuantityStepperProps): ReactNode {
  return (
    <div className="stepper" role="group" aria-label="Ticket quantity">
      <button
        type="button"
        className="stepper-btn"
        onClick={() => onChange(Math.max(min, value - 1))}
        disabled={value <= min}
        aria-label="Decrease quantity"
      >
        âˆ’
      </button>
      <span className="stepper-value" aria-live="polite">
        {value}
      </span>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="stepper-btn"
        onClick={() => onChange(Math.min(max, value + 1))}
        disabled={value >= max}
        aria-label="Increase quantity"
      >
        +
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

import { SERVICE_FEE } from './config'

export interface OrderTotals {
  subtotal: number
  serviceFee: number
  total: number
}

export function formatKwacha(amount: number): string {
  return `MK${Math.round(amount).toLocaleString('en-US')}`
}

export function calculateTotals(
  price: number,
  quantity: number,
  serviceFee: number = SERVICE_FEE,
): OrderTotals {
  const subtotal = price * quantity
  return { subtotal, serviceFee, total: subtotal + serviceFee }
}


================================================================================
FILE: ./src/features/checkout/hooks/useCheckout.ts
================================================================================
import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { fetchBackendEvent } from '../../../lib/backendEvents'
import { remainingSeats } from '../../../types/event'
import {
  createOrder,
  initiatePayment,
  savePendingPayment,
} from '../../../lib/paychangu'
import type { CheckoutInput } from '../types'

export class CheckoutError extends Error {}

// The backend owns the order, reserves stock, starts PayChangu and verifies payment.
async function startPayment(input: CheckoutInput): Promise<never> {
  const stored = await fetchBackendEvent(input.event.id)
  if (!stored || stored.status !== 'Published') {
    throw new CheckoutError('This event is not available for booking.')
  }
  const ticketType = stored.ticketTypes.find((candidate) => candidate.id === input.ticketType.id)
  if (!ticketType) throw new CheckoutError('That ticket type no longer exists.')

  if (input.quantity < 1) throw new CheckoutError('Select at least one ticket.')
  const remaining = remainingSeats(ticketType)
  if (remaining <= 0) throw new CheckoutError(`${ticketType.name} tickets are sold out for this event.`)
  if (input.quantity > remaining) {
    throw new CheckoutError(`Only ${remaining} ${ticketType.name} ticket${remaining === 1 ? '' : 's'} left.`)
  }

  try {
    const order = await createOrder({
      eventId: stored.id,
      ticketTypeId: ticketType.id,
      quantity: input.quantity,
    })
    const { checkout_url: checkoutUrl, tx_ref: txRef } = await initiatePayment(order.orderNumber)
    savePendingPayment({
      txRef,
      orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
      eventId: stored.id,
      ticketTypeId: ticketType.id,
      quantity: input.quantity,
      holder: input.holder,
      userId: input.userId,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: 'pending',
    })
    window.location.assign(checkoutUrl)
  } catch (error) {
    throw new CheckoutError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not start the payment.')
  }

  // keep the button on "Redirectingâ€¦" until the browser leaves the page
  return new Promise<never>(() => {})
}

export function useCheckout() {
  return useMutation({ mutationFn: startPayment })
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { useParams, useSearch, Link } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { calculateTotals, formatKwacha } from '../format'
import { useCheckout } from '../hooks/useCheckout'
import { fetchBackendEvent } from '../../../lib/backendEvents'
import { useAuth } from '../../authentication'
import type { CheckoutEvent, TicketType } from '../types'
import { remainingSeats } from '../../../types/event'

const toCheckoutEvent = (ev: import('../../../types/event').Event): CheckoutEvent => ({
  id: ev.id,
  name: ev.title,
  date: ev.date,
  time: ev.time,
  venue: ev.venue,
  city: ev.city,
  organizer: ev.organizer,
})

const toCheckoutTicketTypes = (ev: import('../../../types/event').Event): TicketType[] =>
  ev.ticketTypes.map((t) => ({ ...t }))


export function CheckoutPage(): ReactNode {
  const { eventId } = useParams({ strict: false }) as { eventId?: string }
  const { type, qty } = useSearch({ strict: false }) as { type?: string; qty?: string }
  const parsedQty = parseInt(qty ?? '', 10)

  const [selectedTypeId, setSelectedTypeId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(() =>
    Number.isNaN(parsedQty) || parsedQty < 1 ? 1 : parsedQty,
  )
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const holder = user?.name ?? ''
  const [clientError, setClientError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const { data: eventData, isLoading, isError } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['checkout-event', eventId],
    queryFn: () => fetchBackendEvent(eventId ?? ''),
    enabled: !!eventId,
  })

  const ticketTypes: TicketType[] = eventData ? toCheckoutTicketTypes(eventData) : []
  const activeTypeId = selectedTypeId ?? type ?? ticketTypes[0]?.id
  const ticketType =
    ticketTypes.find((candidate) => candidate.id === activeTypeId) ?? ticketTypes[0]
  const checkoutEvent: CheckoutEvent = eventData
    ? toCheckoutEvent(eventData)
    : {
        id: eventId ?? 'unknown',
        name: 'Event',
        date: '',
        time: '',
        venue: '',
        city: '',
        organizer: '',
      }

  const checkout = useCheckout()

  const totals = ticketType
    ? calculateTotals(ticketType.price, quantity)
    : { subtotal: 0, serviceFee: 0, total: 0 }
  const remaining = ticketType ? remainingSeats(ticketType) : 0
  const soldOut = remaining <= 0
  const exceedsAvailable = quantity > remaining
  function selectTicketType(id: string) {
    setSelectedTypeId(id)
    setQuantity(1)
    setClientError(null)
  }

  function handlePay() {
    if (!ticketType || !user) return
    setClientError(null)
    // goes to PayChangu; tickets are issued on the return page once the payment is confirmed
    checkout.mutate({
      userId: user.id,
      event: checkoutEvent,
      ticketType,
      quantity,
      holder,
    })
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-24 sm:px-6">
        <div className="h-80 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-slate-100" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (isError || !eventData || eventData.status !== 'Published') {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-24 text-center sm:px-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Event not found</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-slate-600">We couldnâ€™t find this event to check out.</p>
        <Link to="/events" className="mt-6 inline-block rounded-full bg-navy px-6 py-2 text-white">Browse events</Link>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const mutationError = checkout.error instanceof Error ? checkout.error.message : null
  const errorMessage = clientError ?? mutationError
  const blocked = soldOut || exceedsAvailable

  const MAX_PER_ORDER = 10
  const maxQty = Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_PER_ORDER, remaining))
  const canPay = !blocked && !checkout.isPending && !!ticketType

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-50">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-10 sm:px-6">
        <Link to="/events" className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 hover:text-navy">
          â† Back to events
        </Link>
        <h1 className="mt-3 text-3xl font-bold text-navy sm:text-4xl">Confirm your purchase</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-slate-500">Check your order, then pay securely.</p>

        <div className="mt-8 grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_380px]">
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-sm ring-1 ring-slate-200">
              <div className="bg-navy px-6 py-5 text-white">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300">Your event</p>
                <h2 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-white">{checkoutEvent.name}</h2>
                <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-200">
                  {checkoutEvent.date}
                  {checkoutEvent.time ? ` Â· ${checkoutEvent.time}` : ''}
                </p>
                <p className="text-sm text-slate-200">
                  {checkoutEvent.venue}
                  {checkoutEvent.city ? `, ${checkoutEvent.city}` : ''}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-6 p-6">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">Ticket type</h3>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    {ticketTypes.map((option) => {
                      const left = option.capacity - option.sold
                      const disabled = left <= 0
                      const selected = option.id === ticketType?.id
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={option.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => selectTicketType(option.id)}
                          disabled={disabled}
                          aria-pressed={selected}
                          className={`rounded-xl border-2 p-4 text-left transition ${
                            selected
                              ? 'border-navy bg-navy/5'
                              : 'border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300'
                          } ${disabled ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50' : ''}`}
                        >
                          <span className="block font-semibold text-slate-900">{option.name}</span>
                          <span className="mt-1 block text-lg font-bold text-navy">{formatKwacha(option.price)}</span>
                          <span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-slate-500">
                            {disabled ? 'Sold out' : `${left} left`}
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      )
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-t border-slate-100 pt-6">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">Quantity</h3>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Up to {MAX_PER_ORDER} per order</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-label="Decrease quantity"
                      onClick={() => setQuantity((q) => Math.max(1, q - 1))}
                      disabled={quantity <= 1}
                      className="h-10 w-10 rounded-full border border-slate-300 text-lg font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 disabled:opacity-40"
                    >
                      âˆ’

                    >
                      +
                    </button>

                <div className="border-t border-slate-100 pt-6">
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">Ticket holder</h3>
                  <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3 ring-1 ring-slate-200">
                    <span className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-navy text-sm font-bold text-white">
                      {(holder || '?').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="truncate font-medium text-slate-900">{holder}</p>
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{user?.email}</p>

                  </div>
                </div>

            </section>

            {soldOut && ticketType && (

                <b>Sold out.</b> There are no {ticketType.name} tickets left.
              </div>
            )}
            {!soldOut && exceedsAvailable && ticketType && (
              <div role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-700 ring-1 ring-red-200">
                Only {remaining} ticket{remaining === 1 ? '' : 's'} left. Reduce the quantity to continue.
              </div>
            )}
            {errorMessage && (
              <div role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-700 ring-1 ring-red-200">
                {errorMessage}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <aside className="lg:sticky lg:top-6 lg:self-start">
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-slate-200">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-navy">Order summary</h2>
              <dl className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-sm">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-600">
                  <dt>
                    {quantity} Ã— {ticketType?.name ?? 'Ticket'}
                  </dt>
                  <dd className="font-medium text-slate-900">{formatKwacha(totals.subtotal)}</dd>
                </div>

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Link, useNavigate, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { latestPendingPayment } from '../../../lib/paychangu'
import { completePayment, type CompletionResult } from '../completePayment'
import { TicketConfirmation } from '../components/TicketConfirmation'

const RETRY_EVERY_MS = 3000
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 10

// PayChangu sends the customer here after paying (or giving up). We never trust the URL:
// we ask PayChangu (through our server) whether the payment really succeeded.
export function PaymentReturnPage(): ReactNode {
  const search = useSearch({ strict: false }) as { tx_ref?: unknown; status?: unknown }
  const txRef = search.tx_ref !== undefined ? String(search.tx_ref) : latestPendingPayment()?.txRef
  const returnedStatus = typeof search.status === 'string' ? search.status.toLowerCase() : ''

  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const [result, setResult] = useState<CompletionResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!txRef) return
    let active = true
    let timer: number | undefined

    completePayment(txRef)
      .then((outcome) => {
        if (!active) return
        setError(null)
        setResult(outcome)
        if (outcome.kind === 'success' || outcome.kind === 'partial') {
          for (const key of ['events', 'checkout-event', 'tickets', 'bookings']) {
            queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [key] })
          }
        }
        if (outcome.kind === 'pending' && attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
          timer = window.setTimeout(() => setAttempt((n) => n + 1), RETRY_EVERY_MS)
        }
      })
      .catch((caught: unknown) => {
        if (!active) return
        setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Could not confirm the payment.')
      })

    return () => {
      active = false
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer)
    }
  }, [txRef, attempt, queryClient])

  if (!txRef || result?.kind === 'unknown') {
    return (
      <Notice title="We couldn't find your order">
        <p className="m">
          This payment was not started from this browser, so we can't match it to an order. If money left your
          account, contact support with your PayChangu receipt.
        </p>
        <Link to="/events" className="btn">Browse events</Link>
      </Notice>
    )
  }

  if (result?.kind === 'success') {
    return <TicketConfirmation tickets={result.tickets} onBuyAgain={() => navigate({ to: '/events' })} />
  }

  if (result?.kind === 'partial') {
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="alert error" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
          <p>{result.message}</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="btn o"
            style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
            onClick={() => {
              setResult(null)
              setAttempt((n) => n + 1)
            }}
          >
            Try missing tickets
          </button>
        </div>
        <TicketConfirmation tickets={result.tickets} onBuyAgain={() => navigate({ to: '/events' })} />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (result?.kind === 'failed' || (returnedStatus === 'failed' && !result)) {
    const failed = result?.kind === 'failed' ? result : null
    return (
      <Notice title="Payment not completed">
        <div className="alert error">
          {failed?.message ?? 'The payment was cancelled or failed. No ticket was issued.'}
        </div>
        {failed?.eventId ? (
          <Link to="/checkout/$eventId" params={{ eventId: failed.eventId }} className="btn">Try again</Link>
        ) : (
          <Link to="/events" className="btn">Browse events</Link>
        )}
      </Notice>
    )
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <Notice title="We couldn't confirm your payment yet">
        <div className="alert error">{error}</div>
        <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => setAttempt((n) => n + 1)}>
          Check again
        </button>
      </Notice>
    )
  }

  const waitedTooLong = result?.kind === 'pending' && attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS
  return (
    <Notice title={waitedTooLong ? 'Still waiting for confirmation' : 'Confirming your paymentâ€¦'}>
      <p className="m">
        {waitedTooLong
          ? 'PayChangu has not confirmed the payment yet. If you approved it on your phone, check again in a moment.'
          : 'Please wait while we confirm the payment with PayChangu. Do not close this page.'}
      </p>
      {waitedTooLong && (
        <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={() => setAttempt(0)}>
          Check again
        </button>
      )}
    </Notice>
  )
}

function Notice({ title, children }: { title: string; children: ReactNode }): ReactNode {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-xl px-4 py-24 text-center sm:px-6">
      <div className="card" style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 12, justifyItems: 'center' }}>
        <h1>{title}</h1>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

                    max={remaining}
                    value={qty}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const val = parseInt(e.target.value, 10)
                      setQuantity(Number.isNaN(val) ? 1 : Math.min(Math.max(1, val), remaining))
                    }}
                    className="w-16 rounded-xl border bg-white px-2 py-1 text-center"
                    disabled={remaining <= 0}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setQuantity((q) => Math.min(remaining, q + 1))}
                    className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full border bg-white hover:bg-slate-100"
                    disabled={remaining <= 0 || qty >= remaining}
                  >
                    +
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="border-t pt-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-slate-600">Total</span>
                  <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-navy">{formatMoney(total)}</span>
                </div>
                <Link
                  to={checkoutLink}
                  className={`mt-4 block w-full rounded-xl py-3 text-center font-semibold text-white transition ${
                    canBuy ? 'bg-navy hover:bg-navy-dark' : 'cursor-not-allowed bg-slate-400'
                  }`}
                  aria-disabled={!canBuy}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    if (!canBuy) e.preventDefault()
                  }}
                >
                  {selectedType && remaining <= 0 ? 'Sold out' : 'Buy ticket'}
                </Link>
                <p className="mt-2 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Youâ€™ll be asked to sign in if youâ€™re not logged in.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Reveal>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useNavigate, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { filtersFromSearch, filterEvents, searchFromFilters, type Filters } from '../../landing/filters'
import { useEvents } from '../hooks/useEvents'
import EventCard from '../../landing/components/EventCard'
import SearchBar from '../../landing/components/SearchBar'
import Reveal from '../../../components/Reveal'

export function EventsPage() {
  const search = useSearch({ from: '/events' })
  const navigate = useNavigate({ from: '/events' })
  const filters = filtersFromSearch(search)
  const { data: events = [], isLoading, isError } = useEvents()
  const visibleEvents = filterEvents(events, filters)

  function setFilters(next: Filters, options?: { replace?: boolean }) {
    navigate({ search: searchFromFilters(next), replace: options?.replace })
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen">
      <section className="bg-navy-50 py-12 pt-24">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6">
          <Reveal>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold sm:text-4xl">Discover Events</h1>
            <p className="mt-2">
              {isLoading ? 'Loading events...' : `${visibleEvents.length} event(s) found`}
            </p>
          </Reveal>

          <div className="mt-8">
            <SearchBar filters={filters} setFilters={setFilters} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="events" className="py-12">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6">
          {isLoading && (
            <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => (
                <div key={n} className="h-80 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-slate-100" />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {isError && (
            <p className="rounded-2xl bg-red-50 p-6 text-center text-red-700">
              Could not load events. Please try again.
            </p>
          )}

          {!isLoading && visibleEvents.length === 0 && (
            <p className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-10 text-center">
              No events match your search. Try adjusting the filters.
            </p>
          )}

          {!isLoading && visibleEvents.length > 0 && (
            <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
              {visibleEvents.map((event, i) => (
                <Reveal key={event.id} delay={(i % 3) * 100}>
                  <EventCard event={event} />
                </Reveal>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: ./src/features/landing/components/Contact.tsx
================================================================================
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Mail, MapPin, Phone, Check } from 'lucide-react'
import Reveal from '../../../components/Reveal'
import { api } from '../../../lib/backend'

const details = [
  { icon: MapPin, text: 'Lilongwe, Central Region, Malawi' },
  { icon: Phone, text: '+265 999 000 000' },
  { icon: Mail, text: 'support@ticketmaster.mw' },
]

const inputStyle = 'w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-navy'
const emptyForm = { name: '', email: '', subject: '', message: '', website: '' }

// Contact section. The message is saved by the backend (POST /contact).
export default function Contact() {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false)

  const set = (key: keyof typeof emptyForm) => (e: { target: { value: string } }) =>
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: e.target.value }))

  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setError(null)
    if (form.name.trim().length < 2) return setError('Enter your name.')
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim())) return setError('Enter a valid email address.')
    if (form.message.trim().length < 5) return setError('Write a message of at least 5 characters.')
    setSending(true)
    try {
      const subject = form.subject.trim()
      await api('/contact', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          name: form.name.trim(),
          email: form.email.trim(),
          message: subject ? `${subject}\n\n${form.message.trim()}` : form.message.trim(),
          website: form.website,
        },
      })
      setForm(emptyForm)
      setSent(true)
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not send your message.')
    } finally {
      setSending(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <section id="contact" className="py-20">
      <div className="mx-auto grid max-w-7xl gap-10 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <Reveal>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-navy">Contact us</p>
          <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-extrabold sm:text-4xl">Let's talk about your event</h2>
          <p className="mt-4">Have a question about tickets, or want to host an event? Send us a message and we will reply within 24 hours.</p>
          <ul className="mt-8 space-y-4">
            {details.map((d) => (
              <li key={d.text} className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <span className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-navy-50 text-navy"><d.icon size={20} /></span>
                {d.text}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Reveal>

        <Reveal delay={150}>
          {sent ? (
            <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-3xl bg-navy-50 p-10 text-center">
              <Check size={56} className="text-navy" />
              <h3 className="mt-4 text-2xl font-bold">Message sent!</h3>
              <p className="mt-2">Thank you, we will get back to you soon.</p>
              <button onClick={() => setSent(false)} className="mt-6 font-semibold text-navy">Send another message</button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="space-y-4 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 bg-white p-6 shadow-xl sm:p-8">
              <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <input placeholder="Your name" aria-label="Your name" value={form.name} onChange={set('name')} className={inputStyle} />
                <input type="email" placeholder="Email address" aria-label="Email address" value={form.email} onChange={set('email')} className={inputStyle} />
              </div>
              <input placeholder="Subject" aria-label="Subject" value={form.subject} onChange={set('subject')} className={inputStyle} />
              <textarea rows={5} placeholder="Your message" aria-label="Your message" value={form.message} onChange={set('message')} className={inputStyle} />
              <input
                tabIndex={-1}
                autoComplete="off"
                aria-hidden="true"
                value={form.website}
                onChange={set('website')}
                style={{ position: 'absolute', left: '-9999px', height: 0, width: 0, opacity: 0 }}
              />
              {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
              <button type="submit" disabled={sending} className="w-full rounded-xl bg-navy py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-navy-dark disabled:opacity-60">
                {sending ? 'Sending...' : 'Send message'}
              </button>
            </form>
          )}
        </Reveal>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

FILE: ./src/features/landing/components/EventCard.tsx

import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { Calendar, MapPin } from 'lucide-react'
import { remainingSeats, type Event, type TicketType } from '../../../types/event'

interface EventCardProps {
  event: Event
}

const MAX_SHOWN = 3

function money(amount: number): string {
  return amount === 0 ? 'Free' : `MK ${amount.toLocaleString()}`
}

// The price line: one price, or "From X" when the ticket types differ, so nobody is surprised.
function priceSummary(types: TicketType[]): { label: string; value: string } {
  if (types.length === 0) return { label: '', value: 'Tickets soon' }
  const prices = types.map((type) => type.price)
  const low = Math.min(...prices)
  const high = Math.max(...prices)
  if (low === high) return { label: '', value: money(low) }
  return { label: 'From', value: money(low) }
}

export default function EventCard({ event }: EventCardProps) {
  const date = new Date(event.date).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  })
  const types = [...event.ticketTypes].sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price)
  const shown = types.slice(0, MAX_SHOWN)
  const hidden = types.length - shown.length
  const summary = priceSummary(types)

  return (
    <Link
      to="/events/$eventId"
      params={{ eventId: String(event.id) }}
      className="group block overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white shadow-sm transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-2xl"
    >
      <div className="relative h-52 overflow-hidden">
        <img
          src={event.image}
          alt={event.title}
          loading="lazy"
          className="h-full w-full object-cover transition duration-500 group-hover:scale-110"
        />
        {event.category && (
          <span className="absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-white px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-navy">
            {event.category}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="p-5">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold group-hover:text-navy">{event.title}</h3>
        <p className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
          <Calendar size={15} /> {date}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
          <MapPin size={15} /> {event.venue}, {event.city}
        </p>

        {shown.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="mt-4 space-y-1.5 border-t pt-4" aria-label="Ticket types">
            {shown.map((type) => {
              const soldOut = remainingSeats(type) === 0
              return (
                <li key={type.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
                  <span className={soldOut ? 'text-slate-400 line-through' : 'font-medium text-slate-700'}>
                    {type.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className={soldOut ? 'text-xs font-semibold text-red-600' : 'font-semibold text-navy'}>
                    {soldOut ? 'Sold out' : money(type.price)}
                  </span>
                </li>
              )
            })}
            {hidden > 0 && <li className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">+{hidden} more ticket {hidden === 1 ? 'type' : 'types'}</li>}
          </ul>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between border-t pt-4">
          <span className="text-lg font-extrabold text-navy">
            {summary.label && <span className="mr-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-slate-500">{summary.label}</span>}
            {summary.value}
          </span>
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-navy">View event â†’</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Link>
  )
}

FILE: ./src/features/landing/components/HeroSlider.tsx

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Pause, Play } from 'lucide-react'
import { useEvents } from '../../events/hooks/useEvents'
import SearchBar from './SearchBar'
import type { Filters } from '../filters'
import { useAutoplay } from '../hooks/useAutoplay'

interface HeroSliderProps {
  filters: Filters
  setFilters: (f: Filters, options?: { replace?: boolean }) => void
  onShowAll?: (filters: Filters) => void
}

export default function HeroSlider({ filters, setFilters, onShowAll }: HeroSliderProps) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0)
  // The slides are the next published events from the backend. With none, one welcome slide is shown.
  const { data: events = [] } = useEvents()
  const heroSlides = events.length > 0
    ? events
        .slice()
        .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
        .slice(0, 5)
        .map((event) => ({
          image: event.image,
          title: event.title,
          text: [event.venue, event.date].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· '),
        }))
    : [{ image: '/images/hero/hero-1.png', title: 'Ticket Master', text: 'Discover events happening near you' }]
  const total = heroSlides.length

  const goTo = useCallback(
    (index: number) => setCurrent((index + total) % total),
    [total],
  )

  // Auto-advance stops on hover, keyboard focus, reduced motion, or when the
  // visitor presses pause (WCAG 2.2.2).
  const next = useCallback(() => goTo(current + 1), [goTo, current])
  const { paused, reducedMotion, togglePause, handlers } = useAutoplay(6000, next)

  const arrowStyle =
    'absolute top-1/2 z-10 hidden h-12 w-12 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-white/40 sm:flex'

  return (
    <section className="relative min-h-screen bg-navy-dark" {...handlers}>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden">
        {heroSlides.map((slide, i) => (
          <img
            key={`slide-${i}`}
            src={slide.image}
            alt={slide.title}
            aria-hidden={i !== current}
            className={`absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover transition-all duration-1500 motion-reduce:transition-none ${
              i === current ? 'scale-105 opacity-100' : 'scale-100 opacity-0'
            }`}
          />
        ))}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-b from-navy-dark/70 via-navy-dark/50 to-navy-dark/80" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-20 mx-auto flex min-h-screen max-w-5xl flex-col items-center justify-center px-4 pb-20 pt-28 text-center">
        <div key={current} className="fade-up">
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-extrabold text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-7xl">
            {heroSlides[current % total].title}
          </h1>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-4 max-w-2xl text-base text-white/85 sm:text-xl">
            {heroSlides[current % total].text}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-10 w-full">
          <SearchBar filters={filters} setFilters={setFilters} onShowAll={onShowAll} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <button aria-label="Previous slide" onClick={() => goTo(current - 1)} className={`${arrowStyle} left-4`}>
        <ChevronLeft />
      </button>
      <button aria-label="Next slide" onClick={() => goTo(current + 1)} className={`${arrowStyle} right-4`}>
        <ChevronRight />
      </button>

      <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-0 right-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
        {!reducedMotion && (
          <button
            aria-label={paused ? 'Resume hero slideshow' : 'Pause hero slideshow'}
            onClick={togglePause}
            className="mr-2 flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white backdrop-blur-sm hover:bg-white/40"
          >
            {paused ? <Play size={14} /> : <Pause size={14} />}
          </button>
        )}
        {heroSlides.map((_, i) => (
          <button
            key={i}
            aria-label={`Slide ${i + 1}`}
            onClick={() => setCurrent(i)}
            className={`h-2 rounded-full transition-all ${i === current ? 'w-8 bg-white' : 'w-2 bg-white/50'}`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}

  const { createElement } = await import('react')
  return {
    Link: ({ children, to, params, ...rest }: Record<string, unknown>) =>
      createElement('a', { href: to as string, ...rest }, children as never),
  }

vi.mock('../../events', () => ({ useEvents: () => ({ data: mocks.events }) }))

vi.mock('../filters', () => ({
  categories: ['All', 'Music', 'Sports'],
  cities: ['All'],
  priceOptions: [{ value: 'all', label: 'Any price' }],
  sortOptions: [{ value: 'date', label: 'Date' }],
  defaultFilters: { search: '', category: 'All', city: 'All', price: 'all', sort: 'date' },
  filterEvents: (events: { title: string }[], f: { search: string }) =>
    events.filter((e) => e.title.toLowerCase().includes(f.search.trim().toLowerCase())),
}))

function Harness() {
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<Filters>(defaultFilters)
  return <SearchBar filters={filters} setFilters={setFilters} />
}

describe('SearchBar combobox', () => {
  let container: HTMLDivElement
  let root: Root

  const input = () => container.querySelector('input') as HTMLInputElement
  const options = () => [...container.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')] as HTMLElement[]

  function typeText(value: string) {
    const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value')?.set
    act(() => {
      setter?.call(input(), value)
      input().dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))
    })
  }

  function press(target: HTMLElement, key: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}) {
    act(() => {
      target.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...init }))
    })
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    container = document.createElement('div')
    document.body.appendChild(container)
    root = createRoot(container)
    act(() => root.render(<Harness />))
  })

  afterEach(() => {
    act(() => root.unmount())
    container.remove()
  })

  it('gives the input a name and combobox state', () => {
    expect(input().getAttribute('role')).toBe('combobox')
    expect(input().getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Search events')
    expect(input().getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')

    typeText('lake')
    expect(input().getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true')
    expect(container.querySelector('[role=listbox]')?.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Search results')
    expect(input().getAttribute('aria-controls')).toBe(container.querySelector('[role=listbox]')?.id)
    // 2 matching events + the "See all" option
    expect(options()).toHaveLength(3)
  })

  it('announces the result count', () => {
    typeText('lake')
    expect(container.querySelector('[role=status]')?.textContent).toBe('2 events found')
    typeText('zomba')
    expect(container.querySelector('[role=status]')?.textContent).toBe('1 event found')
    typeText('nothing')
    expect(container.querySelector('[role=status]')?.textContent).toBe('No events found for nothing')
  })

  it('moves focus with the arrow keys', () => {
    typeText('lake')
    act(() => input().focus())

    press(input(), 'ArrowDown')
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(options()[0])
    expect(options()[0].getAttribute('aria-selected')).toBe('true')
    expect(options()[1].getAttribute('aria-selected')).toBe('false')

    press(options()[0], 'ArrowDown')
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(options()[1])
    expect(options()[1].getAttribute('aria-selected')).toBe('true')

    press(options()[1], 'ArrowUp')
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(options()[0])

    // up from the first option returns to the input
    press(options()[0], 'ArrowUp')
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(input())
  })

  it('closes with Escape and returns focus to the input', () => {
    typeText('lake')
    act(() => input().focus())
    press(input(), 'ArrowDown')
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(options()[0])

    press(options()[0], 'Escape')
    expect(container.querySelector('[role=listbox]')).toBeNull()
    expect(input().getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')
    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(input())
  })

  it('closes the list with Tab', () => {
    typeText('lake')
    act(() => input().focus())
    press(input(), 'Tab')
    expect(container.querySelector('[role=listbox]')).toBeNull()
  })

  it('shows which category chip is selected and the filters state', () => {
    const trigger = container.querySelector('[aria-label=Filters]') as HTMLButtonElement
    expect(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('false')

    act(() => trigger.click())
    expect(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded')).toBe('true')
    expect(container.querySelector('[role=dialog]')?.getAttribute('aria-label')).toBe('Filters')

    const chip = (name: string) =>
      [...container.querySelectorAll('[aria-pressed]')].find((b) => b.textContent === name) as HTMLElement
    expect(chip('All').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true')
    expect(chip('Music').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('false')

    act(() => chip('Music').click())
    expect(chip('Music').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('true')
    expect(chip('All').getAttribute('aria-pressed')).toBe('false')
  })
})

FILE: ./src/features/landing/components/SearchBar.tsx

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ChangeEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react'
import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { Search, SlidersHorizontal } from 'lucide-react'
import { useEvents } from '../../events'
import {
  categories,
  cities,
  priceOptions,
  sortOptions,
  defaultFilters,
  filterEvents,
  type Filters,
} from '../filters'

const selectStyle =
  'mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-normal text-slate-700 outline-none focus:border-navy'

interface HighlightProps {
  text: string
  word: string
}

function Highlight({ text, word }: HighlightProps) {
  const start = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(word.toLowerCase())
  if (!word || start === -1) return <>{text}</>
  const end = start + word.length
  return (
    <>
      {text.slice(0, start)}
      <b className="text-navy">{text.slice(start, end)}</b>
      {text.slice(end)}
    </>
  )
}

interface SearchBarProps {
  filters: Filters
  setFilters: (f: Filters, options?: { replace?: boolean }) => void
  onShowAll?: (filters: Filters) => void
}

type OpenBox = 'none' | 'filters' | 'results'

const MAX_RESULTS = 5

// Search box with a results list. It follows the ARIA "combobox" pattern:
//   - the input announces itself as a combobox and says if the list is open
//   - the results are a listbox of options; Arrow keys move focus through them
//   - Enter opens the focused option, Escape closes and returns to the input,
//     Tab closes the list
//   - a hidden live region announces how many events were found
export default function SearchBar({ filters, setFilters, onShowAll }: SearchBarProps) {
  const [openBox, setOpenBox] = useState<OpenBox>('none')
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1)
  const wrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const { data: events = [] } = useEvents()

  // unique ids so two search bars on one page never clash
  const uid = useId()
  const resultsId = `${uid}-results`
  const filtersId = `${uid}-filters`
  const optionPrefix = `${uid}-option-`

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(target)) {
        setOpenBox('none')
        setActiveIndex(-1)
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClick)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClick)
  }, [])

  const update = (name: keyof Filters, value: string, options?: { replace?: boolean }) =>
    setFilters({ ...filters, [name]: value }, options)

  const handleTyping = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    // Typeahead replaces the current entry; committed filters push a new one.
    update('search', e.target.value, { replace: true })
    setOpenBox(e.target.value.trim() ? 'results' : 'none')
    setActiveIndex(-1)
  }

  const activeCount = (['category', 'city', 'price'] as const).filter(
    (name) => filters[name] !== defaultFilters[name],
  ).length

  const matches = filterEvents(events, filters)
  const shown = matches.slice(0, MAX_RESULTS)
  // every shown event is an option, plus one last "See all" option
  const optionCount = matches.length > 0 ? shown.length + 1 : 0
  const word = filters.search.trim()

  const closeBox = (restoreFocus = false) => {
    setOpenBox('none')
    setActiveIndex(-1)
    if (restoreFocus) inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true })
  }

  const goToEvents = (restoreFocus = false) => {
    closeBox(restoreFocus)
    if (onShowAll) {
      onShowAll(filters)
      return
    }
    document.getElementById('events')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })
  }

  const focusOption = (index: number) => document.getElementById(`${optionPrefix}${index}`)?.focus()

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement
    const onInput = target === inputRef.current
    const optionIndex = target.id.startsWith(optionPrefix)
      ? Number(target.id.slice(optionPrefix.length))
      : -1
    const onOption = optionIndex !== -1

    // Escape closes whichever panel is open and goes back to the input
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && openBox !== 'none') {
      e.preventDefault()
      closeBox(true)
      return
    }

    if (openBox === 'results' && optionCount > 0) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        e.preventDefault()
        focusOption(onOption ? Math.min(optionIndex + 1, optionCount - 1) : 0)
        return
      }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault()
        if (onInput) focusOption(optionCount - 1)
        else if (optionIndex <= 0) inputRef.current?.focus()
        else focusOption(optionIndex - 1)
        return
      }
      if (onOption && e.key === 'Home') {
        e.preventDefault()
        focusOption(0)
        return
      }
      if (onOption && e.key === 'End') {
        e.preventDefault()
        focusOption(optionCount - 1)
        return
      }
      // typing while an option has focus: go back to the input so typing continues
      if (onOption && (e.key === 'Backspace' || (e.key.length === 1 && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey))) {
        inputRef.current?.focus()
        return
      }
    }

    // Tab closes the results list
    if (e.key === 'Tab' && openBox === 'results') {
      if (onOption) {
        if (e.shiftKey) e.preventDefault()
        // focus goes back to the input; Tab then moves on from there
        inputRef.current?.focus()
      }
      closeBox()
      return
    }

    // ArrowDown in the input reopens the list for the current search text
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && onInput && openBox === 'none' && word) {
      e.preventDefault()
      setOpenBox('results')
    }
  }

  // read out by screen readers when the number of results changes
  const resultsCount = `${matches.length} event${matches.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} found`
  const statusText =
    openBox === 'results' ? (matches.length === 0 ? `No events found for ${word}` : resultsCount) : ''

  return (
    <div ref={wrapperRef} onKeyDown={handleKeyDown} className="relative mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl">
      <form
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          goToEvents()
        }}
        className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-white p-2 pl-5 shadow-2xl"
      >
        <Search size={20} className="shrink-0 text-slate-400" />
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          role="combobox"
          aria-label="Search events"
          aria-expanded={openBox === 'results'}
          aria-controls={resultsId}
          aria-autocomplete="list"
          autoComplete="off"
          value={filters.search}
          onChange={handleTyping}
          onFocus={() => setActiveIndex(-1)}
          placeholder="Search concerts, sports, workshops..."
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent py-2 text-sm text-slate-700 outline-none sm:text-base"
        />

        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label="Filters"
          aria-expanded={openBox === 'filters'}
          aria-controls={filtersId}
          aria-haspopup="dialog"
          onClick={() => setOpenBox(openBox === 'filters' ? 'none' : 'filters')}
          className={`relative flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full ${
            openBox === 'filters' ? 'bg-navy text-white' : 'bg-navy-50 text-navy hover:bg-navy-100'
          }`}
        >
          <SlidersHorizontal size={20} />
          {activeCount > 0 && (
            <span className="absolute -right-1 -top-1 flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-navy-dark text-[11px] font-bold text-white">
              {activeCount}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>

        <button
          type="submit"
          className="hidden h-11 rounded-full bg-navy px-6 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-navy-dark sm:block"
        >
          Search
        </button>
      </form>

      <div role="status" aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
        {statusText}
      </div>

      {openBox === 'results' && (
        <div
          id={resultsId}
          role={matches.length > 0 ? 'listbox' : undefined}
          aria-label={matches.length > 0 ? 'Search results' : undefined}
          className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-30 mt-3 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl bg-white p-2 text-left shadow-2xl"
        >
          {matches.length === 0 && <p className="p-4 text-sm">No events found for "{word}"</p>}

          {shown.map((event, i) => (
            <Link
              key={event.id}
              id={`${optionPrefix}${i}`}
              role="option"
              aria-selected={activeIndex === i}
              tabIndex={-1}
              onFocus={() => setActiveIndex(i)}
              to="/events/$eventId"
              params={{ eventId: String(event.id) }}
              onClick={() => closeBox()}
              className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-2 hover:bg-navy-50 focus:bg-navy-50 focus:outline-2 focus:outline-navy"
            >
              <img src={event.image} alt="" className="h-12 w-12 rounded-lg object-cover" />
              <span>
                <span className="block font-semibold text-slate-700">
                  <Highlight text={event.title} word={word} />
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs">
                  {event.category} Â· {event.city}
                </span>
              </span>
            </Link>
          ))}

          {matches.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              id={`${optionPrefix}${shown.length}`}
              role="option"
              aria-selected={activeIndex === shown.length}
              tabIndex={-1}
              onFocus={() => setActiveIndex(shown.length)}
              onClick={(e) => goToEvents(e.detail === 0)}
              className="w-full rounded-xl p-3 text-sm font-semibold text-navy hover:bg-navy-50 focus:bg-navy-50 focus:outline-2 focus:outline-navy"
            >
              See all {matches.length} result(s)
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {openBox === 'filters' && (
        <div
          id={filtersId}
          role="dialog"
          aria-label="Filters"
          className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full z-30 mt-3 max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 text-left shadow-2xl"
        >
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-navy-dark">Category</p>
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {categories.map((c) => (
              <button
                key={c}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={filters.category === c}
                onClick={() => update('category', c)}
                className={`rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium ${
                  filters.category === c ? 'bg-navy text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                }`}
              >
                {c}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-navy-dark">
              City
              <select value={filters.city} onChange={(e) => update('city', e.target.value)} className={selectStyle}>
                {cities.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c}>{c}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-navy-dark">
              Price
              <select value={filters.price} onChange={(e) => update('price', e.target.value)} className={selectStyle}>
                {priceOptions.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.value} value={p.value}>
                    {p.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-navy-dark">
              Sort by
              <select value={filters.sort} onChange={(e) => update('sort', e.target.value)} className={selectStyle}>
                {sortOptions.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s.value} value={s.value}>
                    {s.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilters(defaultFilters)}
              className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-navy"
            >
              Reset all
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => goToEvents(e.detail === 0)}
              className="rounded-full bg-navy px-6 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-navy-dark"
            >
              Show {matches.length} event(s)
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import {
  defaultFilters,
  filtersFromSearch,
  searchFromFilters,
  validateEventSearch,
} from './filters'

describe('event search params', () => {
  it('keeps valid non-default filters', () => {
    expect(
      validateEventSearch({
        search: 'jazz',
        category: 'Concerts',
        city: 'Lilongwe',
        price: 'under20',
        sort: 'low',
      }),
    ).toEqual({
      search: 'jazz',
      category: 'Concerts',
      city: 'Lilongwe',
      price: 'under20',
      sort: 'low',
    })
  })

  it('omits defaults so the URL stays clean', () => {
    expect(
      validateEventSearch({
        search: '',
        category: 'All',
        city: 'All cities',
        price: 'any',
        sort: 'date',
      }),
    ).toEqual({})
  })

  it('falls back to defaults for invalid values', () => {
    expect(validateEventSearch({ category: 'Wat', city: 'Atlantis', price: 'cheap', sort: 'random' })).toEqual(
      {},
    )

    const filters = filtersFromSearch(validateEventSearch({ category: 'Wat' }))
    expect(filters).toEqual(defaultFilters)
  })

  it('round-trips a full filter state through the URL', () => {
    const filters = {
      search: 'lake',
      category: 'Festivals',
      city: 'Mangochi',
      price: 'under20',
      sort: 'high',
    }
    const url = searchFromFilters(filters)
    expect(filtersFromSearch(validateEventSearch(url))).toEqual(filters)
  })

  it('turns a reset into an empty search object', () => {
    expect(searchFromFilters(defaultFilters)).toEqual({})
  })
})

FILE: ./src/features/landing/filters.ts
================================================================================
import { fromPrice, type Event } from '../../types/event'

export const categories = ['All', 'Concerts', 'Sports', 'Festivals', 'Workshops', 'Community']
export const cities = ['All cities', 'Lilongwe', 'Blantyre', 'Mzuzu', 'Zomba', 'Mangochi', 'Salima']

export const priceOptions = [
  { value: 'any', label: 'Any price' },
  { value: 'free', label: 'Free' },
  { value: 'under10', label: 'Under MK 10,000' },
  { value: 'under20', label: 'Under MK 20,000' },
  { value: 'over20', label: 'MK 20,000 and above' },
]

export const sortOptions = [
  { value: 'date', label: 'Soonest first' },
  { value: 'low', label: 'Price: low to high' },
  { value: 'high', label: 'Price: high to low' },
]

export interface Filters {
  search: string
  category: string
  city: string
  price: string
  sort: string
}

export const defaultFilters: Filters = {
  search: '',
  category: 'All',
  city: 'All cities',
  price: 'any',
  sort: 'date',
}

// The URL only carries non-default filters, so links stay short and readable.
export type EventSearch = Partial<Filters>

const priceValues = priceOptions.map((option) => option.value)
const sortValues = sortOptions.map((option) => option.value)

function picked(value: unknown, allowed: readonly string[]): string | undefined {
  return typeof value === 'string' && allowed.includes(value) ? value : undefined
}

// validateSearch for both `/` and `/events`. Unknown or invalid values are
// dropped, which makes them fall back to the defaults instead of breaking.
export function validateEventSearch(raw: Record<string, unknown>): EventSearch {
  const search: EventSearch = {}

  if (typeof raw.search === 'string' && raw.search !== '') {
    search.search = raw.search
  }

  const category = picked(raw.category, categories)
  if (category && category !== defaultFilters.category) search.category = category

  const city = picked(raw.city, cities)
  if (city && city !== defaultFilters.city) search.city = city

  const price = picked(raw.price, priceValues)
  if (price && price !== defaultFilters.price) search.price = price

  const sort = picked(raw.sort, sortValues)
  if (sort && sort !== defaultFilters.sort) search.sort = sort

  return search
}

// Merge partial URL state with the defaults for filtering/sorting.
export function filtersFromSearch(search: EventSearch): Filters {
  return {
    search: search.search ?? defaultFilters.search,
    category: search.category ?? defaultFilters.category,
    city: search.city ?? defaultFilters.city,
    price: search.price ?? defaultFilters.price,
    sort: search.sort ?? defaultFilters.sort,
  }
}

// Turn the full filter state back into a clean search object.
export function searchFromFilters(filters: Filters): EventSearch {
  const search: EventSearch = {}
  if (filters.search !== '') search.search = filters.search
  if (filters.category !== defaultFilters.category) search.category = filters.category
  if (filters.city !== defaultFilters.city) search.city = filters.city
  if (filters.price !== defaultFilters.price) search.price = filters.price
  if (filters.sort !== defaultFilters.sort) search.sort = filters.sort
  return search
}

function matchesPrice(price: number, option: string): boolean {
  if (option === 'free') return price === 0
  if (option === 'under10') return price < 10000
  if (option === 'under20') return price < 20000
  if (option === 'over20') return price >= 20000
  return true
}

export function filterEvents(events: Event[], filters: Filters): Event[] {
  const search = filters.search.trim().toLowerCase()

  return events
    .filter((e) => filters.category === 'All' || e.category === filters.category)
    .filter((e) => filters.city === 'All cities' || e.city === filters.city)
    .filter((e) => matchesPrice(fromPrice(e), filters.price))
    .filter((e) =>
      `${e.title} ${e.city} ${e.venue} ${e.category}`.toLowerCase().includes(search),
    )
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (filters.sort === 'low') return fromPrice(a) - fromPrice(b)
      if (filters.sort === 'high') return fromPrice(b) - fromPrice(a)
      return new Date(a.date).getTime() - new Date(b.date).getTime()
    })
}

// @vitest-environment jsdom
import { act, useCallback, useState } from 'react'
import { createRoot, type Root } from 'react-dom/client'
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { useAutoplay } from './useAutoplay'

;(globalThis as { IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT?: boolean }).IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true

let advanced = 0
let latest: ReturnType<typeof useAutoplay> | undefined

// tiny stand-in for a carousel: every advance changes `n`, like a new slide
function Probe() {
  const [n, setN] = useState(0)
  const advance = useCallback(() => {
    advanced += 1
    setN(n + 1)
  }, [n])
  latest = useAutoplay(1000, advance)
  return null
}

function mockMotionPreference(reduce: boolean) {
  window.matchMedia = (query: string) =>
    ({
      matches: reduce,
      media: query,
      addEventListener: () => {},
      removeEventListener: () => {},
    }) as unknown as MediaQueryList
}

describe('useAutoplay', () => {
  let container: HTMLDivElement
  let root: Root

  function mount() {
    container = document.createElement('div')
    root = createRoot(container)
    act(() => root.render(<Probe />))
  }

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.useFakeTimers()
    advanced = 0
    latest = undefined
    mockMotionPreference(false)
  })

  afterEach(() => {
    act(() => root.unmount())
    vi.useRealTimers()
  })

  it('advances after the delay', () => {
    mount()
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000)
    })
    expect(advanced).toBe(1)
  })

  it('stops while the user has paused and continues on resume', () => {
    mount()
    act(() => latest?.togglePause())
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(5000)
    })
    expect(advanced).toBe(0)

    act(() => latest?.togglePause())
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000)
    })
    expect(advanced).toBe(1)
  })

  it('stops while the mouse is over the carousel', () => {
    mount()
    act(() => latest?.handlers.onMouseEnter())
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(5000)
    })
    expect(advanced).toBe(0)

    act(() => latest?.handlers.onMouseLeave())
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(1000)
    })
    expect(advanced).toBe(1)
  })

  it('never advances when reduced motion is requested', () => {
    mockMotionPreference(true)
    mount()
    act(() => {
      vi.advanceTimersByTime(10000)
    })
    expect(advanced).toBe(0)
    expect(latest?.reducedMotion).toBe(true)
  })
})

FILE: ./src/features/landing/hooks/useAutoplay.ts
================================================================================
import { useEffect, useState, type FocusEvent } from 'react'

// true when the visitor asked their device for less motion
function usePrefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  const query = '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'
  const [reduced, setReduced] = useState(
    () => typeof window.matchMedia === 'function' && window.matchMedia(query).matches,
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') return
    const media = window.matchMedia(query)
    const onChange = () => setReduced(media.matches)
    media.addEventListener('change', onChange)
    return () => media.removeEventListener('change', onChange)
  }, [])

  return reduced
}

// Auto-advance for a carousel (WCAG 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide).
// The timer only runs when ALL of these are true:
//   - the visitor has not pressed the pause button
//   - the mouse is not over the carousel
//   - keyboard focus is not inside the carousel
//   - the device does not ask for reduced motion
// `advance` must change whenever the slide changes so the timer restarts.
export function useAutoplay(delayMs: number, advance: () => void) {
  const reducedMotion = usePrefersReducedMotion()
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false)
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false)
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false)

  const running = !paused && !hovered && !focused && !reducedMotion

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return
    const timer = setTimeout(advance, delayMs)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [running, advance, delayMs])

  // spread these on the element that wraps the whole carousel
  const handlers = {
    onMouseEnter: () => setHovered(true),
    onMouseLeave: () => setHovered(false),
    onFocus: (e: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      // only keyboard focus pauses; clicking an arrow with the mouse does not
      if (e.target.matches(':focus-visible')) setFocused(true)
    },
    onBlur: (e: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) setFocused(false)
    },
  }

  return {
    running,
    paused,
    reducedMotion,
    togglePause: () => setPaused((value) => !value),
    handlers,
  }
}

import { useNavigate, useSearch } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { filtersFromSearch, searchFromFilters, type Filters } from '../filters'
import HeroSlider from '../components/HeroSlider'
import About from '../components/About'
import EventsSection from '../components/EventsSection'
import Organizers from '../components/Organizers'
import Contact from '../components/Contact'

export default function HomePage() {
  const search = useSearch({ from: '/' })
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const filters = filtersFromSearch(search)

  // Typing replaces the history entry so the typeahead does not spam Back.
  function setFilters(next: Filters, options?: { replace?: boolean }) {
    navigate({ to: '/', search: searchFromFilters(next), replace: options?.replace })
  }

  // Committing the search carries the same filters to the full catalogue.
  function showAll(next: Filters) {
    navigate({ to: '/events', search: searchFromFilters(next) })
  }

  return (
    <>
      <HeroSlider filters={filters} setFilters={setFilters} onShowAll={showAll} />
      <About />
      <EventsSection filters={filters} />
      <Organizers />
      <Contact />
    </>
  )
}
