import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { totalCapacity, uploadEventImage, type NewEventInput } from '../../../lib/backendOrganizer';
import { DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES, resolveEventImage } from '../../../lib/backendEvents';

interface EventFormProps {
  onSubmit: (event: NewEventInput) => Promise<void> | void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

interface TicketRow {
  name: string;
  price: string;
  quantity: string;
}

const emptyRow = (name = ''): TicketRow => ({ name, price: '', quantity: '' });

export const EventForm: React.FC<EventFormProps> = ({ onSubmit, onCancel }) => {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [venue, setVenue] = useState('');
  const [location, setLocation] = useState('');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState('');
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<TicketRow[]>([emptyRow('General')]);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'Published' | 'Draft'>('Draft');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [imageUrl, setImageUrl] = useState(''); // '' = let the app pick a default
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const updateRow = (index: number, patch: Partial<TicketRow>) =>
    setRows(rows.map((row, i) => (i === index ? { ...row, ...patch } : row)));

  const ticketTypes = rows.map((row) => ({
    name: row.name.trim(),
    price: Number(row.price),
    quantity: Number(row.quantity),
  }));
  const capacity = totalCapacity(ticketTypes.filter((type) => Number.isFinite(type.quantity)));
  const startAt = startDate && startTime ? `${startDate}T${startTime}` : '';
  const endAt = endDate && endTime ? `${endDate}T${endTime}` : '';

  const handleImageFile = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = '';
    if (!file) return;
    setError('');
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      setImageUrl(await uploadEventImage(file));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'The image could not be uploaded.');
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim() || !description.trim() || !venue.trim() || !location.trim() || !startAt || !endAt) {
      setError('Fill in the title, description, venue, city, start date and time, and end date and time.');
      return;
    }
    const startDateTime = new Date(startAt);
    const endDateTime = new Date(endAt);
    if (Number.isNaN(startDateTime.getTime()) || Number.isNaN(endDateTime.getTime())) {
      setError('Enter a valid start and end date and time.');
      return;
    }
    if (endDateTime <= startDateTime) {
      setError('The event must end after it starts.');
      return;
    }
    const badType = ticketTypes.find(
      (type) => !type.name || !(type.price >= 0) || !Number.isInteger(type.quantity) || type.quantity < 1,
    );
    if (badType || rows.some((row) => row.price === '' || row.quantity === '')) {
      setError('Every ticket type needs a name, a price (0 or more) and a whole number of tickets.');
      return;
    }
    setError('');
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await onSubmit({
        name,
        description,
        venue,
        location,
        startAt: startDateTime.toISOString(),
        endAt: endDateTime.toISOString(),
        ticketTypes,
        status,
        ...(imageUrl ? { imageUrl } : {}),
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not save the event. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form className="event-creation-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      {error && <div className="form-error-banner">{error}</div>}

      <div className="form-group">
        <label>Event Title</label>
        <input type="text" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Afrobeat Showcase 2026" />
      </div>

      <div className="form-group">
        <label>Event image</label>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center' }}>
          {imageUrl && (
            <img
              src={resolveEventImage(imageUrl, '0')}
              alt="Selected event"
              style={{ width: 120, height: 80, objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 8, border: '2px solid #1e3a8a' }}
            />
          )}
          {DEFAULT_EVENT_IMAGES.map((src) => (
            <button
              key={src}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setImageUrl(src)}
              aria-label="Use this default image"
              aria-pressed={imageUrl === src}
              style={{ padding: 0, border: imageUrl === src ? '2px solid #1e3a8a' : '2px solid transparent', borderRadius: 8, background: 'none', cursor: 'pointer' }}
            >
              <img src={src} alt="" style={{ width: 72, height: 48, objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 6, display: 'block' }} />
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div style={{ marginTop: 8, display: 'flex', gap: 10, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" onChange={handleImageFile} disabled={uploading} />
          {uploading && <span>Uploadingâ€¦</span>}
          {imageUrl && !uploading && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setImageUrl('')} style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: '#475569', textDecoration: 'underline', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
              Remove image
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <small>Upload your own (JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB) or pick a default. If you choose nothing, a default is used.</small>
      </div>

      <div className="form-group">
        <label>Description</label>
        <textarea rows={3} value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} placeholder="What is this event about?" />
      </div>

      <div className="form-group">
        <label>Venue</label>
        <input type="text" value={venue} onChange={(e) => setVenue(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Bingu International Conference Centre" />
      </div>

      <div className="form-group">
        <label>City and country</label>
        <input type="text" value={location} onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Lilongwe, Malawi" />
      </div>

      <div className="form-row">
        <div className="form-group">
          <label>Start date</label>
          <input type="date" value={startDate} onChange={(e) => setStartDate(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label>Start time</label>
          <input type="time" value={startTime} onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label>End date</label>
          <input type="date" value={endDate} onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        <div className="form-group">
          <label>End time</label>
          <input type="time" value={endTime} onChange={(e) => setEndTime(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="form-group">
        <label>Ticket types (prices in MWK)</label>
        {rows.map((row, index) => (
          <div className="ticket-row" key={index}>
            <input type="text" aria-label="Ticket type name" value={row.name} onChange={(e) => updateRow(index, { name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Name, e.g. VIP" />
            <input type="number" min="0" aria-label="Price" value={row.price} onChange={(e) => updateRow(index, { price: e.target.value })} placeholder="Price" />
            <input type="number" min="1" aria-label="Number of tickets" value={row.quantity} onChange={(e) => updateRow(index, { quantity: e.target.value })} placeholder="How many" />
            {rows.length > 1 && (
              <button type="button" className="btn-action" onClick={() => setRows(rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index))}>Remove</button>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className="ticket-row-footer">
          <button type="button" className="btn-action" onClick={() => setRows([...rows, emptyRow()])}>+ Add ticket type</button>
          <span className="form-hint">Total capacity: {capacity.toLocaleString()} tickets</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="form-group">
        <label>Visibility Status</label>
        <select value={status} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as 'Published' | 'Draft')}>
          <option value="Draft">Save as Draft</option>
          <option value="Published">Publish Directly</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div className="form-actions">
        <button type="button" className="btn-secondary" onClick={onCancel} disabled={saving}>Cancel</button>
        <button type="submit" className="btn-primary" disabled={saving || uploading}>{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Create Event'}</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { ConfirmDialog } from '../../../components/ConfirmDialog';
import type { EventItem } from '../Data/Events';

interface EventTableProps {
  events: EventItem[];
  onPublish?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  onCancel?: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  onRestore?: (id: string, status: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED') => Promise<void>;
}

// the event's picture, or the calendar icon when it is missing or cannot be loaded
const Thumb: React.FC<{ src?: string; alt: string }> = ({ src, alt }) => {
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  if (!src || failed) return <div className="placeholder-img-frame">ğŸ“…</div>;
  return <img className="event-thumb" src={src} alt={alt} loading="lazy" onError={() => setFailed(true)} />;
};

export const EventTable: React.FC<EventTableProps> = ({ events, onPublish, onCancel, onRestore }) => {
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [cancelTarget, setCancelTarget] = useState<EventItem | null>(null);

  const run = async (id: string, action?: (id: string) => Promise<void>) => {
    if (!action) return;
    setBusyId(id);
    setError('');
    try {
      await action(id);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'That did not work. Try again.');
    } finally {
      setBusyId('');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="table-responsive">
      {error && <div className="form-error-banner">{error}</div>}
      <table className="dashboard-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Event Image</th>
            <th>Event Name</th>
            <th>Date & Time</th>
            <th>Venue</th>
            <th>Tickets Sold</th>
            <th>Status</th>
            <th>Actions</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {events.map((event) => (
            <tr key={event.id}>
              <td>
                <Thumb src={event.image} alt={event.name} />
              </td>
              <td className="font-semibold">{event.name}</td>
              <td>{event.date}</td>
              <td>{event.venue}</td>
              <td>{event.ticketsSold.toLocaleString()}</td>
              <td>
                <span className={`status-badge ${event.status.toLowerCase()}`}>
                  â— {event.status}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td>
                <div className="action-buttons">
                  <Link to="/events/$eventId" params={{ eventId: event.id }} className="btn-action">View</Link>
                  {event.status !== 'Cancelled' && (
                    <Link to="/organizer/events/$eventId/edit" params={{ eventId: event.id }} className="btn-action">Edit</Link>
                  )}
                  {event.status === 'Draft' && onPublish && (
                    <button className="btn-action primary" disabled={busyId === event.id} onClick={() => run(event.id, onPublish)}>Publish</button>
                  )}
                  {event.status === 'Cancelled' && onRestore && event.restoreStatus && (
                    <button
                      className="btn-action primary"
                      disabled={busyId === event.id}
                      onClick={() => void run(event.id, () => onRestore(
                        event.id,
                        event.restoreStatus === 'Published' ? 'PUBLISHED' : 'DRAFT',
                      ))}
                    >
                      Restore
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {event.status !== 'Cancelled' && onCancel && (
                    <button
                      className="btn-action danger"
                      disabled={busyId === event.id}
                      onClick={() => setCancelTarget(event)}
                    >
                      Cancel event
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={cancelTarget !== null}
        onClose={() => setCancelTarget(null)}
        onConfirm={() => {
          if (cancelTarget && onCancel) void run(cancelTarget.id, onCancel);
        }}
        title="Cancel this event?"
        description={cancelTarget ? `â€œ${cancelTarget.name}â€ will be cancelled and removed from public listings. The event and ticket records are preserved.` : ''}
        confirmLabel="Cancel event"
        cancelLabel="Keep event"
        variant="danger"
      />
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import type { EventItem } from '../Data/Events';

export const SalesChart: React.FC<{ events: EventItem[] }> = ({ events }) => {
  const maximum = Math.max(1, ...events.map((event) => event.ticketsSold));

  return (
    <div className="sales-summary-container">
      <div className="chart-header">
        <div>
          <h3 className="sales-summary-title">Tickets sold</h3>
          <p className="sales-summary-caption">Sales by event</p>
        </div>
        <span className="sales-summary-total">
          {events.reduce((sum, event) => sum + event.ticketsSold, 0).toLocaleString()}
          <span> total</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      {events.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="sales-summary-empty">No event sales data available.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="sales-summary-list">
          {events.map((event) => (
            <li key={event.id}>
              <div className="sales-summary-row">
                <span className="sales-summary-event" title={event.name}>{event.name}</span>
                <strong className="sales-summary-count">{event.ticketsSold.toLocaleString()}</strong>
              </div>
              <div className="sales-summary-track">
                <div
                  className="sales-summary-bar"
                  style={{
                    width: event.ticketsSold > 0
                      ? `${Math.max(3, (event.ticketsSold / maximum) * 100)}%`
                      : '0%',
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import { useState, useEffect, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { api } from '../../../lib/backend'
import { createMyStaff } from '../../../lib/backendUsers'

interface StaffMember {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  assignedEventIds: string[]
  isActive: boolean
}

const emptyForm = { name: '', email: '', password: '' }

// Safely extract whatever ID field the backend actually provided.
function extractId(raw: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  return String(raw.id ?? raw.userId ?? raw.user_id ?? raw.staffId ?? raw.staff_id ?? '')
}

// The organizer's own staff: listed from the backend, and new staff accounts are created there.
export function StaffRoster() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<StaffMember[]>([])
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm)
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  async function loadStaff() {
    setIsLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      const result = await api<any>('/organizers/me/staff')
      let list: any[] = []
      if (Array.isArray(result)) list = result
      else if (result && Array.isArray(result.data)) list = result.data
      else if (result && Array.isArray(result.staff)) list = result.staff

      const cleaned = list.map((raw) => ({
        id: extractId(raw),
        name: raw.name ?? 'Unnamed Staff',
        email: raw.email ?? '',
        assignedEventIds: Array.isArray(raw.assignedEventIds) ? raw.assignedEventIds.map(String) : 
                          Array.isArray(raw.eventIds) ? raw.eventIds.map(String) : 
                          Array.isArray(raw.events) ? raw.events.map(String) : [],
        isActive: raw.isActive ?? raw.active ?? raw.status !== 'DISABLED',
      }))

      setData(cleaned)
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not load staff.')
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadStaff()
  }, [])

  async function create(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setFormError(null)
    setNotice(null)
    if (!form.name.trim()) return setFormError('Enter the staff memberâ€™s name.')
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim())) return setFormError('Enter a valid email address.')
    if (form.password.length < 8) return setFormError('The password needs at least 8 characters.')
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      await createMyStaff(form)
      setForm(emptyForm)
      await loadStaff()
      setNotice('Staff account created.')
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Could not create the account.')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <form onSubmit={create} noValidate style={{ marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}>
        <h3>Add a staff member</h3>
        <div className="form-row">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="staff-name">Name</label>
            <input id="staff-name" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="staff-email">Email</label>
            <input id="staff-email" type="email" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label htmlFor="staff-password">Password</label>
            <input id="staff-password" type="password" value={form.password} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })} />
          </div>
        </div>
        {formError && <div className="form-error-banner">{formError}</div>}
        {notice && <p className="form-hint">{notice}</p>}
        <div className="form-actions">
          <button type="submit" className="btn-primary-header" disabled={saving}>
            {saving ? 'Creating...' : 'Create staff account'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {isLoading && <p className="view-subtitle">Loading your staff...</p>}
      {error && <div className="form-error-banner">{error}</div>}
      {!isLoading && !error && data.length === 0 && (
        <p className="view-subtitle">You have no staff yet. Add one above.</p>
      )}
      {data.length > 0 && (
        <div className="table-responsive">
          <table className="dashboard-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Name</th>
                <th>Email</th>
                <th>Events</th>
                <th>Status</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.map((member, i) => (
                <tr key={member.id || i}>
                  <td>{member.name}</td>
                  <td>{member.email}</td>
                  <td>{member.assignedEventIds.length}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span className={`status-badge ${member.isActive ? 'published' : 'cancelled'}`}>
                      {member.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="form-hint">
        To choose which events a staff member may scan, switch them off or remove them, open{' '}
        <Link to="/organizer/staff">staff management</Link>.
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}

import React, { isValidElement, type ReactNode } from 'react'

interface StatCardProps {
  label?: string
  title?: string
  value: string | number
  detail?: string
  icon?: ReactNode | React.ComponentType<{ size?: number }> | string
  color?: string
}

export function StatCard({ label, title, value, detail, icon, color }: StatCardProps) {
  // Support both `label` (new) and `title` (old)
  const displayLabel = label ?? title ?? ''

  // Determine how to render the icon safely
  let renderedIcon: ReactNode = null

  if (icon) {
    // 1. If it's a plain element (e.g. <ShieldAlert />) â†’ render as-is
    if (isValidElement(icon)) {
      renderedIcon = icon
    }
    // 2. If it's a string (e.g. emoji) â†’ wrap in a span
    else if (typeof icon === 'string') {
      renderedIcon = <span aria-hidden="true">{icon}</span>
    }
    // 3. If it's a component reference (e.g. ShieldAlert) â†’ call it correctly
    else if (typeof icon === 'function') {
      const Icon = icon as React.ComponentType<{ size?: number }>
      renderedIcon = <Icon size={19} />
    }
  }

  return (
    <article className="stat-card">
      <div className="stat-info">
        <span className="stat-title">{displayLabel}</span>
        <span className="stat-value">{value}</span>
        {detail && <small className="stat-detail">{detail}</small>}
      </div>
      {renderedIcon && (
        <span className="stat-icon" style={{ color }}>
          {renderedIcon}
        </span>
      )}
    </article>
  )
}

export default StatCard

FILE: ./src/features/organizer/hooks/useAttendee.ts
================================================================================
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useAuth } from '../../authentication';
import { api } from '../../../lib/backend';
import { listMyEvents } from '../../../lib/backendOrganizer';
import type { AttendeeFilters, AttendeeItem } from '../Data/Attendee';

interface BackendEventTicket {
  ticketNumber: string;
  ticketTypeId: string;
  customerId: string | null;
  customerName?: string | null;
  customerEmail?: string | null;
  attendee?: { userId: string; fullName: string; email: string } | null;
  ticketType?: { ticketTypeId: string; name: string; price: number | string };
  status: 'ISSUED' | 'USED' | 'CANCELLED' | 'REFUNDED';
  issuedAt: string;
  purchasedAt?: string | null;
  checkedInAt: string | null;
}

function formatPurchaseDate(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return 'Unknown';
  return date.toLocaleString('en-GB', { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' });
}

export async function fetchBackendAttendees(): Promise<AttendeeItem[]> {
  const events = await listMyEvents();
  const attendeesByEvent = await Promise.all(
    events.map(async (event) => {
      const tickets = await api<BackendEventTicket[]>(`/tickets/events/${encodeURIComponent(event.id)}`);

      return tickets.flatMap((ticket) => {
        if (!ticket.customerId || ticket.status === 'CANCELLED' || ticket.status === 'REFUNDED') return [];
        const purchasedAt = ticket.purchasedAt ?? ticket.issuedAt;

        return [{
          id: ticket.ticketNumber,
          name: ticket.attendee?.fullName ?? ticket.customerName ?? `Customer #${ticket.customerId}`,
          email: ticket.attendee?.email ?? ticket.customerEmail ?? '',
          event: event.name,
          eventId: event.id,
          ticketType: ticket.ticketType?.name ?? 'Unknown',
          quantity: 1,
          amount: Number(ticket.ticketType?.price ?? 0),
          purchaseDate: formatPurchaseDate(purchasedAt),
          purchasedAt,
          status: ticket.status === 'USED' || ticket.checkedInAt ? 'Checked In' : 'Registered',
        } satisfies AttendeeItem];
      });
    }),
  );

  return attendeesByEvent.flat().sort(
    (a, b) => new Date(b.purchasedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.purchasedAt).getTime(),
  );
}

export function filterAttendees(
  attendees: AttendeeItem[],
  filters: AttendeeFilters,
): AttendeeItem[] {
  const search = filters.search?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? '';

  return attendees.filter((attendee) => {
    if (filters.eventId && filters.eventId !== 'all' && attendee.eventId !== filters.eventId) {
      return false;
    }
    if (
      filters.ticketType &&
      filters.ticketType !== 'all' &&
      !attendee.ticketType.split(', ').includes(filters.ticketType)
    ) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!search) return true;
    return [attendee.name, attendee.email, attendee.event, attendee.ticketType, attendee.id].some(
      (value) => value.toLowerCase().includes(search),
    );
  });
}

export const useAttendees = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [eventId, setEventId] = useState('all');
  const [ticketType, setTicketType] = useState('all');

  const backendAttendees = useQuery({
    queryKey: ['organizer-attendees', user?.id],
    queryFn: fetchBackendAttendees,
    enabled: !!user,
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });
  const allAttendees = useMemo(() => backendAttendees.data ?? [], [backendAttendees.data]);
  const attendees = useMemo(
    () => filterAttendees(allAttendees, { search, eventId, ticketType }),
    [allAttendees, search, eventId, ticketType],
  );

  const eventOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const byId = new Map(allAttendees.map((attendee) => [attendee.eventId, attendee.event]));
    return [...byId.entries()]
      .map(([id, title]) => ({ id, title }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
  }, [allAttendees]);

  const ticketTypeOptions = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...new Set(allAttendees.flatMap((attendee) => attendee.ticketType.split(', ')))].sort((a, b) =>
        a.localeCompare(b),
      ),
    [allAttendees],
  );

  return {
    attendees,
    totalAttendees: allAttendees.length,
    checkedInCount: allAttendees.filter((attendee) => attendee.status === 'Checked In').length,
    loading: backendAttendees.isLoading,
    error: backendAttendees.error instanceof Error ? backendAttendees.error.message : '',
    search,
    setSearch,
    eventId,
    setEventId,
    ticketType,
    setTicketType,
    eventOptions,
    ticketTypeOptions,
  };
};

FILE: ./src/features/organizer/hooks/useEventStats.ts
================================================================================
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import {
  cancelOrganizerEvent,
  createOrganizerEvent,
  listMyEvents,
  publishEvent,
  restoreOrganizerEvent,
  type NewEventInput,
} from '../../../lib/backendOrganizer';
import type { EventItem } from '../Data/Events';

const MY_EVENTS_KEY = ['events', 'mine'];
const restoreStatusKey = (id: string) => `tm_event_restore_status_${id}`;

interface PendingCancellation {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  previousStatus: EventItem['status'];
  timerId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
}

export const useEvents = () => {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('All');
  const [pendingCancels, setPendingCancels] = useState<Map<string, PendingCancellation>>(new Map());
  const pendingCancelsRef = useRef(pendingCancels);
  pendingCancelsRef.current = pendingCancels;

  const remote = useQuery({ queryKey: MY_EVENTS_KEY, queryFn: listMyEvents });
  const events = (remote.data ?? []).map((event) => {
    const pending = pendingCancels.get(event.id);
    if (pending) {
      return {
        ...event,
        status: 'Cancelled' as const,
        restoreStatus: (pending.previousStatus === 'Published' || pending.previousStatus === 'Draft' ? pending.previousStatus : 'Draft'),
        isPendingCancel: true,
      };
    }
    if (event.status !== 'Cancelled') return event;
    let restoreStatus: EventItem['restoreStatus'] = 'Draft';
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(restoreStatusKey(event.id));
      if (saved === 'Published' || saved === 'Draft') restoreStatus = saved;
    } catch { /* Restore as a draft if browser storage is unavailable. */ }
    return { ...event, restoreStatus };
  });

  // The public catalogue and the organizer list both change after any of these actions.
  const refresh = () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events'] });

  const create = useMutation({ mutationFn: createOrganizerEvent, onSuccess: refresh });
  const publish = useMutation({ mutationFn: publishEvent, onSuccess: refresh });
  const cancel = useMutation({ mutationFn: cancelOrganizerEvent, onSuccess: refresh });
  const restore = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, status }: { id: string; status: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' }) =>
      restoreOrganizerEvent(id, status),
    onSuccess: refresh,
  });

  // Immediately commit any pending cancellations before the page unloads
  useEffect(() => {
    const onBeforeUnload = () => {
      for (const [id, pending] of pendingCancelsRef.current.entries()) {
        clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
        void cancelOrganizerEvent(id);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', onBeforeUnload);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', onBeforeUnload);
    };
  }, []);

  const addEvent = async (newEvent: NewEventInput): Promise<void> => {
    await create.mutateAsync(newEvent);
  };

  const publishExisting = async (id: string): Promise<void> => {
    await publish.mutateAsync(id);
  };

  const undoCancel = useCallback((id: string): boolean => {
    const pending = pendingCancelsRef.current.get(id);
    if (pending) {
      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
      setPendingCancels((prev) => {
        const next = new Map(prev);
        next.delete(id);
        return next;
      });
      try { localStorage.removeItem(restoreStatusKey(id)); } catch { /* Ignore */ }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }, []);

  const cancelExisting = async (id: string): Promise<void> => {
    const event = events.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!event) return;
    const previousStatus = event.status;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(restoreStatusKey(id), previousStatus);
    } catch { /* Keep cancellation available if browser storage is unavailable. */ }

    // Start a 15-second grace period timer before sending cancellation to backend
    const timerId = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        await cancel.mutateAsync(id);
      } catch {
        /* Ignore error if already committed */
      } finally {
        setPendingCancels((prev) => {
          const next = new Map(prev);
          next.delete(id);
          return next;
        });
      }
    }, 15000);

    setPendingCancels((prev) => {
      const next = new Map(prev);
      next.set(id, { id, name: event.name, previousStatus, timerId });
      return next;
    });
  };

  const restoreExisting = async (id: string, status: 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED'): Promise<void> => {
    if (undoCancel(id)) {
      return;
    }
    await restore.mutateAsync({ id, status });
    try { localStorage.removeItem(restoreStatusKey(id)); } catch { /* Ignore unavailable storage. */ }
  };

  const filteredEvents = events.filter(item => {
    const matchesSearch = item.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || item.venue.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchesStatus = filterStatus === 'All' || item.status === filterStatus;
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  const totalTickets = events.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.ticketsSold, 0);

  return {
    events: filteredEvents,
    totalEvents: events.length,
    publishedCount: events.filter(e => e.status === 'Published').length,
    draftCount: events.filter(e => e.status === 'Draft').length,
    totalTickets,
    search,
    setSearch,
    filterStatus,
    setFilterStatus,
    addEvent,
    publishEvent: publishExisting,
    cancelEvent: cancelExisting,
    restoreEvent: restoreExisting,
    undoCancel,
    pendingCancels,
    loading: remote.isLoading,
    loadError: remote.error instanceof Error ? remote.error.message : '',
  };
};

FILE: ./src/features/organizer/hooks/useStaff.ts
================================================================================
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import {
  assignStaffEvents,
  createStaff,
  listStaff,
  removeStaff,
  setStaffActive,
  type CreateStaffInput,
  type StaffMember,
} from '../../../lib/backendStaff'

const STAFF_KEY = ['organizer-staff']

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : ''
}

function errorStatus(error: unknown): number | undefined {
  return (error as { status?: number } | null)?.status
}

export function useStaff() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('')

  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: STAFF_KEY,
    queryFn: listStaff,
    retry: false,
  })

  const refresh = () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: STAFF_KEY })

  const create = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: CreateStaffInput) => createStaff(input),
    onSuccess: refresh,
  })
  const assign = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ staffId, eventIds }: { staffId: string; eventIds: string[] }) =>
      assignStaffEvents(staffId, eventIds),
    onSuccess: refresh,
  })
  const toggleActive = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ staffId, isActive }: { staffId: string; isActive: boolean }) =>
      setStaffActive(staffId, isActive),
    onSuccess: refresh,
  })
  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (staffId: string) => removeStaff(staffId),
    onSuccess: refresh,
  })

  const allStaff = useMemo(() => query.data ?? [], [query.data])
  const staff = useMemo(() => {
    const term = search.trim().toLowerCase()
    if (!term) return allStaff
    return allStaff.filter((member) =>
      [member.name, member.email, ...member.events.map((event) => event.title)]
        .join(' ')
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(term),
    )
  }, [allStaff, search])

  return {
    staff,
    allStaff,
    totalStaff: allStaff.length,
    activeStaff: allStaff.filter((member) => member.isActive).length,
    disabledStaff: allStaff.filter((member) => !member.isActive).length,
    search,
    setSearch,
    loading: query.isLoading,
    error: errorMessage(query.error),
    unsupported: errorStatus(query.error) === 404,
    saving:
      create.isPending || assign.isPending || toggleActive.isPending || remove.isPending,
    createStaff: async (input: CreateStaffInput): Promise<StaffMember> => {
      return create.mutateAsync(input)
    },
    assignEvents: async (staffId: string, eventIds: string[]): Promise<StaffMember> => {
      return assign.mutateAsync({ staffId, eventIds })
    },
    setActive: async (staffId: string, isActive: boolean): Promise<StaffMember> => {
      return toggleActive.mutateAsync({ staffId, isActive })
    },
    removeStaff: async (staffId: string): Promise<void> => {
      await remove.mutateAsync(staffId)
    },
  }
}

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router';
import { EventForm } from '../components/EventForm';
import { useEvents } from '../hooks/useEventStats';
import type { NewEventInput } from '../../../lib/backendOrganizer';

interface CreateEventPageProps {
  onEventCreated: (event: NewEventInput) => Promise<void> | void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export const CreateEventPage: React.FC<CreateEventPageProps> = ({ onEventCreated, onCancel }) => {
  return (
    <div className="page-content-wrapper">
      <div className="content-header">
        <div>
          <h2 className="view-title">Schedule New Event</h2>
          <p className="view-subtitle">Populate definitions to post directly onto Ticket Panel frameworks.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="card-body-frame">
        <EventForm onSubmit={onEventCreated} onCancel={onCancel} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export function CreateEventRoute() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { addEvent } = useEvents();

  const goToDashboard = () => {
    void navigate({ to: '/organizer/dashboard' });
  };

  return (
    <CreateEventPage
      onEventCreated={async (event) => {
        await addEvent(event);
        goToDashboard();
      }}
      onCancel={goToDashboard}
    />
  );
}


================================================================================
FILE: ./src/features/organizer/pages/EditEventPage.tsx
================================================================================
import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import {
  createOrganizerTicketType,
  fetchEditableOrganizerEvent,
  listOrganizerTicketTypes,
  updateOrganizerEvent,
  updateOrganizerTicketType,
  type EditableOrganizerEvent,
} from '../../../lib/backendOrganizer'

interface TicketDraft {
  id?: string
  name: string
  description: string
  price: string
  quantity: string
  perOrderLimit: string
  currency: string
}

function localDateTime(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value)
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return ''
  const pad = (number: number) => String(number).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}T${pad(date.getHours())}:${pad(date.getMinutes())}`
}

const field = 'mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2.5 text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-navy focus:ring-2 focus:ring-navy/15'

export function EditEventPage() {
  const { eventId } = useParams({ from: '/organizer/events/$eventId/edit' })
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const [form, setForm] = useState<EditableOrganizerEvent | null>(null)
  const [ticketTypes, setTicketTypes] = useState<TicketDraft[]>([])
  const [removedTicketIds, setRemovedTicketIds] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState('')

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true
    setLoading(true)
    void Promise.all([fetchEditableOrganizerEvent(eventId), listOrganizerTicketTypes(eventId)])
      .then(([event, types]) => {
        if (!active) return
        setForm(event)
        setTicketTypes(types.filter((type) => type.isActive).map((type) => ({
          id: type.id,
          name: type.name,
          description: type.description,
          price: String(type.price),
          quantity: String(type.quantity),
          perOrderLimit: String(type.perOrderLimit),
          currency: type.currency,
        })))
      })
      .catch((caught) => { if (active) setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Could not load this event.') })
      .finally(() => { if (active) setLoading(false) })
    return () => { active = false }
  }, [eventId])

  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault()
    if (!form || saving) return
    const startAt = new Date(form.startAt)
    const endAt = new Date(form.endAt)
    if (!form.title.trim() || !form.description.trim() || !form.venue.trim() || !form.location.trim()) {
      setError('Enter the event title, description, venue, and location.')
      return
    }
    if (Number.isNaN(startAt.getTime()) || Number.isNaN(endAt.getTime()) || endAt <= startAt) {
      setError('Choose a valid start and end time. The event must end after it starts.')
      return
    }
    if (ticketTypes.length === 0 || ticketTypes.some((ticket) =>
      !ticket.name.trim() || !Number.isFinite(Number(ticket.price)) || Number(ticket.price) < 0 ||
      !Number.isInteger(Number(ticket.quantity)) || Number(ticket.quantity) < 1 ||
      !Number.isInteger(Number(ticket.perOrderLimit)) || Number(ticket.perOrderLimit) < 1,
    )) {
      setError('Keep at least one valid ticket type. Each needs a name, a non-negative price, quantity, and per-order limit.')
      return
    }

    setSaving(true)
    setError('')
    try {
      await updateOrganizerEvent(eventId, {
        title: form.title.trim(),
        description: form.description.trim(),
        category: form.category?.trim() || undefined,
        imageUrl: form.imageUrl?.trim() || undefined,
        venue: form.venue.trim(),
        location: form.location.trim(),
        startAt: startAt.toISOString(),
        endAt: endAt.toISOString(),
      })
      for (const ticketId of removedTicketIds) {
        await updateOrganizerTicketType(eventId, ticketId, { isActive: false })
      }
      for (const ticket of ticketTypes) {
        const changes = {
          name: ticket.name.trim(),
          description: ticket.description.trim(),
          price: Number(ticket.price),
          currency: ticket.currency || 'MWK',
          quantity: Number(ticket.quantity),
          perOrderLimit: Number(ticket.perOrderLimit),
        }
        if (ticket.id) await updateOrganizerTicketType(eventId, ticket.id, changes)
        else await createOrganizerTicketType(eventId, changes)
      }
      await Promise.all([
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events'] }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['events', 'mine'] }),
      ])
      await navigate({ to: '/organizer/dashboard' })
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Could not save event changes.')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-16 pt-24 sm:px-6">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl">
        <Link to="/organizer/dashboard" className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-navy">â† Organizer dashboard</Link>
        <section className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm sm:p-8">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-navy-dark">Edit event</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">Update the event details shown to attendees.</p>

          {loading && <p className="mt-6 text-slate-500">Loading eventâ€¦</p>}
          {error && <div role="alert" className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</div>}

          {!loading && form && (
            <form onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="mt-6 space-y-4">
              <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Event title
                <input className={field} value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} required />
              </label>
              <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Description
                <textarea className={field} rows={4} value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} required />
              </label>
              <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Category
                <input className={field} value={form.category ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, category: e.target.value })} />
              </label>
              <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Venue
                  <input className={field} value={form.venue} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, venue: e.target.value })} required />
                </label>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">City and location
                  <input className={field} value={form.location} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, location: e.target.value })} required />
                </label>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Starts
                  <input className={field} type="datetime-local" value={localDateTime(form.startAt)} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, startAt: e.target.value })} required />
                </label>
                <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Ends
                  <input className={field} type="datetime-local" value={localDateTime(form.endAt)} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, endAt: e.target.value })} required />
                </label>
              </div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Image URL
                <input className={field} value={form.imageUrl ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, imageUrl: e.target.value })} placeholder="Leave blank to keep the current image" />
              </label>
              <section className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-4">
                <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="font-bold text-navy-dark">Ticket types and prices</h2>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-normal text-slate-500">Removing a type deactivates it; existing ticket records are kept.</p>
                  </div>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setTicketTypes((current) => [...current, { name: '', description: '', price: '', quantity: '1', perOrderLimit: '10', currency: 'MWK' }])} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50">Add ticket type</button>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-4">

                    <div key={ticket.id ?? `new-${index}`} className="grid gap-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2">

                        <input className={field} value={ticket.name} onChange={(e) => setTicketTypes((current) => current.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, name: e.target.value } : item))} />
                      </label>
                      <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Description
                        <input className={field} value={ticket.description} onChange={(e) => setTicketTypes((current) => current.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, description: e.target.value } : item))} />
                      </label>
                      <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Price (MWK)
                        <input className={field} type="number" min="0" step="1" value={ticket.price} onChange={(e) => setTicketTypes((current) => current.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, price: e.target.value } : item))} />
                      </label>
                      <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Quantity
                        <input className={field} type="number" min="1" step="1" value={ticket.quantity} onChange={(e) => setTicketTypes((current) => current.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, quantity: e.target.value } : item))} />
                      </label>
                      <label className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Per-order limit
                        <input className={field} type="number" min="1" step="1" value={ticket.perOrderLimit} onChange={(e) => setTicketTypes((current) => current.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, perOrderLimit: e.target.value } : item))} />
                      </label>
                      <div className="flex items-end justify-end">
                        <button type="button" disabled={ticketTypes.length === 1} onClick={() => {
                          if (ticket.id) setRemovedTicketIds((current) => [...current, ticket.id!])
                          setTicketTypes((current) => current.filter((_, i) => i !== index))
                        }} className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 disabled:opacity-50">Remove type</button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </section>
              <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 pt-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => void navigate({ to: '/organizer/dashboard' })} className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50" disabled={saving}>Cancel</button>
                <button type="submit" className="rounded-xl bg-navy px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-navy-dark disabled:opacity-60" disabled={saving}>{saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save changes'}</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

function initials(name: string | undefined): string {

FILE: ./src/features/organizer/pages/OrganizerKycPage.tsx

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { useAuth } from '../../authentication'
import { getKYC, submitKyc } from '../../../lib/verification'

// Organizer details are saved directly to the backend. Submission does not wait for
// an admin review or approval before the organizer can use the platform.
export function OrganizerKycPage() {
  const { user } = useAuth()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const existing = user ? getKYC(user.id) : null

  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState(existing?.businessName ?? '')
  const [phoneNumber, setPhoneNumber] = useState(existing?.phoneNumber ?? '')
  const [nationalId, setNationalId] = useState(existing?.nationalId ?? '')
  const [error, setError] = useState('')
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)

  if (!user) return null

  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault()
    if (!user || saving) return
    if (!businessName.trim()) return setError('Enter your business or organization name.')
    if (!/^[+\d][\d\s-]{6,}$/.test(phoneNumber.trim())) return setError('Enter a valid phone number, for example +265 999 000 000.')
    if (nationalId.trim().length < 5) return setError('Enter your national ID number.')
    setError('')
    setSaving(true)
    try {
      await submitKyc(user.id, {
        businessName: businessName.trim(),
        phoneNumber: phoneNumber.trim(),
        nationalId: nationalId.trim(),
      })
      void navigate({ to: '/organizer/dashboard' })
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Could not save your details. Try again.')
    } finally {
      setSaving(false)
    }
  }

  const field = 'mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2.5 text-slate-900 focus:border-navy focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-navy/20'

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-16 pt-24">
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="mx-auto max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8" noValidate>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-navy-dark">Confirm your details</h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
          Welcome, {user.name}. Add your business details to your organizer profile. You can create and manage events as soon as you save; no admin approval is required.
        </p>

        {error && (
          <div role="alert" className="mt-5 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</div>
        )}

        <label className="mt-5 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
          Business or organization name
          <input className={field} value={businessName} onChange={(e) => setBusinessName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Nyasa Events" autoComplete="organization" />
        </label>
        <label className="mt-4 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
          Phone number
          <input className={field} value={phoneNumber} onChange={(e) => setPhoneNumber(e.target.value)} placeholder="+265 999 000 000" inputMode="tel" autoComplete="tel" />
        </label>
        <label className="mt-4 block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
          National ID number
          <input className={field} value={nationalId} onChange={(e) => setNationalId(e.target.value)} placeholder="Your national ID" />
        </label>

        <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="mt-6 w-full rounded-lg bg-navy px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-navy-dark disabled:opacity-60">
          {saving ? 'Savingâ€¦' : 'Save and continue'}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: ./src/features/organizer/pages/StaffManagementPage.tsx

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router'
import { Modal } from '../../../components/ui/Modal'
import { StatCard } from '../components/StatCard'
import { useEvents } from '../hooks/useEventStats'
import { useStaff } from '../hooks/useStaff'
import type { StaffMember } from '../../../lib/backendStaff'

const emptyForm = { name: '', email: '', password: '' }

const field =
  'mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-navy'
const primaryButton =
  'rounded-xl bg-navy px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-navy-dark disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60'
const secondaryButton =
  'rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60'
function messageFor(error: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : fallback
}

export function StaffManagementPage() {
  const { events, loadError: eventsError } = useEvents()
  const {
    staff,
    totalStaff,
    activeStaff,
    disabledStaff,
    search,
    setSearch,
    loading,
    error,
    unsupported,
    saving,
    createStaff,
    assignEvents,
    setActive,
    removeStaff,
  } = useStaff()

  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false)
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm)
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState('')
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<StaffMember | null>(null)
  const [selectedEventIds, setSelectedEventIds] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState('')
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState('')
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState('')

  function openCreate() {
    setForm(emptyForm)
    setFormError('')
    setCreating(true)
  }

  async function submitCreate(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setFormError('')
    if (form.name.trim().length < 2) {
      setFormError('Enter the staff memberâ€™s full name.')
      return
    }
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(form.email.trim())) {
      setFormError('Enter a valid email address.')
      return
    }
    if (form.password.length < 10) {
      setFormError('The temporary password must be at least 10 characters.')
      return
    }

    try {
      await createStaff(form)
      setCreating(false)
      setForm(emptyForm)
      setNotice('Staff account created. Assign at least one event before they can scan tickets.')
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(messageFor(err, 'Could not create the staff account.'))
    }
  }

  function openAssign(member: StaffMember) {
    setEditing(member)
    setSelectedEventIds(member.events.map((event) => event.eventId))
    setActionError('')
  }

  function toggleEvent(eventId: string) {
    setSelectedEventIds((current) =>
      current.includes(eventId)
        ? current.filter((id) => id !== eventId)
        : [...current, eventId],
    )
  }

  async function saveAssignments() {
    if (!editing) return
    setBusyId(editing.staffId)
    setActionError('')
    try {
      await assignEvents(editing.staffId, selectedEventIds)
      setEditing(null)
      setNotice('Event assignments updated.')
    } catch (err) {
      setActionError(messageFor(err, 'Could not update the event assignments.'))
    } finally {
      setBusyId('')
    }
  }

  async function toggleActive(member: StaffMember) {
    setBusyId(member.staffId)
    setActionError('')
    try {
      await setActive(member.staffId, !member.isActive)
      setNotice(member.isActive ? 'Staff account disabled.' : 'Staff account enabled.')
    } catch (err) {
      setActionError(messageFor(err, 'Could not change the staff account status.'))
    } finally {
      setBusyId('')
    }
  }

  async function deleteMember(member: StaffMember) {
    if (!window.confirm(`Remove ${member.name}? Their login will stop working and their event assignments will be deleted.`)) {
      return
    }
    setBusyId(member.staffId)
    setActionError('')
    try {
      await removeStaff(member.staffId)
      setNotice('Staff member removed.')
    } catch (err) {
      setActionError(messageFor(err, 'Could not remove the staff member.'))
    } finally {
      setBusyId('')
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 pb-16 pt-24">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6">
        <Link to="/organizer/dashboard" className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:text-navy">
          â† Organizer dashboard
        </Link>

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-navy-dark">Staff Roster</h1>
            <p className="mt-2 text-slate-600">
              Create check-in staff, assign them to your events, and control whether they can scan.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={openCreate} className={primaryButton}>
            + Create staff
          </button>
        </div>

        <div
          role="status"
          className="mt-6 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4 text-sm text-amber-900"
        >
          <strong>Backend support:</strong> Staff management uses the organizer-staff endpoints
          added in backend 1.3. If you are connected to backend 1.2, this section is not supported
          and the staff list will fail. Staff must be assigned to an event before they can scan.
        </div>

        {notice && (
          <div role="status" className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-3 text-sm text-emerald-800">
            {notice}
          </div>
        )}

        {unsupported && (
          <div role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">
            The connected backend does not expose `/organizers/me/staff`. Start backend 1.3 and
            try again.
          </div>
        )}

        {error && !unsupported && (
          <div role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        {eventsError && (
          <div role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">
            Could not load your events: {eventsError}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="metrics-grid mt-6">
          <StatCard title="Total Staff" value={totalStaff} icon="ğŸ‘¥" color="#3b82f6" />
          <StatCard title="Active" value={activeStaff} icon="âœ…" color="#10b981" />
          <StatCard title="Disabled" value={disabledStaff} icon="â›”" color="#64748b" />
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
          <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-navy-dark">Staff accounts</h2>
            <input
              type="search"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search name, email or event"
              aria-label="Search staff"
              className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-navy"
            />
          </div>

          {actionError && (
            <div role="alert" className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">
              {actionError}
            </div>
          )}

          {loading ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Loading staff...</p>
          ) : staff.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-6 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
              {search ? 'No staff match your search.' : 'No staff accounts yet. Create one to get started.'}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="table-responsive">
              <table className="dashboard-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>Name</th>
                    <th>Email</th>
                    <th>Assigned events</th>
                    <th>Status</th>
                    <th>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {staff.map((member) => (
                    <tr key={member.staffId}>
                      <td className="font-semibold">{member.name}</td>
                      <td>{member.email}</td>
                      <td>
                        {member.events.length === 0 ? (
                          <span className="text-amber-700">None â€” cannot scan yet</span>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                            {member.events.map((event) => (
                              <span
                                key={event.eventId}
                                className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700"
                              >
                                {event.title}
                              </span>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span className={`status-badge ${member.isActive ? 'published' : 'draft'}`}>
                          {member.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Disabled'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => openAssign(member)}
                            className="btn-action"
                            disabled={busyId === member.staffId}
                          >
                            Assign events
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => void toggleActive(member)}
                            className="btn-action"
                            disabled={busyId === member.staffId}
                          >
                            {member.isActive ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => void deleteMember(member)}
                            className="btn-action text-red-700"
                            disabled={busyId === member.staffId}
                          >
                            Remove
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Modal isOpen={creating} onClose={() => setCreating(false)} title="Create staff account">
        <form onSubmit={(e) => void submitCreate(e)} className="space-y-3">
          {formError && (
            <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">
              {formError}
            </p>
          )}
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">
            Full name
            <input
              className={field}
              value={form.name}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
              autoComplete="name"
            />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">
            Email
            <input
              type="email"
              className={field}
              value={form.email}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })}
              autoComplete="email"
            />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-sm font-medium">
            Temporary password
            <input
              type="password"
              className={field}
              value={form.password}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })}
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="At least 10 characters"
            />
          </label>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setCreating(false)} className={secondaryButton}>
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button type="submit" className={primaryButton} disabled={saving}>
              {saving ? 'Creating...' : 'Create staff'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      <Modal
        isOpen={!!editing}
        onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
        title={editing ? `Assign events to ${editing.name}` : 'Assign events'}
      >
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">
            Select every event this staff member may scan. Sending an empty selection removes all
            their assignments.
          </p>

          {actionError && (
            <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">
              {actionError}
            </p>
          )}

          {events.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="rounded-xl bg-slate-50 p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
              You have no events yet. Create an event first.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="max-h-64 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3">
              {events.map((event) => (
                <label key={event.id} className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 rounded-lg p-2 hover:bg-slate-50">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={selectedEventIds.includes(event.id)}
                    onChange={() => toggleEvent(event.id)}
                    className="mt-1"
                  />
                  <span>
                    <span className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">{event.name}</span>
                    <span className="block text-xs text-slate-500">
                      {event.date} Â· {event.venue} Â· {event.status}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing(null)} className={secondaryButton}>
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void saveAssignments()}
              className={primaryButton}
              disabled={!!busyId}
            >
              {busyId ? 'Saving...' : 'Save assignments'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </main>
  )
}

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { fetchBookings } from './bookingData'

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals()
})

describe('fetchBookings', () => {
  it('loads and maps orders from the backend', async () => {
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async () => new Response(JSON.stringify([
      {
        orderNumber: 'ORD-1',
        event: { title: 'Live show', venue: 'City Hall', startAt: '2026-12-20T18:00:00.000Z' },
        items: [{ quantity: 2 }],
        totalAmount: 10500,
        status: 'PAID',
      },
    ]), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }))
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock)

    await expect(fetchBookings()).resolves.toEqual([{
      id: 'ORD-1',
      eventTitle: 'Live show',
      venue: 'City Hall',
      date: '2026-12-20T18:00:00.000Z',
      quantity: 2,
      total: 10500,
      status: 'confirmed',
    }])
    expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/be/orders/mine', expect.any(Object))
  })

  it('surfaces an unsupported backend response instead of showing invented data', async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(async () => new Response(JSON.stringify([{}]), {
      status: 200,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    })))

    await expect(fetchBookings()).rejects.toThrow(/missing its number, event, date, or ticket quantity/)
  })
})

FILE: ./src/features/tickets/bookingData.ts
================================================================================
import { api } from '../../lib/backend'
import type { Booking, BookingStatus } from './bookingTypes'

type JsonRecord = Record<string, unknown>

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is JsonRecord {
  return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
}

function firstString(...values: unknown[]): string | undefined {
  return values.find((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0)
}

function firstNumber(...values: unknown[]): number | undefined {
  return values.find((value): value is number => typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value))
}

function normalizeStatus(value: unknown): BookingStatus {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') throw new Error('The backend returned an order without a status.')
  switch (value.toUpperCase()) {
    case 'PAID':
    case 'COMPLETED':
    case 'CONFIRMED':
    case 'SUCCESS':
      return 'confirmed'
    case 'CANCELLED':
    case 'CANCELED':
    case 'REFUNDED':
      return 'cancelled'
    case 'PENDING':
    case 'PROCESSING':
    case 'INITIATED':
      return 'pending'
    case 'FAILED':
    case 'EXPIRED':
      return 'failed'
    default:
      throw new Error(`The backend returned an unsupported order status: ${value}`)
  }
}

function mapOrder(value: unknown): Booking {
  if (!isRecord(value)) throw new Error('The backend returned an invalid order.')

  const event = isRecord(value.event) ? value.event : {}
  const id = firstString(value.orderNumber, value.id, value.orderId)
  const eventTitle = firstString(value.eventTitle, event.title, event.name)
  const venue = firstString(value.venue, event.venue) ?? 'Venue not provided'
  const date = firstString(value.eventDate, event.startAt, event.date, value.createdAt, value.created_at)
  const total = firstNumber(value.totalAmount, value.total, value.amount)
  const items = Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items : []
  const quantity = firstNumber(value.quantity) ??
    items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (isRecord(item) ? firstNumber(item.quantity) ?? 0 : 0), 0)

  if (!id || !eventTitle || !date || quantity < 1) {
    throw new Error('The backend returned an order missing its number, event, date, or ticket quantity.')
  }

  return {
    id,
    eventTitle,
    venue,
    date,
    quantity,
    ...(total === undefined ? {} : { total }),
    status: normalizeStatus(value.status ?? value.paymentStatus),
  }
}

export async function fetchBookings(): Promise<Booking[]> {
  const result = await api<unknown>('/orders/mine')
  if (!Array.isArray(result)) throw new Error('The backend returned an invalid order history.')
  return result.map(mapOrder)
}

export type Booking = {
  id: string;
  eventTitle: string;
  venue: string;
  date: string; // ISO date, e.g. 2026-09-12
  quantity: number;
  total?: number;
  status: BookingStatus;
};

import type { Booking } from '../bookingTypes';
import styles from './BookingCard.module.css';

function formatDate(iso: string) {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric',
  });
}

export function BookingCard({ booking }: { booking: Booking }) {
  const statusClass = styles[booking.status]

  return (
    <article className={styles.card}>
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <h3 className={styles.title}>{booking.eventTitle}</h3>
        <p className={styles.meta}>
          {booking.venue} Â· {formatDate(booking.date)}
        </p>
        <p className={styles.meta}>
          {booking.id} Â· {booking.quantity} ticket{booking.quantity > 1 ? 's' : ''}
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.side}>
        <strong className={styles.total}>
          {booking.total === undefined ? 'Total unavailable' : `MK ${booking.total.toLocaleString()}`}
        </strong>
        <span className={`${styles.badge} ${statusClass}`}>{booking.status}</span>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import type { Ticket } from '../ticketTypes';
import { formatDate } from '../ticketFormat';
import { downloadTicketImage, ticketFromView } from '../ticketImage';
import styles from './TicketDetail.module.css';

// The ticket itself: status, event, QR code and the download button.
// The full details (venue, price, purchase time...) are in TicketInfoTable.
export function TicketDetail({ ticket }: { ticket: Ticket }) {
  const statusClass = ticket.status === 'valid' ? styles.valid : styles.used;

  return (
    <article className={styles.card}>
      <div className={styles.info}>
        <span className={`${styles.badge} ${statusClass}`}>{ticket.status}</span>
        <h2 className={styles.title}>{ticket.eventTitle}</h2>
        <p className={styles.venue}>
          {ticket.venue}, {ticket.city}
        </p>
        <p className={styles.venue}>
          {formatDate(ticket.date)} Â· {ticket.time}
        </p>

        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.download}
          onClick={() => void downloadTicketImage(ticketFromView(ticket), null, ticket.qrCodeDataUrl)}
        >
          Download ticket
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.qrBox}>
        {ticket.qrCodeDataUrl ? (
          <img
            src={ticket.qrCodeDataUrl}
            width={168}
            height={168}
            alt=""
            style={{ width: 168, height: 168, objectFit: 'contain' }}
          />
        ) : (
          <p className={styles.qrNote}>A QR code is unavailable for this ticket.</p>
        )}
        <p className={styles.qrId}>{ticket.id}</p>
        <p className={styles.qrNote}>
          {ticket.status === 'valid'
            ? 'Show this code at the entrance'
            : ticket.status === 'used'
              ? 'This ticket has already been used'
              : `This ticket is ${ticket.status}`}
        </p>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import { Link } from '@tanstack/react-router';

export function TicketsTable({ tickets }: { tickets: Ticket[] }) {

    <div className={styles.wrap}>
      <table className={styles.table}>
        <caption className="sr-only">Your tickets</caption>

          <tr>

            <th scope="col">Date</th>
            <th scope="col">Venue</th>
            <th scope="col">Type</th>
            <th scope="col">Price</th>

            <th scope="col">
              <span className="sr-only">Open</span>
            </th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {tickets.map((t, index) => (
            <tr key={t.id || index}>
              <td>
                {t.id ? (
                  <Link to="/tickets/$ticketId" params={{ ticketId: t.id }} className={styles.link}>
                    {t.eventTitle || 'Unknown Event'}
                  </Link>
                ) : (
                  <span className={styles.event}>{t.eventTitle || 'Unknown Event'}</span>
                )}
              </td>
              <td>{t.date ? formatDate(t.date) : 'TBD'}</td>
              <td>{t.venue ? `${t.venue}, ${t.city}` : 'â€”'}</td>
              <td>{t.ticketType || 'Standard'}</td>
              <td>{formatMoney(t.price ?? 0)}</td>
              <td>
                <span
                  className={`${styles.badge} ${t.status === 'valid' ? styles.valid : styles.used}`}
                >
                  {t.status || 'valid'}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td>{t.purchasedAt ? formatDateTime(t.purchasedAt) : 'â€”'}</td>
              <td>
                {t.id && (
                  <Link to="/tickets/$ticketId" params={{ ticketId: t.id }} className={styles.link}>
                    View ticket
                  </Link>
                )}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );

import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useAuth } from '../../authentication'
import { fetchBookings } from '../bookingData'

export function useBookings() {
  const { user } = useAuth()
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['bookings', user?.id],
    queryFn: fetchBookings,
    enabled: !!user?.id,
  })
}

FILE: ./src/features/tickets/hooks/useTickets.ts
================================================================================
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { fetchTickets } from '../ticketData';
import { useAuth } from '../../authentication';

export function useTickets() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const userId = user?.id;
  return useQuery({
    // Keyed per user so switching accounts never shows the previous cache.
    queryKey: ['tickets', userId],
    queryFn: () => fetchTickets(userId, user?.name ?? ''),
    enabled: !!userId,
  });
}
